### Task 14: The service's wake

**Files:**

- Create: `tests/wake-service.test.ts`
- Modify: `src/kanban/service.ts`, `src/kanban/types.ts`

§3.1, §3.4 and §13. `KanbanService` is given the gateway's `kanban.wake` switch and depth (`wake`, absent in the board's own tests: on, to depth 5). `setWake(taskId, {on: true, as} | {on: false}, by, appId)` refuses wake on with `wake_off`, a new refusal code, while wakes are off, and passes everything else to the writer's `setWake` with the depth bound; off always works. `create` takes `wake: {by, depth}`: refused `wake_off` while wakes are off, refused for a terminal's task with no `--chat`, made with wake off and the too-deep `wake_set` at `max_depth` or more, and ignored for a run's follow-up, which the writer makes inherit. The wake writes the waker will make (`recordWake` to `passWake`) are passed through, as the notifier's `advanceSubscription` is, so the waker reaches the writer through the service alone. Nothing calls any of it yet.

- [ ] **Step 14.1: Write the tests.**

Create `tests/wake-service.test.ts`:

```ts
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { eventsOf, getTask, getWake, subscriptionsOf } from '../src/db/kanban-read.js';
import { KanbanService, type CreateRequest, type KanbanServiceDeps } from '../src/kanban/service.js';
import type { Role } from '../src/roles.js';
import { ManualClock, testDb, type TestDb } from './helpers/db.js';
import { ALICE, VIA, WORKSPACES } from './helpers/kanban.js';

/**
 * The service's wake (wake spec §3.1, §3.4, §13): `setWake` with its refusals,
 * `create` taking a wake, and the wake writes the waker goes through.
 */

const APP = 'cli_app';
const BOB = 'lark:on_bob';
const FOLLOW = { appId: APP, chatId: 'oc_team', threadId: '', rootId: null };

let h: TestDb;
let clock: ManualClock;
beforeEach(() => {
  h = testDb();
  clock = new ManualClock();
});
afterEach(() => h.close());

const ROLES: ReadonlyMap<string, Role> = new Map([
  [
    'implementer',
    {
      name: 'implementer',
      source: 'directory',
      dir: undefined,
      description: undefined,
      workspace: undefined,
      agent: {
        driver: 'structured-cli',
        command: 'bytesec',
        args: [],
        env: {},
        unsupervised: true,
        passEnv: [],
        readOnlyTools: [],
        maskExempt: [],
      },
      roleMdPath: undefined,
      skills: [],
      secretValues: [],
    },
  ],
]);

function service(extra: Partial<KanbanServiceDeps> = {}): KanbanService {
  return new KanbanService({ db: h.db, roles: ROLES, workspaces: WORKSPACES, clock, ...extra });
}

function request(extra: Partial<CreateRequest> = {}): CreateRequest {
  return { title: 'Book the venue', assignee: 'implementer', createdBy: ALICE, createdVia: VIA, ...extra };
}

function ok<T extends { ok: boolean }>(r: T): Extract<T, { ok: true }> {
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(JSON.stringify(r));
  return r as Extract<T, { ok: true }>;
}

const WAKES_OFF =
  'wakes are off on this gateway: an operator turns them on with kanban.wake.enabled: true in config.yaml, and a restart';

describe('KanbanService.create with a wake', () => {
  it('makes a task with wake on, as its setter, at its depth', () => {
    const { task } = ok(service().create(request({ wake: { by: ALICE, depth: 2 } })));
    expect(task).toMatchObject({ wakeBy: ALICE, wakeDepth: 2 });
    expect(eventsOf(h.db, task.taskId).map((e) => e.kind)).toEqual(['created', 'wake_set']);
  });

  it('keeps a depth without a wake', () => {
    const { task } = ok(service().create(request({ wake: { by: null, depth: 1 } })));
    expect(task).toMatchObject({ wakeBy: null, wakeDepth: 1 });
  });

  it('refuses a wake while wakes are off, and makes nothing', () => {
    const r = service({ wake: { enabled: false, maxDepth: 5 } }).create(request({ wake: { by: ALICE, depth: 0 } }));
    expect(r).toEqual({ ok: false, code: 'wake_off', message: WAKES_OFF });
    expect(h.db.prepare('SELECT count(*) AS n FROM kanban_tasks').get()).toEqual({ n: 0 });
  });

  it("makes a task asked with no wake while wakes are off", () => {
    expect(service({ wake: { enabled: false, maxDepth: 5 } }).create(request()).ok).toBe(true);
  });

  it("refuses a terminal's wake with no chat to follow the task", () => {
    const r = service().create(request({ createdVia: { kind: 'operator' }, wake: { by: ALICE, depth: 0 } }));
    expect(r).toEqual({ ok: false, code: 'invalid', message: 'a wake needs a chat that follows the task: add --chat' });
    const followed = ok(service().create(request({ createdVia: { kind: 'operator' }, follow: FOLLOW, wake: { by: ALICE, depth: 0 } })));
    expect(followed.task.wakeBy).toBe(ALICE);
  });

  it('makes a task at max_depth or more with wake off, recording why', () => {
    const { task } = ok(service({ wake: { enabled: true, maxDepth: 5 } }).create(request({ wake: { by: ALICE, depth: 5 } })));
    expect(task).toMatchObject({ wakeBy: null, wakeDepth: 5 });
    expect(eventsOf(h.db, task.taskId).find((e) => e.kind === 'wake_set')?.payload).toEqual({ on: false, refused: 'too_deep', depth: 5 });
    const shallow = ok(service({ wake: { enabled: true, maxDepth: 5 } }).create(request({ wake: { by: ALICE, depth: 4 } })));
    expect(shallow.task.wakeBy).toBe(ALICE);
  });

  it('refuses a wake that is not a principal and a depth', () => {
    for (const wake of [{ by: 'alice', depth: 0 }, { by: ALICE, depth: -1 }, { by: ALICE, depth: 1.5 }]) {
      expect(service().create(request({ wake })).ok).toBe(false);
    }
  });
});

describe('KanbanService.setWake', () => {
  it('turns wake on and off, and says when it was already so', () => {
    const s = service();
    const { task } = ok(s.create(request()));
    expect(ok(s.setWake(task.taskId, { on: true, as: ALICE }, ALICE, APP))).toMatchObject({ changed: true, tooDeep: false, task: { wakeBy: ALICE } });
    expect(ok(s.setWake(task.taskId, { on: true, as: ALICE }, ALICE, APP)).changed).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(s.setWake(task.taskId, { on: true, as: BOB }, BOB, APP)).task.wakeBy).toBe(BOB);
    expect(ok(s.setWake(task.taskId, { on: false }, ALICE, APP))).toMatchObject({ changed: true, task: { wakeBy: null } });
    expect(ok(s.setWake(task.taskId, { on: false }, ALICE, APP)).changed).toBe(false);
  });

  it('refuses wake on while wakes are off, and still turns it off', () => {
    const on = service();
    const { task } = ok(on.create(request()));
    ok(on.setWake(task.taskId, { on: true, as: ALICE }, ALICE, APP));
    const off = service({ wake: { enabled: false, maxDepth: 5 } });
    expect(off.setWake(task.taskId, { on: true, as: BOB }, BOB, APP)).toEqual({ ok: false, code: 'wake_off', message: WAKES_OFF });
    expect(ok(off.setWake(task.taskId, { on: false }, ALICE, APP)).task.wakeBy).toBeNull();
  });

  it('refuses a task no chat of this bot follows', () => {
    const s = service();
    const { task } = ok(s.create(request({ createdVia: { kind: 'operator' } })));
    expect(s.setWake(task.taskId, { on: true, as: ALICE }, ALICE, APP)).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      code: 'invalid',
      message: `a wake needs a chat that follows the task, and no chat follows ${task.taskId}: a chat is chosen when a task is made`,
    });
  });

  it('leaves a task too deep with wake off, as a note', () => {
    const s = service({ wake: { enabled: true, maxDepth: 2 } });
    const { task } = ok(s.create(request({ wake: { by: null, depth: 2 } })));
    expect(ok(s.setWake(task.taskId, { on: true, as: ALICE }, ALICE, APP))).toMatchObject({ changed: false, tooDeep: true, task: { wakeBy: null } });
  });

  it('refuses ids that are not text, and a task that is not there', () => {
    const s = service();
    expect(s.setWake(7 as unknown as string, { on: false }, ALICE, APP)).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: 'invalid' });
    expect(s.setWake('k_none', { on: true, as: ALICE }, ALICE, APP)).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: 'not_found' });
  });
});

describe("the waker's writes through the service", () => {
  it('records, stamps, refuses, delivers and passes a wake', () => {
    const s = service();
    const { task } = ok(s.create(request({ wake: { by: ALICE, depth: 0 } })));
    const sub = subscriptionsOf(h.db, task.taskId)[0];
    if (sub === undefined) throw new Error('no subscription');
    const event = eventsOf(h.db, task.taskId).at(-1);
    if (event === undefined) throw new Error('no event');
    const { wake } = ok(
      s.recordWake({
        uuid: 'u-1',
        channel: 'lark',
        appId: APP,
        conversationId: sub.conversationId,
        threadId: sub.threadId,
        principal: ALICE,
        depth: 0,
        events: [{ subscriptionId: sub.id, eventId: event.id, taskId: task.taskId }],
      }),
    );
    expect(ok(s.wakeMarked(wake.wakeId)).marked).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(s.wakeSubmitted(wake.wakeId, 's_one', 'key-1', 'boot-1')).submitted).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(s.wakeRefused(wake.wakeId, 'session s_one is closed'))).toMatchObject({ refused: true, attempt: 2 });
    clock.advance(1_000);
    expect(ok(s.advanceWake(wake.wakeId)).delivered).toBe(true);
    expect(getWake(h.db, wake.wakeId)).toMatchObject({ state: 'delivered', deliveredAt: clock.now() });
    expect(subscriptionsOf(h.db, task.taskId)[0]?.wakeCursor).toBe(event.id);
    expect(ok(s.dropWake(wake.wakeId, 'late')).dropped).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(s.liftedWake(wake.wakeId)).lifted).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(s.passWake(sub.id, event.id + 1)).advanced).toBe(true);
    expect(getTask(h.db, task.taskId)?.wakeBy).toBe(ALICE);
  });
});
```

```ts
/** Why a wake asked for is refused while wakes are off (wake spec §3.4). */
export const WAKES_OFF =
  'wakes are off on this gateway: an operator turns them on with kanban.wake.enabled: true in config.yaml, and a restart';

/** A change of a task's wake, as chat or the terminal asks it (wake spec §3.1): on as a principal, or off. */
export type WakeRequest = { on: true; as: string } | { on: false };

/** A refusal unless a new task's wake is a principal, or none, and a whole depth (wake spec §3.1). */
function wakeShapeRefused(wake: unknown): Refusal | undefined {
  if (wake === undefined) return undefined;
  if (
    !isRecord(wake) ||
    !(wake.by === null || (isText(wake.by) && wake.by.startsWith('lark:') && wake.by.length > 'lark:'.length)) ||
    typeof wake.depth !== 'number' ||
    !Number.isSafeInteger(wake.depth) ||
    wake.depth < 0
  ) {
    return board.refuse('invalid', 'a wake is a principal, lark:<union_id>, or none, and a depth of 0 or more');
  }
  return undefined;
}

/** Whose environment a task's gates run with when no agent has run on it (spec §7.7). */
```


```ts
  }

  /**
   * A new task's wake, checked (wake spec §3.1, §3.4): refused while wakes are
   * off, and for a terminal's task no chat follows; made with wake off, as a
   * note, at `max_depth` or more. A run's follow-up inherits its creating
   * task's in the writer, whatever was asked, so nothing is refused for it.
   */
  #newWake(req: CreateRequest): Result<{ wake?: board.NewWake }> {
    const shape = wakeShapeRefused(req.wake);
    if (shape !== undefined) return shape;
    const w = req.wake;
    if (w === undefined || req.createdVia?.kind === 'run') return { ok: true };
    if (w.by === null) return { ok: true, wake: { by: null, depth: w.depth } };
    if (!this.#wake.enabled) return board.refuse('wake_off', WAKES_OFF);
    if (req.createdVia?.kind === 'operator' && req.follow === undefined) {
      return board.refuse('invalid', 'a wake needs a chat that follows the task: add --chat');
    }
    return { ok: true, wake: { by: w.by, depth: w.depth, ...(w.depth >= this.#wake.maxDepth ? { tooDeep: true } : {}) } };
  }

  /**
   * Turn a task's wake on or off (wake spec §3.1, §3.4), for this bot's
   * subscriptions: on runs its woken turns as `as`, set by `by`. Refused while
   * wakes are off, though off still works; a task too deep is left with wake
   * off, `tooDeep`, for the caller's note. Who may ask is the caller's.
   */
  setWake(taskId: string, change: WakeRequest, by: string, appId: string): Result<{ task: TaskRow; changed: boolean; tooDeep: boolean }> {
    const ids = idsRefused(taskId);
    if (ids !== undefined) return ids;
    if (change.on && !this.#wake.enabled) return board.refuse('wake_off', WAKES_OFF);
    const writerChange: board.WakeChange = change.on ? { on: true, as: change.as, maxDepth: this.#wake.maxDepth } : { on: false };
    return board.setWake(this.#db, taskId, writerChange, by, appId, this.#clock.now());
  }

  /** The waker's record of a batch (wake spec §5.5 step 2), through the writer. */
  recordWake(batch: board.NewWakeBatch): ReturnType<typeof board.recordWake> {
    return board.recordWake(this.#db, batch, this.#clock.now());
  }

  /** A wake's marker sent, or tried (wake spec §5.5 step 3). */
  wakeMarked(wakeId: number): Result<{ marked: boolean }> {
    return board.wakeMarked(this.#db, wakeId, this.#clock.now());
  }

  /** A wake's current attempt submitted, by this boot (wake spec §5.5 step 6). */
  wakeSubmitted(wakeId: number, sessionId: string, turnKey: string, boot: string): Result<{ submitted: boolean }> {
    return board.wakeSubmitted(this.#db, wakeId, sessionId, turnKey, boot);
  }

  /** A wake's attempt refused by its session (wake spec §5.6). */
  wakeRefused(wakeId: number, error: string): Result<{ refused: boolean; attempt: number }> {
    return board.wakeRefused(this.#db, wakeId, error);
  }

  /** A wake delivered, its cursors moved (wake spec §5.5 step 9). */
  advanceWake(wakeId: number): Result<{ delivered: boolean }> {
    return board.advanceWake(this.#db, wakeId, this.#clock.now());
  }

  /** A wake dropped, its cursors moved past all its events or only `tasks`' (wake spec §5.3a, §5.6). */
  dropWake(wakeId: number, error: string, opts: { tasks?: readonly string[] } = {}): Result<{ dropped: boolean }> {
    return board.dropWake(this.#db, wakeId, error, this.#clock.now(), opts);
  }

  /** A pending wake with nothing left once its lifted blocks are dropped (wake spec §5.3b). */
  liftedWake(wakeId: number): Result<{ lifted: boolean }> {
    return board.liftedWake(this.#db, wakeId, this.#clock.now());
  }

  /** A subscription's wake cursor moved past events the waker passes over (wake spec §5.2 step 3). */
  passWake(subscriptionId: number, cursor: number): Result<{ advanced: boolean }> {
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(subscriptionId) || !Number.isSafeInteger(cursor) || cursor < 0) {
      return board.refuse('invalid', 'a subscription and its cursor are whole numbers');
    }
    return board.passWake(this.#db, subscriptionId, cursor);
  }

   * The root of a thread, as the notifier finds it (spec §19.7): the message a
```

§3.1, §3.4 and D10, D14, D16. `/kanban task new` takes a field line `wake: on` or `wake: off`, beside `assignee:` and the others: on makes the task with wake on as the sender, at depth 0, and its "Created" reply ends `Its outcomes wake the agent here.`; any other value is refused. `/kanban task wake <task> on|off` is a new verb, at talk tier, answered in the spec's words with the setter by chat name, `already on` for the same setter, and the too-deep note; it is refused for a task another chat follows, and the service refuses a task no chat follows and, with wakes off, an on. `/kanban help` and `/kanban task`'s list of verbs gain it, so the parser's test of that list changes. The too-deep line is shared with the notice as `tooDeepLine`.

```ts
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { eventsOf, getTask } from '../src/db/kanban-read.js';
import { KanbanChat } from '../src/kanban/chat.js';
import { PeopleDirectory } from '../src/kanban/people.js';
import { KanbanService } from '../src/kanban/service.js';
import { Authorizer, defaultAuthConfig } from '../src/policy/auth.js';
import { clearSecrets } from '../src/secrets.js';
import type { BindingKey, InboundMessage, Principal } from '../src/types.js';
import { ManualClock, testDb, type TestDb } from './helpers/db.js';
import { DEFAULT_ROLES } from './helpers/dispatch.js';
import { WORKSPACES } from './helpers/kanban.js';

/**
 * Wake in chat (wake spec §3.1, §3.4): the `wake:` field line of `/kanban task
 * new`, and `/kanban task wake <task> on|off`, typed in a chat that follows the
 * task, its answers naming the setter by chat name.
 */

const OWNER: Principal = { openId: 'ou_owner', unionId: 'on_owner', displayName: 'Zhixi Sun' };
const GUEST: Principal = { openId: 'ou_guest', unionId: 'on_guest', displayName: 'Kevin Tu' };
const KEY: BindingKey = { channel: 'lark', appId: 'cli_app', conversationId: 'oc_team', threadId: 'omt_topic' };
const WAKES_OFF =
  'Not done: wakes are off on this gateway: an operator turns them on with kanban.wake.enabled: true in config.yaml, and a restart';

let t: TestDb;
let seq = 0;

beforeEach(() => {
  clearSecrets();
  t = testDb();
});
afterEach(() => {
  clearSecrets();
  t.close();
});

function harness(wake = { enabled: true, maxDepth: 5 }): { chat: KanbanChat; service: KanbanService } {
  const authorizer = new Authorizer({ ...defaultAuthConfig(OWNER.openId), allowTalk: [OWNER.openId, GUEST.openId] });
  const people = new PeopleDirectory({
    db: t.db,
    appId: 'cli_app',
    canTalk: ({ openId, unionId }) => authorizer.canTalk({ openId: openId ?? '', unionId, displayName: null }),
  });
  const service = new KanbanService({
    db: t.db,
    roles: new Map(DEFAULT_ROLES.map((r) => [r.name, r])),
    workspaces: WORKSPACES,
    clock: new ManualClock(),
    people,
    wake,
  });
  const chat = new KanbanChat({ service, hasTier: (p, tier) => authorizer.hasTier(p, tier), people, appId: 'cli_app' });
  return { chat, service };
}

function message(sender: Principal, key: BindingKey): InboundMessage {
  return {
    messageId: `om_${++seq}`,
    appId: 'cli_app',
    chatId: key.conversationId,
    chatType: 'group',
    threadId: key.threadId,
    rootId: 'om_root',
    sender,
    senderIsBot: false,
    text: '',
    mentionedBot: true,
    mentionAll: false,
    mentions: [],
    attachments: [],
    createTime: 0,
  };
}

async function say(chat: KanbanChat, arg: string, sender: Principal = OWNER, key: BindingKey = KEY): Promise<string> {
  return (await chat.run(arg, message(sender, key), key)).text;
}

function created(reply: string): string {
  const m = /^Created `(k_[0-9a-z]+)`/.exec(reply);
  if (m?.[1] === undefined) throw new Error(`not created: ${reply}`);
  return m[1];
}

describe('/kanban task new with a wake: line', () => {
  it('turns wake on as the sender, and says so in the reply', async () => {
    const { chat } = harness();
    const reply = await say(chat, 'task new Book the venue\nassignee: implementer\nwake: on');
    const task = getTask(t.db, created(reply));
    expect(task).toMatchObject({ wakeBy: 'lark:on_owner', wakeDepth: 0 });
    expect(reply).toMatch(/Its outcomes wake the agent here\.$/);
    expect(eventsOf(t.db, task?.taskId ?? '').map((e) => e.kind)).toContain('wake_set');
  });

  it('leaves wake off for wake: off, and with no line', async () => {
    const { chat } = harness();
    for (const text of ['task new Book the venue\nwake: off', 'task new Book the venue', 'task new Book the venue\nWAKE: Off']) {
      const reply = await say(chat, text);
      expect(getTask(t.db, created(reply))?.wakeBy).toBeNull();
      expect(reply).not.toContain('wake the agent');
    }
  });

  it('refuses a wake: line that is neither on nor off, and one given twice', async () => {
    const { chat } = harness();
    expect(await say(chat, 'task new Book the venue\nwake: maybe')).toBe('`wake:` is `on` or `off`.');
    expect(await say(chat, 'task new Book the venue\nwake: on\nwake: off')).toBe('`wake:` is given twice.');
  });

  it('refuses wake: on while wakes are off, and makes nothing', async () => {
    const { chat } = harness({ enabled: false, maxDepth: 5 });
    expect(await say(chat, 'task new Book the venue\nwake: on')).toBe(WAKES_OFF);
    expect(t.db.prepare('SELECT count(*) AS n FROM kanban_tasks').get()).toEqual({ n: 0 });
  });
});

describe('/kanban task wake', () => {
  it('turns wake on at talk tier, run as the sender, says when it is already on, and turns it off', async () => {
    const { chat } = harness();
    const taskId = created(await say(chat, 'task new Book the venue'));
    expect(await say(chat, `task wake ${taskId} on`, GUEST)).toBe(
      `Wake is on for \`${taskId}\`: its outcomes now start a turn of the agent where it is followed, run as Kevin Tu.`,
    );
    expect(getTask(t.db, taskId)?.wakeBy).toBe('lark:on_guest');
    expect(await say(chat, `task wake ${taskId} on`, GUEST)).toBe(`Wake is already on for \`${taskId}\`, run as Kevin Tu.`);
    // Another setter replaces the first.
    expect(await say(chat, `task wake ${taskId} ON`)).toContain('run as Zhixi Sun.');
    expect(getTask(t.db, taskId)?.wakeBy).toBe('lark:on_owner');
    // Anyone with talk tier may turn it off.
    expect(await say(chat, `task wake ${taskId} off`, GUEST)).toBe(`Wake is off for \`${taskId}\`: its outcomes are notices only.`);
    expect(getTask(t.db, taskId)?.wakeBy).toBeNull();
    expect(await say(chat, `task wake ${taskId} off`, GUEST)).toBe(`Wake is off for \`${taskId}\`: its outcomes are notices only.`);
  });

  it('takes a task followed in any thread of this chat, or at its chat scope', async () => {
    const { chat } = harness();
    const taskId = created(await say(chat, 'task new Book the venue'));
    const elsewhere: BindingKey = { ...KEY, threadId: '' };
    expect(await say(chat, `task wake ${taskId} on`, OWNER, elsewhere)).toContain(`Wake is on for \`${taskId}\``);
  });

  it('refuses a task another chat follows', async () => {
    const { chat } = harness();
    const taskId = created(await say(chat, 'task new Book the venue'));
    const other: BindingKey = { ...KEY, conversationId: 'oc_other', threadId: '' };
    expect(await say(chat, `task wake ${taskId} on`, OWNER, other)).toBe(
      `Not done: \`${taskId}\` is followed by another chat, so its wake is set there, or from the terminal`,
    );
    expect(getTask(t.db, taskId)?.wakeBy).toBeNull();
  });

  it('refuses a task no chat follows', async () => {
    const { chat, service } = harness();
    const r = service.create({ title: 'Book the venue', createdBy: 'lark:on_owner', createdVia: { kind: 'operator' } });
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.message);
    expect(await say(chat, `task wake ${r.task.taskId} on`)).toBe(
      // A refusal's words are escaped, as every refusal chat shows.
      `Not done: a wake needs a chat that follows the task, and no chat follows ${r.task.taskId.replace('_', '\\_')}: a chat is chosen when a task is made`,
    );
  });

  it('refuses wake on while wakes are off, and still turns it off', async () => {
    const on = harness();
    const taskId = created(await say(on.chat, 'task new Book the venue\nwake: on'));
    const off = harness({ enabled: false, maxDepth: 5 });
    expect(await say(off.chat, `task wake ${taskId} on`, GUEST)).toBe(WAKES_OFF);
    expect(await say(off.chat, `task wake ${taskId} off`)).toBe(`Wake is off for \`${taskId}\`: its outcomes are notices only.`);
  });

  it('notes a task too deep, and leaves its wake off', async () => {
    const { chat, service } = harness();
    const r = service.create({
      title: 'Book the venue',
      createdBy: 'lark:on_owner',
      createdVia: { kind: 'chat', channel: 'lark', appId: 'cli_app', conversationId: 'oc_team', threadId: 'omt_topic', chatType: 'group' },
      wake: { by: null, depth: 5 },
    });
```

### Task 16: Workflows' `wake`

**Files:**

- Create: `tests/wake-workflow.test.ts`
- Modify: `src/db/kanban.ts`, `src/kanban/chat-parse.ts`, `src/kanban/chat.ts`, `src/kanban/dag.ts`, `src/kanban/service.ts`, `src/kanban/workflow.ts`, `tests/kanban-dag.test.ts`

§3.1 and §3.4. A step takes `wake: true`, and a DAG task `"wake": true`, each a boolean, default false, an unknown value refused naming its place (`steps.book.wake is true or false`, `tasks[0] (a).wake is true or false`); the expansion carries a step's into its DAG task. A start or an apply takes `wake: {by, depth, all}`: every member's wake with `all`, else only the members that ask, run as `by`. With wakes off, `all` is refused `wake_off`, and a start whose steps ask still starts with every member notice-only, its answer carrying `wakeNote`; `all` at the terminal with no `--chat` is refused. A run's start or apply is left to the writer, whose members inherit their creating task's wake. Chat's `/kanban workflow start <name> … wake` reads a trailing bare word `wake`, which no `key=value` pair can be, and passes the sender as setter, its reply ending with the note when wakes are off. The terminal's `--wake` is the next task's. The DAG's list of task keys in `tests/kanban-dag.test.ts` gains `wake`. A terminal's start or apply with no chat whose steps ask for the chat session's wake makes those members notice-only, with its note (§19.16).

```ts
import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { getTask } from '../src/db/kanban-read.js';
import { parseKanban } from '../src/kanban/chat-parse.js';
import { KanbanChat } from '../src/kanban/chat.js';
import { canonicalDag, checkDagShape } from '../src/kanban/dag.js';
import { PeopleDirectory } from '../src/kanban/people.js';
import { KanbanService, type StartRequest, type WorkflowMade } from '../src/kanban/service.js';
import type { CreatedVia, Result } from '../src/kanban/types.js';
import { readWorkflow } from '../src/kanban/workflow.js';
import { Authorizer, defaultAuthConfig } from '../src/policy/auth.js';
import { clearSecrets } from '../src/secrets.js';
import type { BindingKey, InboundMessage, Principal } from '../src/types.js';
import { testDb, type TestDb } from './helpers/db.js';
import { role } from './helpers/dispatch.js';
import { ALICE, VIA, claimed } from './helpers/kanban.js';

/**
 * A workflow's wake (wake spec §3.1, §3.4): `wake: true` in a step and `"wake":
 * true` in a DAG task, checked; a start's wake for every member, or only the
 * steps that ask; a run's start inheriting its task's; chat's bare `wake` on
 * `workflow start`; and a start whose steps ask for one while wakes are off.
 */

const OPERATOR: CreatedVia = { kind: 'operator' };
const FOLLOW = { appId: 'cli_app', chatId: 'oc_team', threadId: '', rootId: null };
const WAKES_OFF =
  'wakes are off on this gateway: an operator turns them on with kanban.wake.enabled: true in config.yaml, and a restart';
const NOTE = 'wakes are off on this gateway (kanban.wake.enabled), so the steps that ask for one are notice-only';
const NO_CHAT = 'no chat follows this start (add --chat), so the steps that wake the chat session are notice-only';

const FLOW = `steps:
  draft:
    title: Draft the agenda
    assignee: implementer
  book:
    parents: [draft]
    title: Book the venue
    assignee: implementer
    wake: true
`;

let h: TestDb;
let dir: string;

beforeEach(() => {
  clearSecrets();
  h = testDb();
  dir = join(h.dir, 'workflows');
  mkdirSync(dir);
  writeFileSync(join(dir, 'flow.yaml'), FLOW);
});
afterEach(() => {
  clearSecrets();
  h.close();
});

function service(wake = { enabled: true, maxDepth: 5 }): KanbanService {
  return new KanbanService({ db: h.db, roles: new Map([['implementer', role('implementer')]]), workspaces: new Set(['default']), workflowsDir: dir, wake });
}

const FACTS = { roles: new Map([['implementer', role('implementer')]]), workspaces: new Set(['default']), supervisedRoles: false };

function made(r: Result<object>): WorkflowMade {
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`${r.code}: ${r.message}`);
  return r as unknown as WorkflowMade;
}

function start(s: KanbanService, over: Partial<StartRequest> = {}): Result<WorkflowMade> {
  return s.startWorkflow({ workflow: 'flow', params: { from: 'json', params: {} }, createdBy: ALICE, createdVia: VIA, ...over });
}

function wakes(r: WorkflowMade): Array<[string, string | null]> {
  return r.tasks.map((t) => [t.ref, getTask(h.db, t.taskId)?.wakeBy ?? null]);
}

describe("a step's wake", () => {
  it('reads wake: true, and carries it into the DAG, absent where it is false', () => {
    const r = readWorkflow(dir, 'flow', FACTS);
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.message);
    expect(r.workflow.steps.map((s) => [s.name, s.wake])).toEqual([
      ['draft', false],
      ['book', true],
    ]);
    const preview = service().previewWorkflow({ workflow: 'flow', params: { from: 'json', params: {} }, createdBy: 'operator:me', createdVia: OPERATOR });
    if (!preview.ok) throw new Error(preview.message);
    expect(preview.dag.tasks.map((t) => t.wake)).toEqual([undefined, true]);
    expect(canonicalDag(preview.dag)).toContain('"gates":[],"wake":true}');
    expect(canonicalDag(preview.dag)).not.toContain('"wake":false');
  });

  it('refuses a wake that is not true or false, naming its place', () => {
    writeFileSync(join(dir, 'flow.yaml'), FLOW.replace('wake: true', 'wake: maybe'));
    const r = readWorkflow(dir, 'flow', FACTS);
    expect(r.ok).toBe(false);
    if (!r.ok) expect(r.message).toContain('steps.book.wake is true or false');
  });
});

describe("a DAG task's wake", () => {
  const dag = (wake: unknown) => ({
    format: 1,
    tasks: [{ ref: 'a', title: 'Book the venue', assignee: 'implementer', ...(wake === undefined ? {} : { wake }) }],
  });

  it('is true or false, false the same as none', () => {
    const on = checkDagShape(dag(true), 'terminal');
    const off = checkDagShape(dag(false), 'terminal');
    const none = checkDagShape(dag(undefined), 'terminal');
    if (!on.ok || !off.ok || !none.ok) throw new Error('refused');
    expect(on.dag.tasks[0]?.wake).toBe(true);
    expect(off.sha256).toBe(none.sha256);
    expect(on.sha256).not.toBe(none.sha256);
    expect(checkDagShape(dag('yes'), 'terminal')).toEqual({ ok: false, code: 'invalid', message: 'tasks[0] (a).wake is true or false' });
  });

  it("makes an apply's members with wake on where they say so, as the apply's setter", () => {
    const s = service();
    const r = made(
      s.applyDag({
        dag: { format: 1, tasks: [{ ref: 'a', title: 'A', wake: true }, { ref: 'b', title: 'B' }] },
        createdBy: 'operator:me',
        createdVia: OPERATOR,
        follow: FOLLOW,
        wake: { by: ALICE, depth: 0, all: false },
      }),
    );
    expect(wakes(r)).toEqual([
      ['a', ALICE],
      ['b', null],
    ]);
  });
});

describe("a start's wake", () => {
  it('turns wake on for the steps that ask, as the setter, or for every member', () => {
    const steps = made(start(service(), { wake: { by: ALICE, depth: 0, all: false } }));
    expect(wakes(steps)).toEqual([
      ['draft', null],
      ['book', ALICE],
    ]);
    expect(steps.wakeNote).toBeUndefined();
    const all = made(start(service(), { wake: { by: ALICE, depth: 0, all: true }, idempotencyKey: 'again' }));
    expect(wakes(all)).toEqual([
      ['draft', ALICE],
      ['book', ALICE],
    ]);
  });

  it('turns none on with no setter', () => {
    expect(wakes(made(start(service())))).toEqual([
      ['draft', null],
      ['book', null],
    ]);
  });

  it('refuses a wake for every member while wakes are off, and starts a file whose steps ask for one with a note', () => {
    const off = service({ enabled: false, maxDepth: 5 });
    expect(start(off, { wake: { by: ALICE, depth: 0, all: true } })).toEqual({ ok: false, code: 'wake_off', message: WAKES_OFF });
    const r = made(start(off, { wake: { by: ALICE, depth: 0, all: false } }));
    expect(wakes(r)).toEqual([
      ['draft', null],
      ['book', null],
    ]);
    expect(r.wakeNote).toBe(NOTE);
  });

  it("refuses a terminal's wake for every member with no chat to follow them", () => {
    expect(start(service(), { createdVia: OPERATOR, createdBy: 'operator:me', wake: { by: ALICE, depth: 0, all: true } })).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      code: 'invalid',
      message: 'a wake needs a chat that follows the task: add --chat',
    });
  });

  it("starts a terminal's file whose steps ask for the chat session's wake with no chat, those members notice-only, with the note", () => {
    const r = made(start(service(), { createdVia: OPERATOR, createdBy: 'operator:me', wake: { by: ALICE, depth: 0, all: false } }));
    expect(wakes(r)).toEqual([
      ['draft', null],
      ['book', null],
    ]);
    expect(r.wakeNote).toBe(NO_CHAT);
  });

  it("applies a terminal's DAG whose tasks ask for the chat session's wake with no chat, those members notice-only, with the note", () => {
    const r = made(
      service().applyDag({
        dag: { format: 1, tasks: [{ ref: 'a', title: 'A', wake: true }, { ref: 'b', title: 'B' }] },
        createdBy: 'operator:me',
        createdVia: OPERATOR,
        wake: { by: ALICE, depth: 0, all: false },
      }),
    );
    expect(wakes(r)).toEqual([
      ['a', null],
      ['b', null],
    ]);
    expect(r.wakeNote).toBe(NO_CHAT);
  });

  it("gives a run's start its task's wake, whatever the steps say", () => {
    const s = service();
    const parent = s.create({ title: 'Plan the offsite', assignee: 'implementer', createdBy: ALICE, createdVia: VIA, wake: { by: ALICE, depth: 1 } });
    if (!parent.ok) throw new Error(parent.message);
    const run = claimed(h.db, parent.task.taskId);
    const r = made(start(s, { createdBy: `run:${run.runId}`, createdVia: { kind: 'run', runId: run.runId } }));
    expect(r.tasks.map((t) => [t.ref, getTask(h.db, t.taskId)?.wakeBy, getTask(h.db, t.taskId)?.wakeDepth])).toEqual([
      ['draft', ALICE, 1],
      ['book', ALICE, 1],
    ]);
  });
});

describe("chat's bare wake on workflow start", () => {
```

```ts
  /** The one transaction (workflows spec §6 step 3). */
```

with:

```ts

  /**
   * A start's or an apply's wake, checked (wake spec §3.1, §3.4): a wake for
   * every member is refused while wakes are off, and at the terminal with no
   * chat to follow them; a start whose steps ask for one while wakes are off,
   * or at the terminal with no chat (§19.16), still starts, those members
   * notice-only, with the note. A run's members
   * inherit its task's in the writer, so nothing is asked for them.
   */
  #startWake(req: StartRequest | ApplyRequest, dag: Dag): Result<{ wake?: board.NewWake & { all: boolean }; wakeNote?: string }> {
    const w = req.wake;
    if (w === undefined || req.createdVia?.kind === 'run') return { ok: true };
    const shape = wakeShapeRefused({ by: w.by, depth: w.depth });
    if (shape !== undefined) return shape;
    const asked = w.all || dag.tasks.some((t) => t.wake === true);
    if (!asked) return { ok: true, wake: { by: null, depth: w.depth, all: false } };
    if (!this.#wake.enabled) {
      if (w.all) return board.refuse('wake_off', WAKES_OFF);
      return { ok: true, wake: { by: null, depth: w.depth, all: false }, wakeNote: STEPS_NOTICE_ONLY };
    }
    if (req.createdVia?.kind === 'operator' && req.follow === undefined) {
      if (w.all) return board.refuse('invalid', 'a wake needs a chat that follows the task: add --chat');
      // The steps' wake is the chat session's, and no chat follows the members: they are made notice-only, with a note (§19.16).
      return { ok: true, wake: { by: null, depth: w.depth, all: false }, wakeNote: NO_CHAT_NOTICE_ONLY };
    }
    return { ok: true, wake: { by: w.by, depth: w.depth, all: w.all, ...(w.depth >= this.#wake.maxDepth ? { tooDeep: true } : {}) } };
  }

  /** The one transaction (workflows spec §6 step 3). */
```

### Task 17: The terminal's `--wake` and `task wake`

**Files:**

- Create: `tests/mt-wake.test.ts`
- Modify: `src/cli/gate.ts`, `src/cli/mt.ts`, `src/cli/operator.ts`, `src/kanban/service.ts`, `tests/mt-kanban-operator-tasks.test.ts`

§3.1, §3.2 and §3.4. A wake set from the terminal runs as the owner: `BoardAccess.owner()` finds the owner's principal in `people` by the owner's open_id for this bot (`personByOpenId`), refusing an owner the bot has not seen in the spec's words, and no owner or no app id as the talk check is. `BoardAccess.wake` is this shell's `kanban.wake`, which the terminal's service is given too. `mt kanban task new --wake` is refused while wakes are off, with no `--chat`, and for an unseen owner, in that order; its answer gains `; its outcomes wake the agent`, and its `--json` gains `wake: {on, by, depth}` for a task it made. `mt kanban task wake <task_id> on|off [--board] [--json]` sets the owner as `wake_by`, the operator as the event's actor, and answers in the spec's words, naming the conversation it wakes, or the too-deep note. `workflow start --wake` turns wake on for every member; without it, and on `workflow apply`, the members that ask wake as the owner when the bot has seen them. A start's answer ends with the wakes-off note, `wake_note` in `--json`. `USAGE` and `mt kanban task`'s list of verbs gain them. A start whose steps ask for a wake, with no `--chat` or with an owner not yet seen, ends with its one note (§19.16).

Create `tests/mt-wake.test.ts`:

```ts
import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { userInfo } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { eventsOf, getTask } from '../src/db/kanban-read.js';
import { migrate, openDb, type Db } from '../src/db/open.js';
import { notePerson } from '../src/db/people.js';
import { listenWorker, workerSocketPath, type WorkerServer } from '../src/kanban/socket.js';
import { clearSecrets } from '../src/secrets.js';
import { SCHEMA_DIR } from './helpers/db.js';
import { NOW, newTask } from './helpers/kanban.js';
import { mtFixture, type MtFixture } from './helpers/mt.js';

/**
 * Wake at the terminal (wake spec §3.1, §3.2, §3.4): `--wake` on `mt kanban task
 * new` and `workflow start`, a DAG's `"wake": true` on `workflow apply`, and `mt
 * kanban task wake <task> on|off`, each run as the owner, found in `people` by
 * the owner's open_id, and set by the terminal's operator.
 */

let fx: MtFixture;
let db: Db;
let server: WorkerServer | undefined;
const ME = `operator:${userInfo().username}`;
const OWNER = 'lark:on_owner';
const WAKES_OFF =
  'wakes are off on this gateway: an operator turns them on with kanban.wake.enabled: true in config.yaml, and a restart';
const UNSEEN =
  'a wake set from the terminal runs as the owner, whom this gateway has not seen yet: the owner is known once they have used /kanban in Lark';

afterEach(async () => {
  clearSecrets();
  await server?.close();
  server = undefined;
  db?.close();
  fx?.cleanup();
});

/** A home with an app id and an owner, the board on, the owner seen by the bot, and a thread omt_topic in oc_team. */
async function setup(opts: { lines?: string[]; seen?: boolean } = {}): Promise<string> {
  clearSecrets();
  const lines = opts.lines ?? ['lark:', '  appId: cli_app', 'kanban:', '  enabled: true'];
  fx = mtFixture((ws) => [`workspace: ${ws}`, ...lines, 'agent:', '  driver: structured-cli', '  command: bytesec', '  unsupervised: true', ''].join('\n'));
  db = openDb(join(fx.home, 'team.db'));
  migrate(db, SCHEMA_DIR);
  if (opts.seen !== false) notePerson(db, { appId: 'cli_app', unionId: 'on_owner', openId: 'ou_owner', name: 'Zhixi Sun' }, NOW);
  const threaded = newTask(db, { createdVia: { kind: 'chat', channel: 'lark', appId: 'cli_app', conversationId: 'oc_team', threadId: 'omt_topic', rootId: 'om_root' } });
  mkdirSync(join(fx.home, 'workflows'));
  writeFileSync(
    join(fx.home, 'workflows', 'brief.yaml'),
    'steps:\n  a: { title: "Draft the brief", assignee: default }\n  b: { parents: [a], title: "Check the brief", assignee: default, wake: true }\n',
  );
  server = await listenWorker(workerSocketPath(fx.home), () => ({ ok: true }));
  return threaded.taskId;
}

const kanban = (argv: string[]) => fx.run(['kanban', ...argv], { env: { MT_OWNER_OPEN_ID: 'ou_owner' } });
const count = () => (db.prepare('SELECT count(*) AS n FROM kanban_tasks').get() as { n: number }).n;

describe('mt kanban task new --wake', () => {
  it('makes the task with wake on, as the owner, set by the operator, and says so', async () => {
    await setup();
    const r = await kanban(['task', 'new', 'Book the venue', '--assignee', 'default', '--chat', 'oc_team', '--wake']);
    expect(r.code, r.err).toBe(0);
    const id = /^created (k_[0-9a-z]+): /.exec(r.out)?.[1] ?? '';
    expect(r.out).toBe(`created ${id}: Book the venue, for role default, on board default; chat oc_team follows it; its outcomes wake the agent`);
    expect(getTask(db, id)).toMatchObject({ wakeBy: OWNER, wakeDepth: 0 });
    expect(eventsOf(db, id).find((e) => e.kind === 'wake_set')).toMatchObject({ actor: ME, payload: { on: true, as: OWNER, depth: 0 } });
    const json = JSON.parse((await kanban(['task', 'new', 'Order food', '--chat', 'oc_team', '--wake', '--json'])).out);
    expect(json).toMatchObject({ ok: true, existing: false, wake: { on: true, by: OWNER, depth: 0 } });
    expect(JSON.parse((await kanban(['task', 'new', 'Alone', '--json'])).out).wake).toEqual({ on: false, by: null, depth: 0 });
  });

  it('refuses --wake with no --chat, and makes nothing', async () => {
    await setup();
    const before = count();
    expect(await kanban(['task', 'new', 'x', '--wake'])).toEqual({ code: 1, out: '', err: 'mt: a wake needs a chat that follows the task: add --chat' });
    expect(count()).toBe(before);
  });

  it('refuses an owner this gateway has not seen', async () => {
    await setup({ seen: false });
    const before = count();
    expect(await kanban(['task', 'new', 'x', '--chat', 'oc_team', '--wake'])).toEqual({ code: 1, out: '', err: `mt: ${UNSEEN}` });
    expect(count()).toBe(before);
  });

  it('refuses --wake while wakes are off', async () => {
    await setup({ lines: ['lark:', '  appId: cli_app', 'kanban:', '  enabled: true', '  wake:', '    enabled: false'] });
    expect(await kanban(['task', 'new', 'x', '--chat', 'oc_team', '--wake'])).toEqual({ code: 1, out: '', err: `mt: ${WAKES_OFF}` });
    expect(JSON.parse((await kanban(['task', 'new', 'x', '--chat', 'oc_team', '--wake', '--json'])).out)).toEqual({ ok: false, code: 'wake_off', message: WAKES_OFF });
  });
});

describe('mt kanban task wake', () => {
  it('turns wake on as the owner, naming where it wakes, and off', async () => {
    const id = await setup();
    expect(await kanban(['task', 'wake', id, 'on'])).toEqual({
      code: 0,
      out: `wake on for ${id}: its outcomes start a turn in oc_team/omt_topic, as ${OWNER} (the owner)`,
      err: '',
    });
    expect(getTask(db, id)?.wakeBy).toBe(OWNER);
    expect(eventsOf(db, id).filter((e) => e.kind === 'wake_set').at(-1)).toMatchObject({ actor: ME });
    expect(JSON.parse((await kanban(['task', 'wake', id, 'on', '--json'])).out)).toEqual({ ok: true, task_id: id, wake: { on: true, by: OWNER, depth: 0 } });
    expect(await kanban(['task', 'wake', id, 'off'])).toEqual({ code: 0, out: `wake off for ${id}`, err: '' });
    expect(JSON.parse((await kanban(['task', 'wake', id, 'off', '--json'])).out)).toEqual({ ok: true, task_id: id, wake: { on: false, by: null, depth: 0 } });
  });

  it('names a chat-scope task by its chat alone', async () => {
    await setup();
    const id = /^created (k_[0-9a-z]+)/.exec((await kanban(['task', 'new', 'x', '--chat', 'oc_team'])).out)?.[1] ?? '';
    expect((await kanban(['task', 'wake', id, 'on'])).out).toBe(`wake on for ${id}: its outcomes start a turn in oc_team, as ${OWNER} (the owner)`);
  });

  it('refuses a task no chat follows, and a task too deep is a note', async () => {
    await setup();
    const alone = newTask(db, { createdVia: { kind: 'operator' } });
    expect(await kanban(['task', 'wake', alone.taskId, 'on'])).toEqual({
      code: 1,
      out: '',
      err: `mt: a wake needs a chat that follows the task, and no chat follows ${alone.taskId}: a chat is chosen when a task is made`,
    });
    const deep = newTask(db, { wake: { by: null, depth: 5 } });
    expect(await kanban(['task', 'wake', deep.taskId, 'on'])).toEqual({ code: 0, out: `${deep.taskId} is 5 tasks deep in woken turns, so it stays notice-only`, err: '' });
    expect(getTask(db, deep.taskId)?.wakeBy).toBeNull();
  });

  it('refuses an owner not seen for on, and turns it off all the same', async () => {
    const id = await setup({ seen: false });
    expect(await kanban(['task', 'wake', id, 'on'])).toEqual({ code: 1, out: '', err: `mt: ${UNSEEN}` });
    expect((await kanban(['task', 'wake', id, 'off'])).code).toBe(0);
  });

  it('takes on or off, and nothing else', async () => {
    const id = await setup();
    for (const argv of [['task', 'wake', id], ['task', 'wake', id, 'maybe'], ['task', 'wake', id, 'on', 'now']]) {
      const r = await kanban(argv);
      expect(r.code, argv.join(' ')).toBe(2);
      expect(r.err.split('\n')[0]).toBe('mt: kanban task wake takes a task id, and on or off');
    }
  });
});

describe('a workflow at the terminal', () => {
  it('turns wake on for every member with --wake, as the owner', async () => {
    await setup();
    const r = JSON.parse((await kanban(['workflow', 'start', 'brief', '--chat', 'oc_team', '--wake', '--json'])).out);
    expect(r.ok).toBe(true);
    const ids = (r.tasks as Array<{ task_id: string }>).map((t) => t.task_id);
    expect(ids.map((id) => getTask(db, id)?.wakeBy)).toEqual([OWNER, OWNER]);
  });
```

```ts

/** A task's wake, as `--json` gives it (wake spec §3.4): on, by whom, and its depth. */
function wakeJson(task: TaskRow): { on: boolean; by: string | null; depth: number } {
  return { on: task.wakeBy !== null, by: task.wakeBy, depth: task.wakeDepth };
}

/**
 * The wake a terminal asks for (wake spec §3.2, §3.4), run as the owner: refused
 * while wakes are off, with no `--chat`, and for an owner this bot has not seen,
 * in that order. Undefined when none is asked.
 */
function terminalWake(board: BoardAccess, asked: boolean, chat: boolean): { ok: true; by: string } | Outcome | undefined {
  if (!asked) return undefined;
  if (!board.wake.enabled) return refused({ code: 'wake_off', message: WAKES_OFF });
  if (!chat) return refused({ code: 'invalid', message: 'a wake needs a chat that follows the task: add --chat' });
  const owner = board.owner();
  return owner.ok ? { ok: true, by: owner.principal } : refused(owner);
}

/**
 * A start's or an apply's wake (wake spec §3.1): every member's with `--wake`,
 * as `terminalWake` checks it; else the members that ask for one, as the owner
 * when this bot has seen them, and none otherwise, with a note (§19.16).
 */
function startWakeOf(board: BoardAccess, all: boolean, chat: boolean): StartWake | Outcome | undefined {
  if (all) {
    const w = terminalWake(board, true, chat);
    return w === undefined || !('by' in w) ? w : { by: w.by, depth: 0, all: true };
  }
  const owner = board.owner();
  // An owner not yet seen: the asking members are made notice-only, and the answer says so (wake spec §19.16).
  return { by: owner.ok ? owner.principal : null, depth: 0, all: false };
}

/** One task id, and nothing else. */
```

```ts
/** `mt kanban task comment <task> <text>`: an operator's comment, which steers the task's agent (spec §7.5). */
```

with:

```ts

/**
 * `mt kanban task wake <task> on|off [--board <name>] [--json]` (wake spec §3.1, §3.2):
 * on runs the task's woken turns as the owner, set by the operator; off clears it.
 */
function wake(rest: readonly string[], io: MtIo): Promise<number> {
  const { values, positionals } = parse(rest, BOARD_FLAGS);
  const [taskId, word, extra] = positionals;
  const on = word?.toLowerCase();
  if (taskId === undefined || (on !== 'on' && on !== 'off') || extra !== undefined) {
    throw new UsageError('kanban task wake takes a task id, and on or off');
  }
  const board = boardFlag(values.board);
  return act(io, values.json === true, 'mt kanban task wake', (service, by, b) => {
    const guard = offBoard(service, board, taskId);
    if (guard !== undefined) return guard;
    let as: string | undefined;
    if (on === 'on') {
      const owner = b.owner();
      if (!owner.ok) return refused(owner);
      as = owner.principal;
    }
    const r = service.setWake(taskId, as === undefined ? { on: false } : { on: true, as }, by, b.appId ?? '');
    if (!r.ok) return refused(r);
    const t = r.task;
    const json = { task_id: t.taskId, wake: wakeJson(t) };
    if (as === undefined) return { ok: true, lines: [`wake off for ${t.taskId}`], json };
    if (r.tooDeep) return { ok: true, lines: [`${t.taskId} is ${t.wakeDepth} tasks deep in woken turns, so it stays notice-only`], json };
    const f = storedFollows(service, b, t.taskId);
    const at = f === null ? '' : ` in ${f.chat}${f.thread === null ? '' : `/${f.thread}`}`;
    return { ok: true, lines: [`wake on for ${t.taskId}: its outcomes start a turn${at}, as ${as} (the owner)`], json };
  });
}

/** `mt kanban task comment <task> <text>`: an operator's comment, which steers the task's agent (spec §7.5). */
```

### Task 18: The agent-shell rules

**Files:**

- Create: `tests/mt-wake-shell.test.ts`
- Modify: `src/cli/gate.ts`, `src/cli/operator.ts`, `src/kanban/service.ts`

§3.2a and §9.1. `BoardAccess.shell` is the session `MT_AGENT_SESSION` names and the delivered wake of its running turn, `wakeOfShell` on the terminal's own database (none on a database not yet migrated). In such a shell every task `mt kanban task new`, `workflow start` and `workflow apply` make is made at the wake's depth + 1, or 0 with no woken turn, whether or not it asks for a wake. A wake (`--wake`, a step's or a DAG task's `wake: true`, `task wake on`) is refused with no woken turn; with one, it runs as the wake's principal, never the owner, and `--chat` and `--thread` must name the wake's own conversation; `task wake on` also needs the task in that conversation and deeper than the wake. A wake asked for past `max_depth` is made notice-only with the too-deep note as a second line of `task new`'s answer. With cron on, the operator's commands are refused before their arguments, as today, which the last test holds. A start's `StartWake.by` may be null, for members that keep a depth alone.

```ts
import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';

import { eventsOf, getTask } from '../src/db/kanban-read.js';

import { notePerson } from '../src/db/people.js';
import { createSession } from '../src/db/sessions.js';

import { listenWorker, workerSocketPath, type WorkerServer } from '../src/kanban/socket.js';
import { clearSecrets } from '../src/secrets.js';
import { SCHEMA_DIR } from './helpers/db.js';
import { NOW, newTask } from './helpers/kanban.js';
import { mtFixture, type MtFixture } from './helpers/mt.js';

/**
 * Setting a wake from an agent's shell (wake spec §3.2a, §9.1): in a shell with
 * `MT_AGENT_SESSION` and cron off, a wake is set only from a turn the board
 * woke, as its setter, in its own conversation, one level deeper; any other
 * agent shell makes tasks at depth 0, and sets no wake.
 */

let fx: MtFixture;
let db: Db;
let server: WorkerServer | undefined;
const SETTER = 'lark:on_kevin';
const OWNER = 'lark:on_owner';
const NONE = "a wake set from an agent's shell needs a turn the board woke, and session s_1 has none running";
const OWN = "a woken turn's tasks are followed by its own conversation: --chat oc_team --thread omt_topic";

afterEach(async () => {
  clearSecrets();
  await server?.close();
  server = undefined;
  db?.close();
  fx?.cleanup();
});

/**
 * A home with the board on and cron off; a task in thread omt_topic of oc_team,
 * and session s_1 bound to nothing in particular, its turn t_1 running. With
 * `woken`, that turn is a delivered wake of the task, by SETTER at depth 1.
 */
async function setup(woken: boolean): Promise<string> {
  clearSecrets();
  fx = mtFixture((ws) =>
    [`workspace: ${ws}`, 'lark:', '  appId: cli_app', 'kanban:', '  enabled: true', 'agent:', '  driver: structured-cli', '  command: bytesec', '  unsupervised: true', ''].join('\n'),
  );
  db = openDb(join(fx.home, 'team.db'));
  migrate(db, SCHEMA_DIR);
  notePerson(db, { appId: 'cli_app', unionId: 'on_owner', openId: 'ou_owner', name: 'Zhixi Sun' }, NOW);
  const via = { kind: 'chat' as const, channel: 'lark', appId: 'cli_app', conversationId: 'oc_team', threadId: 'omt_topic', rootId: 'om_root' };
  const task = newTask(db, { createdVia: via, wake: { by: SETTER, depth: 1 } });
  createSession(db, { id: 's_1', agentId: 'default', workspaceId: 'default', ownerPrincipal: SETTER }, NOW);
  createTurn(db, { sessionId: 's_1', turnId: 't_1', generation: 0, idempotencyKey: 'key-1' }, NOW);
  setTurnState(db, 's_1', 't_1', 'running');
  if (woken) {
    const event = eventsOf(db, task.taskId).at(-1);
    const sub = db.prepare<[string], { id: number }>('SELECT id FROM kanban_subscriptions WHERE task_id = ?').get(task.taskId);
    const r = recordWake(
      db,
      {
        uuid: 'u-1',
        channel: 'lark',
        appId: 'cli_app',
        conversationId: 'oc_team',
        threadId: 'omt_topic',
        principal: SETTER,
        depth: 1,
        events: [{ subscriptionId: sub?.id ?? 0, eventId: event?.id ?? 0, taskId: task.taskId }],
      },
      NOW,
    );
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.message);
    wakeSubmitted(db, r.wake.wakeId, 's_1', 'key-1', 'boot-1');
    advanceWake(db, r.wake.wakeId, NOW + 1);
  }
  mkdirSync(join(fx.home, 'workflows'));
  writeFileSync(
    join(fx.home, 'workflows', 'brief.yaml'),
    'steps:\n  a: { title: "Draft the brief", assignee: default }\n  b: { parents: [a], title: "Check the brief", assignee: default, wake: true }\n',
  );
  server = await listenWorker(workerSocketPath(fx.home), () => ({ ok: true }));
  return task.taskId;
}

describe('a woken turn\'s shell, cron off', () => {
  it('makes a task with --wake in its own conversation, as the wake\'s setter, one level deeper', async () => {
    await setup(true);
    const r = await shell(['task', 'new', 'Book the hall', '--chat', 'oc_team', '--thread', 'omt_topic', '--wake']);
    expect(r.code, r.err).toBe(0);
    expect(getTask(db, made(r.out))).toMatchObject({ wakeBy: SETTER, wakeDepth: 2 });
  });

  it('makes a task without a wake one level deeper too', async () => {
    await setup(true);
    expect(getTask(db, made((await shell(['task', 'new', 'Book the hall'])).out))).toMatchObject({ wakeBy: null, wakeDepth: 2 });
  });

  it('refuses --wake naming another chat, or another thread, and makes nothing', async () => {
    await setup(true);
    const before = count();
    for (const where of [['--chat', 'oc_other'], ['--chat', 'oc_team']]) {
      expect(await shell(['task', 'new', 'x', ...where, '--wake'])).toEqual({ code: 1, out: '', err: `mt: ${OWN}` });
    }
    expect(count()).toBe(before);
  });

  it('notes a task too deep, and makes it notice-only', async () => {
    const id = await setup(true);
    db.prepare('UPDATE kanban_wakes SET depth = 4').run();
    const r = await shell(['task', 'new', 'Book the hall', '--chat', 'oc_team', '--thread', 'omt_topic', '--wake']);
    expect(r.code, r.err).toBe(0);
    const made2 = made(r.out);
    expect(getTask(db, made2)).toMatchObject({ wakeBy: null, wakeDepth: 5 });
    expect(r.out.split('\n').at(-1)).toBe(`${made2} is 5 tasks deep in woken turns, so it stays notice-only`);
    expect(id).not.toBe(made2);
  });

  it('turns on the wake of a deeper task in its conversation as its setter, and refuses one not deeper, or elsewhere', async () => {
    const shallow = await setup(true);
    const deep = made((await shell(['task', 'new', 'Deeper', '--chat', 'oc_team', '--thread', 'omt_topic'])).out);
    expect((await shell(['task', 'wake', deep, 'on'])).code).toBe(0);
    expect(getTask(db, deep)?.wakeBy).toBe(SETTER);
    expect(await shell(['task', 'wake', shallow, 'on'])).toEqual({
      code: 1,
      out: '',
      err: `mt: \`${shallow}\` is not deeper than this woken turn (depth 1), so a woken turn cannot set its wake`,
    });
    const other = newTask(db, {
      createdVia: { kind: 'chat', channel: 'lark', appId: 'cli_app', conversationId: 'oc_other', threadId: '' },
      wake: { by: null, depth: 3 },
    });
    expect(await shell(['task', 'wake', other.taskId, 'on'])).toEqual({ code: 1, out: '', err: `mt: ${OWN}` });
  });

  it("starts a workflow with --wake in its own conversation as its setter, one level deeper", async () => {
    await setup(true);
    const r = await json(['workflow', 'start', 'brief', '--chat', 'oc_team', '--thread', 'omt_topic', '--wake']);
    expect((r['tasks'] as Array<{ task_id: string }>).map((t) => [getTask(db, t.task_id)?.wakeBy, getTask(db, t.task_id)?.wakeDepth])).toEqual([
      [SETTER, 2],
      [SETTER, 2],
    ]);
  });
});
```

```ts
 * The wake of what a terminal makes (wake spec §3.2, §3.2a, §3.4, §9.1). In an
 * agent's shell, every task is made one level deeper than the woken turn it
 * runs in, or at 0 in none, whether or not a wake is asked; a wake is set only
 * in a woken turn, as its setter, in its own conversation. Anywhere else it
 * runs as the owner. A wake asked for is refused while wakes are off, with no
 * `--chat`, and for an owner this bot has not seen, in that order.
 */
function terminalWake(board: BoardAccess, asked: boolean, flags: ChatFlags | undefined): { ok: true; wake?: { by: string | null; depth: number } } | Refused {
  const shell = board.shell;
  const depth = shell?.wake === undefined ? 0 : shell.wake.depth + 1;
  if (!asked) return depth === 0 ? { ok: true } : { ok: true, wake: { by: null, depth } };
  if (!board.wake.enabled) return refused({ code: 'wake_off', message: WAKES_OFF });
  if (flags === undefined) return refused({ code: 'invalid', message: 'a wake needs a chat that follows the task: add --chat' });
  if (shell !== undefined) {
    if (shell.wake === undefined) return notWoken(shell.sessionId);
    if (flags.chat !== shell.wake.conversationId || flags.thread !== shell.wake.threadId) return refused({ code: 'invalid', message: ownConversation(shell.wake) });
    return { ok: true, wake: { by: shell.wake.principal, depth } };
  }
  const owner = board.owner();
  return owner.ok ? { ok: true, wake: { by: owner.principal, depth } } : refused(owner);
}

 * asks.
 */
```

### Task 19: `task show`'s Wake line

**Files:**

- Create: `tests/wake-show.test.ts`
- Modify: `src/cli/gate.ts`, `src/cli/operator.ts`, `src/cli/plain.ts`, `src/db/kanban-read.ts`, `src/kanban/chat-render.ts`, `src/kanban/chat.ts`, `tests/kanban-chat-render.test.ts`, `tests/mt-kanban-operator-tasks.test.ts`, `tests/mt-plain.test.ts`

§10. `wakeLine(task, lastWoke, {enabled, zone, now}, setter)` in `src/kanban/chat-render.ts` says `Wake: off`, `Wake: on, set by …, depth N`, with `; last woke HH:MM` in the gateway's zone once the task has been woken (MM-DD HH:MM on another day), or `Wake: on, set by …, but wakes are off on this gateway`. `TaskView.lastWoke` is the task's latest delivered wake, `lastWokeOf`, read by `taskView` on a migrated database. `/kanban task show` puts the line after the board's line, the setter by chat name, from `KanbanChatDeps.wake` (the switch and the zone; absent, on, in the process's zone); `mt kanban task show` the same line by principal, in `cron.tz` else the shell's zone (`BoardAccess.zone`), and `--json`'s task gains `wake: {on, by, depth, last_woke}`. Every task now shows the line, so the three tests that pin `task show`'s lines gain `Wake: off`.

```ts
const ZONE = 'Asia/Shanghai';

const SAME_DAY = Date.UTC(2025, 9, 9, 9, 0);

  h = testDb();

/** A task set by ALICE at `depth`, woken once at WOKE when `woken`. */
function view(depth: number, woken: boolean): TaskView {
  const task = newTask(h.db, { wake: { by: ALICE, depth } });
  if (woken) {
    const sub = subscriptionsOf(h.db, task.taskId)[0];
    const event = eventsOf(h.db, task.taskId).at(-1);
    const r = recordWake(
      h.db,
      {
        uuid: `u-${task.taskId}`,
        channel: 'lark',
        appId: 'cli_app',
        conversationId: 'oc_chat',
        threadId: '',
        principal: ALICE,
        depth,
        events: [{ subscriptionId: sub?.id ?? 0, eventId: event?.id ?? 0, taskId: task.taskId }],
      },
      NOW,
    );
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.message);
    advanceWake(h.db, r.wake.wakeId, WOKE);
  }
  const v = taskView(h.db, task.taskId);
  if (v === undefined) throw new Error('no view');
  return v;
}

describe('wakeLine', () => {
  it('says on, by whom, at what depth, and when it last woke, in the zone', () => {
    const v = view(1, true);
    expect(v.lastWoke).toBe(WOKE);
    expect(wakeLine(v.task, v.lastWoke, { enabled: true, zone: ZONE, now: SAME_DAY }, 'Zhixi Sun')).toBe('Wake: on, set by Zhixi Sun, depth 1; last woke 14:02');
    expect(wakeLine(v.task, v.lastWoke, { enabled: true, zone: ZONE, now: NEXT_DAY }, 'Zhixi Sun')).toBe('Wake: on, set by Zhixi Sun, depth 1; last woke 10-09 14:02');
  });

  it('says on with no last wake before its first, off, and on but off on the gateway', () => {
    const v = view(0, false);
    expect(v.lastWoke).toBeUndefined();
    expect(wakeLine(v.task, v.lastWoke, { enabled: true, zone: ZONE, now: SAME_DAY }, 'Zhixi Sun')).toBe('Wake: on, set by Zhixi Sun, depth 0');
    expect(wakeLine(v.task, v.lastWoke, { enabled: false, zone: ZONE, now: SAME_DAY }, 'Zhixi Sun')).toBe(
      'Wake: on, set by Zhixi Sun, but wakes are off on this gateway',
    );
    setWake(h.db, v.task.taskId, { on: false }, ALICE, 'cli_app', NOW);
    const off = taskView(h.db, v.task.taskId);
    expect(off === undefined ? '' : wakeLine(off.task, off.lastWoke, { enabled: true, zone: ZONE, now: SAME_DAY }, '')).toBe('Wake: off');
  });
});
```

```ts
/** What a Wake line needs of the gateway (wake spec §10): its switch, its zone, and now, for the day. */
export interface WakeShow {
  enabled: boolean;
  /** `cron.tz`, else the process's. */
  zone: string;
  now: number;
}

/** A Wake line when the caller says nothing of the gateway: wakes on, in the process's zone, now. */
export function defaultWakeShow(): WakeShow {
  return { enabled: true, zone: processZone(), now: Date.now() };
}

/**
 * `task show`'s Wake line (wake spec §10), chat's and the terminal's in the same
 * words, the setter named as the caller names people: off; on, by whom and at
 * what depth, with the time of the task's last delivered wake, HH:MM in the
 * zone, MM-DD HH:MM on another day; or on, but wakes off on the gateway.
 */
export function wakeLine(task: TaskRow, lastWoke: number | undefined, show: WakeShow, setter: string): string {
  if (task.wakeBy === null) return 'Wake: off';
  if (!show.enabled) return `Wake: on, set by ${setter}, but wakes are off on this gateway`;
  const head = `Wake: on, set by ${setter}, depth ${task.wakeDepth}`;
  if (lastWoke === undefined) return head;
  const at = formatWall(show.zone, lastWoke);
  const day = at.slice(0, 10) === formatWall(show.zone, show.now).slice(0, 10);
  return `${head}; last woke ${day ? at.slice(11) : at.slice(5)}`;
}
```

### Task 20: The session layer's origin, onTurn and onPrompted

**Files:**

- Create: `tests/wake-session.test.ts`
- Modify: `src/core/session-actor.ts`

§6.1. `SubmitRequest` gains three optional fields and nothing else of the actor changes. `onTurn` is called once in `#runTurn`, just after `createTurn`, with its `created`, so a duplicate submit (an earlier one with the same key made the turn) is told apart from a refusal, which a read of the turns table cannot do, as a failed start also leaves a turn with the key. `onPrompted` is called once, just after the turn is set `running` and `promptSent` is set, before the first event is read: never on a failed start, never on a duplicate. A throw from either is noted and never fails the turn. `origin` is written into the `turn_submitted` payload as `wake: {id, by, name}`, the name masked, made one line and cut at 80; the event's actor stays `user`. A typed turn passes none of them, so its record is as before.

- [ ] **Step 20.1: Write the tests.**

Create `tests/wake-session.test.ts`:

```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { SessionActor, type SubmitRequest } from '../src/core/session-actor.js';
import { createSession } from '../src/db/sessions.js';
import { bindSession } from '../src/db/bindings.js';
import { lastSeq, readEvents } from '../src/db/events.js';
import { MASK, addSecrets, clearSecrets } from '../src/secrets.js';
import type { BindingKey, Event } from '../src/types.js';
import { FakeChannel } from './helpers/channel.js';
import { FakeDriver } from './helpers/driver.js';
import { ManualClock, testDb, type TestDb } from './helpers/db.js';

/**
 * What the session layer gains for a turn the board woke (wake spec §6.1): a
 * submit's `origin`, written into its `turn_submitted`, and two callbacks, so the
 * waker can tell a prompt that reached the agent from a start that failed, and a
 * duplicate from a refusal, without a read of the turns table.
 */

const NOW = 1_760_000_000_000;
const KEY: BindingKey = { channel: 'lark', appId: 'cli_app', conversationId: 'oc_chat', threadId: 'omt_1' };

const open: TestDb[] = [];
afterEach(() => {
  while (open.length > 0) open.pop()?.close();
  clearSecrets();
});

function harness() {
  const db = testDb();
  open.push(db);
  const clock = new ManualClock(NOW);
  const driver = new FakeDriver();
  const notes: string[] = [];
  createSession(db.db, { id: 's_1', agentId: 'fake', workspaceId: 'plain-dir:x', ownerPrincipal: 'on_owner' }, NOW);
  bindSession(db.db, KEY, 's_1', NOW);
  const actor = new SessionActor({
    db: db.db,
    sessionId: 's_1',
    driver,
    channel: new FakeChannel({ clock }),
    key: KEY,
    target: { chatId: KEY.conversationId, threadId: KEY.threadId },
    cwd: '/tmp/workspace',
    clock,
    note: (line) => notes.push(line),
  });
  const events = (): readonly Event[] => readEvents(db.db, 's_1', 0, lastSeq(db.db, 's_1'));
  return { db, actor, driver, notes, events };
}

function woken(extra: Partial<SubmitRequest> = {}): SubmitRequest {
  return { messageId: 'wake:abc', appId: KEY.appId, input: { text: 'Board update: …', paths: [] }, ...extra };
}

describe('onTurn', () => {
  it('is called once, with created true, before the prompt reaches the agent', async () => {
    const h = harness();
    const calls: string[] = [];
    h.driver.scripts = [
      (ctl) => {
        calls.push('agent');
        ctl.end('completed');
      },
    ];
    const terminal = await h.actor.submit(
      woken({ onTurn: (t) => calls.push(`turn ${String(t.created)}`), onPrompted: () => calls.push('prompted') }),
    );
    expect(terminal).toBe('completed');
    expect(calls).toEqual(['turn true', 'prompted', 'agent']);
  });

  it('says created false for a submit whose key already made its turn, and never prompts for it', async () => {
    const h = harness();
    await h.actor.submit(woken());
    const calls: string[] = [];
    await h.actor.submit(woken({ onTurn: (t) => calls.push(`turn ${String(t.created)}`), onPrompted: () => calls.push('prompted') }));
    expect(calls).toEqual(['turn false']);
    expect(h.driver.lastRuntime?.prompts).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('notes a throw from it and runs the turn all the same', async () => {
    const h = harness();
    const terminal = await h.actor.submit(
      woken({
        onTurn: () => {
          throw new Error('boom');
        },
      }),
    );
    expect(terminal).toBe('completed');
    expect(h.notes.some((n) => n.includes('onTurn') && n.includes('boom'))).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe('onPrompted', () => {
  it('is not called when the agent fails to start', async () => {
    const h = harness();
    h.driver.failStartWith = new Error('spawn ENOENT');
    let prompted = 0;
    let created: boolean | undefined;
    const terminal = await h.actor.submit(woken({ onTurn: (t) => (created = t.created), onPrompted: () => (prompted += 1) }));
    expect(terminal).toBe('failed');
    expect(created).toBe(true);
    expect(prompted).toBe(0);
  });

  it('is called once for a turn that fails after the agent started', async () => {
    const h = harness();
    h.driver.scripts = [
      (ctl) => {
        ctl.emit({ kind: 'error', message: 'model overloaded', retryable: true });
        ctl.end('failed');
      },
    ];
    let prompted = 0;
    expect(await h.actor.submit(woken({ onPrompted: () => (prompted += 1) }))).toBe('failed');
    expect(prompted).toBe(1);
  });

  it('notes a throw from it and never fails the turn', async () => {
    const h = harness();
    const terminal = await h.actor.submit(
      woken({
        onPrompted: () => {
          throw new Error('kaput');
        },
      }),
    );
    expect(terminal).toBe('completed');
    expect(h.notes.some((n) => n.includes('onPrompted') && n.includes('kaput'))).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe('origin', () => {
  it('is written into turn_submitted as wake, beside the text, the paths and the message id', async () => {
    const h = harness();
    await h.actor.submit(woken({ origin: { wake: { id: 7, by: 'lark:on_zhixi', name: 'Zhixi Sun' } } }));
    const submitted = h.events().find((e) => e.type === 'turn_submitted');
    expect(submitted?.actor).toBe('user');
    expect(submitted?.payload).toEqual({
      text: 'Board update: …',
      paths: [],
      messageId: 'wake:abc',
      wake: { id: 7, by: 'lark:on_zhixi', name: 'Zhixi Sun' },
    });
  });

  it('writes the name masked, on one line, cut at 80', async () => {
    addSecrets(['sk-secret-9876']);
    const h = harness();
    const long = `Zhixi\nSun sk-secret-9876 ${'x'.repeat(200)}`;
    await h.actor.submit(woken({ origin: { wake: { id: 7, by: 'lark:on_zhixi', name: long } } }));
    const payload = h.events().find((e) => e.type === 'turn_submitted')?.payload as { wake: { name: string } };
    expect(payload.wake.name.startsWith(`Zhixi Sun ${MASK} x`)).toBe(true);
    expect(payload.wake.name).not.toContain('\n');
    expect([...payload.wake.name].length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(80);
  });

  it('is absent from a typed turn', async () => {
    const h = harness();
    await h.actor.submit({ messageId: 'om_1', appId: KEY.appId, input: { text: 'hi', paths: [] } });
    const payload = h.events().find((e) => e.type === 'turn_submitted')?.payload as Record<string, unknown>;
    expect(payload['wake']).toBeUndefined();
  });
});
```

```ts
/** How long a woken turn's setter's name may be in its `turn_submitted`: a name's cut in chat (kanban spec §9.3). */
const WAKE_NAME_MAX = 80;

/** A woken turn's setter's name as recorded (wake spec §6.1): masked, on one line, cut at 80. */
function wakeName(name: string): string {
  const line = redactKnownSecrets(name).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  const chars = [...line];
  return chars.length <= WAKE_NAME_MAX ? line : `${chars.slice(0, WAKE_NAME_MAX - 1).join('')}…`;
```

```ts
  /** A submitter's callback (wake spec §6.1): a throw from it is noted, and never fails the turn. */
  #callback(name: string, fn: () => void): void {
```

### Task 21: A woken turn's card line

**Files:**

- Create: `tests/wake-card.test.ts`
- Modify: `src/channel/render.ts`

§6.2. `renderCard` reads the `wake` that Task 20 writes into a `turn_submitted`, and for that turn keeps the line `_(woken by the board, as Zhixi Sun)_` first on the card, the name escaped as a label and masked. It goes at the head of the tool line's part, which only the tool line rewrites, so the answer below it still only grows at its end (channel spec §4.5), and the placeholder still shows when there is nothing else. Everything resets at the next `turn_submitted`, as the card's other state does, so a typed turn's card is unchanged.

```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { renderCard } from '../src/channel/render.js';
import { MASK, addSecrets, clearSecrets } from '../src/secrets.js';
import type { Event, EventType } from '../src/types.js';

/**
 * A woken turn's card (wake spec §6.2): its first line says the board woke it,
 * and as whom, escaped as a label, above the answer as it streams. A typed turn's
 * card is unchanged.
 */

let seq = 0;
function ev(type: EventType, payload: unknown): Event {
  seq += 1;
  return { sessionId: 's_test', seq, ts: 1_760_000_000_000 + seq, generation: 0, brokerSeq: null, turnId: 't_1', type, actor: 'agent', payload };
}

const WOKEN = { text: 'Board update: …', paths: [], messageId: 'wake:abc', wake: { id: 7, by: 'lark:on_zhixi', name: 'Zhixi Sun' } };

afterEach(() => clearSecrets());

describe('renderCard: a woken turn', () => {
  it('starts with the line that says the board woke it, as whom', () => {
    const view = renderCard([ev('turn_submitted', WOKEN), ev('agent_message_chunk', { text: 'On it.' })]);
    expect(view.text.split('\n')[0]).toBe('_(woken by the board, as Zhixi Sun)_');
    expect(view.parts.tools).toBe('_(woken by the board, as Zhixi Sun)_');
    expect(view.parts.answer).toBe('On it.');
  });

  it('keeps the line above the tool line and the placeholder', () => {
    const open = renderCard([ev('turn_submitted', WOKEN)]);
    expect(open.parts).toEqual({ tools: '_(woken by the board, as Zhixi Sun)_', answer: '', status: '_Working…_' });
    const tools = renderCard([ev('turn_submitted', WOKEN), ev('tool_call', { toolCallId: 'c1', title: 'Bash', status: 'completed' })]);
    expect(tools.parts.tools).toBe('_(woken by the board, as Zhixi Sun)_\n\n✅ Bash');
  });

  it('escapes the name as a label, and masks it', () => {
    addSecrets(['sk-secret-9876']);
    const view = renderCard([ev('turn_submitted', { ...WOKEN, wake: { ...WOKEN.wake, name: 'A_*b* sk-secret-9876' } })]);
    expect(view.parts.tools).toBe(`_(woken by the board, as A\\_\\*b\\* ${MASK})_`);
  });

  it('is gone at the next, typed, turn', () => {
    const view = renderCard([
      ev('turn_submitted', WOKEN),
      ev('turn_ended', { terminal: 'completed' }),
      ev('turn_submitted', { text: 'hi', paths: [], messageId: 'om_1' }),
    ]);
    expect(view.parts.tools).toBe('');
  });

  it('leaves a typed turn without it', () => {
    const view = renderCard([ev('turn_submitted', { text: 'hi', paths: [], messageId: 'om_1' }), ev('agent_message_chunk', { text: 'yes' })]);
    expect(view.text).toBe('yes');
  });
});
```

```ts
/** The setter's name a woken turn's `turn_submitted` records (wake spec §6.1), if it is one. */
function wokenName(wake: unknown): string | undefined {
```
