```ts
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { showJson, wokenShowText } from '../src/cli/plain.js';
import { turnIdempotencyKey } from '../src/core/ids.js';
import { bindSession } from '../src/db/bindings.js';
import { advanceWake, recordWake, wakeSubmitted } from '../src/db/kanban.js';
import { eventsOf, getTask } from '../src/db/kanban-read.js';
import { createSession } from '../src/db/sessions.js';
import { createTurn, endTurn, setTurnState } from '../src/db/turns.js';
import { CronTokens } from '../src/cron/tokens.js';
import { KanbanService } from '../src/kanban/service.js';
import { SocketHandler } from '../src/kanban/socket.js';
import { NOT_WOKEN, WakeApi } from '../src/kanban/wake-api.js';
import { WakeTokens } from '../src/kanban/wake-tokens.js';
import type { TaskRow, WakeRow } from '../src/kanban/types.js';
import { clearSecrets } from '../src/secrets.js';
import type { BindingKey } from '../src/types.js';
import { FakeChannel } from './helpers/channel.js';
import { ManualClock, testDb, type TestDb } from './helpers/db.js';
import { DEFAULT_ROLES } from './helpers/dispatch.js';
import { NOW, WORKSPACES, newTask } from './helpers/kanban.js';

/**
 * The socket's `wake` envelope (wake spec §9.2): a woken turn's show and unblock,
 * judged by the token's session and that session's running turn's delivered
 * wake, refused in §9.2's order.
 */

const ZHIXI = 'lark:on_zhixi';
const KEY: BindingKey = { channel: 'lark', appId: 'cli_app', conversationId: 'oc_chat', threadId: 'omt_1' };
let h: TestDb;
let service: KanbanService;
let tokens: WakeTokens;
let lark: FakeChannel;
let operate: Set<string>;
let nudges: number;
let handler: SocketHandler;
let turnN = 0;

beforeEach(() => {
  clearSecrets();
  h = testDb();
  service = new KanbanService({ db: h.db, roles: new Map(DEFAULT_ROLES.map((r) => [r.name, r])), workspaces: WORKSPACES, clock: new ManualClock(NOW + 10), wake: { enabled: true, maxDepth: 5 } });
  tokens = new WakeTokens({ db: h.db });
  lark = new FakeChannel();
  operate = new Set([ZHIXI]);
  nudges = 0;
  createSession(h.db, { id: 's_chat', agentId: 'default', workspaceId: 'default', ownerPrincipal: 'on_zhixi' }, NOW);
  bindSession(h.db, KEY, 's_chat', NOW);
  const api = new WakeApi({
    db: h.db,
    service,
    tokens,
    people: { canTalk: (p) => p === ZHIXI, canOperate: (p) => operate.has(p), chatNames: () => (p) => (p === ZHIXI ? 'Zhixi Sun' : undefined) },
    blockRecurrenceLimit: 3,
    render: { lines: wokenShowText, json: showJson },
    channels: new Map([['lark', lark]]),
    appId: 'cli_app',
    zone: 'Asia/Shanghai',
    nudge: () => {
      nudges += 1;
    },
  });
  handler = new SocketHandler({ board: () => ({ ok: true, board: true }), wake: (r) => api.handle(r), nudged: () => undefined });
});
afterEach(() => {
  clearSecrets();
  h.close();
});

function event(task: TaskRow, kind: string, actor: string, payload: Record<string, unknown>): number {
  h.db.prepare('INSERT INTO kanban_events (task_id, kind, actor, payload, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, jsonb(?), ?)').run(task.taskId, kind, actor, JSON.stringify(payload), NOW);
  return eventsOf(h.db, task.taskId).at(-1)?.id ?? 0;
}

/** A task with wake on, set by Zhixi, as every task a wake carries has. */
function wakeTask(t: Parameters<typeof newTask>[1] = {}): TaskRow {
  return newTask(h.db, { wake: { by: ZHIXI, depth: 0 }, ...t });
}

function blocked(task: TaskRow): number {
  h.db.prepare("UPDATE kanban_tasks SET phase = 'blocked', blocked_from = 'open', block_kind = 'needs_input' WHERE task_id = ?").run(task.taskId);
  return event(task, 'blocked', 'run:r_1', { kind: 'needs_input', reason: 'which?', blockRecurrences: 1 });
}

/** A turn running in s_chat, woken by a delivered wake of these events when `woken`. */
function running(
  events: ReadonlyArray<{ task: TaskRow; eventId: number }>,
  woken = true,
  opts: { session?: string; settled?: boolean } = {},
): { turnId: string; wake?: WakeRow } {
  turnN += 1;
  const turnId = `t_${turnN}`;
  const session = opts.session ?? 's_chat';
  const key = turnIdempotencyKey('cli_app', `wake:u${turnN}`);
  createTurn(h.db, { sessionId: session, turnId, generation: 0, idempotencyKey: key }, NOW);
  setTurnState(h.db, session, turnId, 'running');
  if (!woken) return { turnId };
  const r = recordWake(
    h.db,
    { uuid: `u${turnN}`, channel: 'lark', appId: 'cli_app', conversationId: 'oc_chat', threadId: 'omt_1', principal: ZHIXI, depth: 0, events: events.map((e) => ({ subscriptionId: 1, eventId: e.eventId, taskId: e.task.taskId })) },
    NOW,
  );
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.message);
  wakeSubmitted(h.db, r.wake.wakeId, session, key, 'boot_a');
  if (opts.settled !== false) advanceWake(h.db, r.wake.wakeId, NOW + 1);
  return { turnId, wake: r.wake };
}

function token(): string {
  return tokens.envFor('s_chat', KEY)?.['MT_WAKE_TOKEN'] ?? '';
}

describe('the wake envelope: unblock', () => {
  it("lifts the turn's own block, answers the operator's words and nudges the dispatcher", async () => {
    const task = wakeTask();
    const block = blocked(task);
    const t = token();
    const { wake } = running([{ task, eventId: block }]);
    const r = await handler.handle({ wake: 'unblock', token: t, input: { task_id: task.taskId, comment: 'the second one' } });
    expect(r).toEqual({ ok: true, task_id: task.taskId, phase: 'open', message: `\`${task.taskId}\` is unblocked, back to open, as Zhixi Sun (woken by the board)` });
    expect(nudges).toBe(1);
    expect(eventsOf(h.db, task.taskId).find((e) => e.kind === 'unblocked')).toMatchObject({ actor: ZHIXI, payload: { wake: wake?.wakeId } });
  });

  it('refuses in order: no token, one never held, a cron token, a stale one, a turn not woken', async () => {
    const task = wakeTask();
    const block = blocked(task);
    const input = { task_id: task.taskId };
    expect(await handler.handle({ wake: 'unblock', input })).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: 'unauthorized' });
    expect(await handler.handle({ wake: 'unblock', token: 'A'.repeat(43), input })).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: 'unauthorized' });
    const cron = new CronTokens({ db: h.db }).envFor('s_chat', KEY)?.['MT_CRON_TOKEN'] ?? '';
    expect(await handler.handle({ wake: 'unblock', token: cron, input })).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: 'unauthorized' });
    // Between turns: the token is stale.
    const t = token();
    expect(await handler.handle({ wake: 'unblock', token: t, input })).toEqual({ ok: false, code: 'not_woken', message: NOT_WOKEN });
    // A turn a person typed: the token works, but no wake delivered it.
    const typed = running([], false);
    expect(await handler.handle({ wake: 'unblock', token: t, input })).toEqual({ ok: false, code: 'not_woken', message: NOT_WOKEN });
    endTurn(h.db, 's_chat', typed.turnId, 'completed', NOW);
    // Its predecessor after a rebuild is stale.
    running([{ task, eventId: block }]);
    const next = token();
    expect(await handler.handle({ wake: 'unblock', token: t, input })).toMatchObject({ code: 'not_woken' });
    expect(await handler.handle({ wake: 'unblock', token: next, input })).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
  });

  it("passes the service's refusals through, and says the woken-unblock limit's line once in the thread", async () => {
    const task = wakeTask();
    const other = wakeTask();
    blocked(other);
    let t = token();
    let turn = running([{ task, eventId: blocked(task) }]);
    expect(await handler.handle({ wake: 'unblock', token: t, input: { task_id: other.taskId } })).toMatchObject({ code: 'not_this_wake' });
    operate.delete(ZHIXI);
    expect(await handler.handle({ wake: 'unblock', token: t, input: { task_id: task.taskId } })).toMatchObject({ code: 'needs_operator' });
    operate.add(ZHIXI);
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i += 1) {
      expect(await handler.handle({ wake: 'unblock', token: t, input: { task_id: task.taskId } })).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
      endTurn(h.db, 's_chat', turn.turnId, 'completed', NOW);
      t = token();
      turn = running([{ task, eventId: blocked(task) }]);
    }
    const sixth = await handler.handle({ wake: 'unblock', token: t, input: { task_id: task.taskId } });
    expect(sixth).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: 'woken_unblock_limit' });
    await handler.handle({ wake: 'unblock', token: t, input: { task_id: task.taskId } });
    await new Promise((r) => setImmediate(r));
    expect(lark.texts.map((x) => x.text)).toEqual([
      `\`${task.taskId}\` has been unblocked by woken turns 5 times since it last completed: a person decides whether it is unblocked again`,
    ]);
    expect(lark.texts[0]?.target).toMatchObject({ chatId: 'oc_chat', threadId: 'omt_1' });
    expect(getTask(h.db, task.taskId)?.phase).toBe('blocked');
  });
});
```

Create `src/kanban/wake-api.ts`:

```ts
import type { Channel } from '../channel/types.js';
import { replyUuid } from '../core/ids.js';
import { wakeOfShell, type ThreadAt } from '../db/kanban-read.js';
import type { Db } from '../db/open.js';
import { processZone } from '../cron/schedule.js';
import { redactKnownSecrets } from '../secrets.js';
import { systemClock, type Clock } from '../time.js';
import { NOTICE_SEND_MS } from './notices.js';
import type { KanbanService, WakeJudge } from './service.js';
import type { WakeLookup } from './wake-tokens.js';
import { targetOf } from './waker.js';
import type { GateRow, Refusal, WakeRow } from './types.js';
import type { NameOf, WakeShow } from './chat-render.js';
import type { TaskView } from '../db/kanban-read.js';

/**
 * The socket's `wake` envelope (wake spec §9.2): a woken turn's `mt kanban task
 * show` and `task unblock`, `{wake: 'show' | 'unblock', token, input}`, the
 * session the token's, never named by the request.
 *
 * Checked in §9.2's order: the board and wakes on, which the socket's handler
 * answers before this one is asked; the token, `unauthorized` for none or one
 * `WakeTokens` never held, a board run's, a chat turn's cron token and a fire's
 * among them; `not_woken` for a stale token, or a session whose running turn the
 * board did not wake (`wakeOfShell`), so the shell, with cron off, falls back to
 * the operator's command; then the service's checks of the task against that
 * wake (`showForWake`, `unblockForWake`).
 *
 * The show answers the operator's output, plain and `--json`, the plain people
 * named as the thread names them and quoted under its framing line; the shell
 * prints the one it was asked for. The unblock answers the operator's words and
 * nudges the dispatcher; its `woken_unblock_limit` refusal is also said once in
 * the wake's conversation, until the task next completes.
 */

export const NOT_WOKEN = 'this turn was not woken by the board';

export interface WakeApiDeps {
  db: Db;
  service: KanbanService;
  tokens: { lookup(token: string): WakeLookup | undefined };
  people: {
    canTalk(principal: string): boolean;
    canOperate(principal: string): boolean;
    chatNames(): (principal: string) => string | undefined;
  };
  blockRecurrenceLimit: number;
  /**
   * The operator's `mt kanban task show`, rendered: its plain lines quoted under
   * the framing line with people by `nameOf`, and its `--json`. Given by the
   * gateway from `src/cli/plain.ts` (`wokenShowText`, `showJson`), as no module of
   * the board imports the terminal's.
   */
  render: {
    lines(view: TaskView, gates: readonly GateRow[], wake: WakeShow, nameOf: NameOf): string[];
    json(view: TaskView, gates: readonly GateRow[]): unknown;
  };
  /** Where the woken-unblock limit's line goes: `lark` to the Lark adapter. */
  channels: ReadonlyMap<string, Channel>;
  appId: string;
  /** The gateway's zone, for the show's Wake line: `cron.tz`, else the process's. */
  zone?: string;
  /** A dispatcher pass, after an unblock. */
  nudge?: () => void;
  clock?: Clock;
  /** Ids and counts, never task text. */
  note?: (line: string) => void;
  sendTimeoutMs?: number;
}

function refusal(r: Refusal): Record<string, unknown> {
  return { ok: false, code: r.code, message: r.message };
}

function text(v: unknown): string | undefined {
  return typeof v === 'string' ? v : undefined;
}

export class WakeApi {
  readonly #deps: WakeApiDeps;
  readonly #clock: Clock;
  /** The tasks the limit's line was said for, with the completion it was said after. */
  readonly #limitSaid = new Map<string, number>();

  constructor(deps: WakeApiDeps) {
    this.#deps = deps;
    this.#clock = deps.clock ?? systemClock;
  }

  /** One request of the envelope. Never throws: a failure is an answer. */
  handle(request: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {
    const verb = request['wake'];
    if (verb !== 'show' && verb !== 'unblock') {
      return { ok: false, code: 'bad_request', message: 'a wake request is show or unblock' };
    }
    const token = text(request['token']);
    const found = token === undefined ? undefined : this.#deps.tokens.lookup(token);
    if (found === undefined) return { ok: false, code: 'unauthorized', message: 'the wake token is not one this gateway holds' };
    if ('stale' in found) return { ok: false, code: 'not_woken', message: NOT_WOKEN };
    const wake = wakeOfShell(this.#deps.db, found.works.sessionId);
    if (wake === undefined) return { ok: false, code: 'not_woken', message: NOT_WOKEN };
    const input = request['input'];
    const fields = typeof input === 'object' && input !== null && !Array.isArray(input) ? (input as Record<string, unknown>) : {};
    const taskId = text(fields['task_id']) ?? '';
    return verb === 'show' ? this.#show(wake, taskId) : this.#unblock(wake, taskId, text(fields['comment']));
  }

  #judge(): WakeJudge {
    const { people } = this.#deps;
    const names = people.chatNames();
    return {
      canTalk: (p) => people.canTalk(p),
      canOperate: (p) => people.canOperate(p),
      nameOf: names,
      blockRecurrenceLimit: this.#deps.blockRecurrenceLimit,
    };
  }

  #show(wake: WakeRow, taskId: string): Record<string, unknown> {
    const judge = this.#judge();
    const r = this.#deps.service.showForWake(wake, taskId, judge);
    if (!r.ok) return refusal(r);
    const show = { enabled: true, zone: this.#deps.zone ?? processZone(), now: this.#clock.now() };
    const { render } = this.#deps;
    return { ok: true, lines: render.lines(r.view, r.gates, show, judge.nameOf), json: render.json(r.view, r.gates) };
  }

  #unblock(wake: WakeRow, taskId: string, comment: string | undefined): Record<string, unknown> {
    const r = this.#deps.service.unblockForWake(wake, taskId, comment, this.#judge());
    if (!r.ok) {
      if (r.code === 'woken_unblock_limit') this.#sayLimit(wake, taskId, r.message);
      return refusal(r);
    }
    try {
      this.#deps.nudge?.();
    } catch {
      // The dispatcher's own timer looks again.
    }
    return {
      ok: true,
      task_id: r.task.taskId,
      phase: r.task.phase,
      message: `\`${r.task.taskId}\` is unblocked, back to ${r.task.phase}, as ${r.setter} (woken by the board)`,
    };
  }

  /**
   * The woken-unblock limit's line, in the wake's conversation (§9.2): once a
   * task until it next completes, kept in memory, sent with the notifier's bound,
   * masked, never retried.
   */
  #sayLimit(wake: WakeRow, taskId: string, line: string): void {
    const completed =
      this.#deps.db
        .prepare<[string], { id: number | null }>("SELECT max(id) AS id FROM kanban_events WHERE task_id = ? AND kind = 'completed'")
        .get(taskId)?.id ?? 0;
    if (this.#limitSaid.get(taskId) === completed) return;
    this.#limitSaid.set(taskId, completed);
    const channel = this.#deps.channels.get(wake.channel);
    const note = this.#deps.note ?? (() => undefined);
    if (channel === undefined) {
      note(`kanban: the woken-unblock limit's line for ${taskId} was not sent: no channel ${wake.channel}`);
      return;
    }
    const at: ThreadAt = { channel: wake.channel, appId: wake.appId, conversationId: wake.conversationId, threadId: wake.threadId };
    const ms = this.#deps.sendTimeoutMs ?? NOTICE_SEND_MS;
    let timer: NodeJS.Timeout | undefined;
    const late = new Promise<never>((_resolve, reject) => {
      timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('the send took too long')), ms);
    });
    const send = channel.sendText(targetOf(this.#deps.db, at), redactKnownSecrets(line), replyUuid(this.#deps.appId, `wake-limit:${taskId}`, String(completed)));
    send.catch(() => undefined);
    void Promise.race([send, late])
      .catch((err: unknown) => {
        note(`kanban: the woken-unblock limit's line for ${taskId} was not sent (${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)})`);
      })
      .finally(() => clearTimeout(timer));
  }
}
```

### Task 34: The shell asks the gateway first

**Files:**

- Create: `src/cli/wake.ts`, `tests/mt-wake-ask.test.ts`
- Modify: `src/cli/mt.ts`, `tests/gateway-env.test.ts`

§9.2's "How the shell asks". In a shell with `MT_WAKE_TOKEN` set and no board run's variables, `mt kanban task unblock <task> [comment...]` and `mt kanban task show <task> [--board <name>] [--json]` send `{wake, token, input}` to `MT_KANBAN_SOCKET` before any refusal (`src/cli/wake.ts`, called from `mt.ts`'s `kanban`). The gateway's answer is printed as the operator's would be: the unblock's words or its `--json`, the show's quoted lines or its `--json`, `--board` of another board refused `other_board` in the operator's words, and a refusal as `mt: <message>` with no fallback. On `not_woken` the command goes on as before wakes: with cron on, today's refusal; with cron off, the operator's command. A socket that cannot be reached, or that gives no answer within 30 s, is refused `unreachable` in both cron modes. Every other shell, a board run's among them, is unchanged. `tests/gateway-env.test.ts`, which holds that every `MT_` name read in `src/` is a gateway setting but for an agent's own `MT_KANBAN_*` and `MT_CRON_*`, now also leaves out `MT_WAKE_*`, the wake token being an agent's own.

```ts
import { createServer, type Server } from 'node:net';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { getTask } from '../src/db/kanban-read.js';
import { migrate, openDb, type Db } from '../src/db/open.js';
import { clearSecrets } from '../src/secrets.js';
import { SCHEMA_DIR } from './helpers/db.js';
import { newTask } from './helpers/kanban.js';
import { mtFixture, type MtFixture } from './helpers/mt.js';

/**
 * A woken turn's shell (wake spec §9.2): with `MT_WAKE_TOKEN` and no board run's
 * variables, `mt kanban task unblock` and `task show` ask the gateway first. Its
 * answer is printed as the operator's would be; `not_woken` goes on as before
 * wakes, today's refusal with cron on and the operator's command with cron off;
 * a refusal, or a gateway that cannot be reached, has no fallback.
 */

const TOKEN = 'T'.repeat(43);
let fx: MtFixture;
let db: Db;
let server: Server | undefined;
let asked: unknown[];

afterEach(async () => {
  clearSecrets();
  await new Promise<void>((resolve) => (server === undefined ? resolve() : server.close(() => resolve())));
  server = undefined;
  db?.close();
  fx?.cleanup();
});

/** A home with the board on and a blocked task; a gateway at the socket that answers `answer` to every request. */
async function setup(answer: unknown): Promise<{ taskId: string; socket: string }> {
  fx = mtFixture((ws) =>
    [`workspace: ${ws}`, 'lark:', '  appId: cli_app', 'kanban:', '  enabled: true', 'agent:', '  driver: structured-cli', '  command: bytesec', '  unsupervised: true', ''].join('\n'),
  );
  db = openDb(join(fx.home, 'team.db'));
  migrate(db, SCHEMA_DIR);
  const task = newTask(db);
  db.prepare("UPDATE kanban_tasks SET phase = 'blocked', blocked_from = 'open', block_kind = 'needs_input' WHERE task_id = ?").run(task.taskId);
  asked = [];
  const socket = join(fx.root, 'k.sock');
  server = createServer((conn) => {
    let got = '';
    conn.setEncoding('utf8');
    conn.on('data', (d: string) => {
      got += d;
      if (!got.includes('\n')) return;
      asked.push(JSON.parse(got.trim()));
      conn.end(`${JSON.stringify(answer)}\n`);
    });
  });
  await new Promise<void>((resolve) => server?.listen(socket, resolve));
  return { taskId: task.taskId, socket };
}

const cronOn = (socket: string): Record<string, string> => ({ MT_WAKE_TOKEN: TOKEN, MT_KANBAN_SOCKET: socket, MT_CRON_TOKEN: 'c'.repeat(43), MT_AGENT_SESSION: 's_1' });
const cronOff = (socket: string): Record<string, string> => ({ MT_WAKE_TOKEN: TOKEN, MT_KANBAN_SOCKET: socket, MT_AGENT_SESSION: 's_1' });

describe('mt kanban task unblock in a woken shell', () => {
  it('asks the gateway first, with the token and the comment, and prints its answer', async () => {
    const { taskId, socket } = await setup({ ok: true, task_id: 'k_x', phase: 'open', message: '`k_x` is unblocked, back to open, as Zhixi Sun (woken by the board)' });
    const r = await fx.run(['kanban', 'task', 'unblock', taskId, 'the', 'second', 'one'], { env: cronOn(socket) });
    expect(r).toMatchObject({ code: 0, out: '`k_x` is unblocked, back to open, as Zhixi Sun (woken by the board)' });
    expect(asked).toEqual([{ wake: 'unblock', token: TOKEN, input: { task_id: taskId, comment: 'the second one' } }]);
    const json = await fx.run(['kanban', 'task', 'unblock', taskId, '--json'], { env: cronOff(socket) });
    expect(JSON.parse(json.out)).toEqual({ ok: true, task_id: 'k_x', phase: 'open' });
    expect(asked[1]).toEqual({ wake: 'unblock', token: TOKEN, input: { task_id: taskId } });
  });

  it("prints a refusal and does not fall back to the operator's command", async () => {
    const { taskId, socket } = await setup({ ok: false, code: 'not_this_wake', message: '`k_x` did not wake this turn: a woken turn unblocks only the tasks whose blocks woke it' });
    const r = await fx.run(['kanban', 'task', 'unblock', taskId], { env: cronOff(socket) });
    expect(r).toMatchObject({ code: 1, err: 'mt: `k_x` did not wake this turn: a woken turn unblocks only the tasks whose blocks woke it' });
    expect(getTask(db, taskId)?.phase).toBe('blocked');
  });

  it("on not_woken gives today's refusal with cron on, and runs the operator's unblock with cron off", async () => {
    const { taskId, socket } = await setup({ ok: false, code: 'not_woken', message: 'this turn was not woken by the board' });
    const on = await fx.run(['kanban', 'task', 'unblock', taskId], { env: cronOn(socket) });
    expect(on.code).toBe(1);
    expect(on.err).toContain("mt kanban task unblock is an operator's command, not an agent's; this shell has MT_CRON_TOKEN set");
    expect(getTask(db, taskId)?.phase).toBe('blocked');
    const off = await fx.run(['kanban', 'task', 'unblock', taskId], { env: cronOff(socket) });
    expect(off).toMatchObject({ code: 0, out: `${taskId} is unblocked, back to open` });
    expect(asked).toHaveLength(2);
  });

  it('is refused unreachable when the socket cannot be reached, with cron on and with cron off, and nothing is unblocked', async () => {
    const { taskId } = await setup({ ok: true });
    const gone = join(fx.root, 'none.sock');
    for (const env of [cronOn(gone), cronOff(gone)]) {
      const r = await fx.run(['kanban', 'task', 'unblock', taskId], { env });
      expect(r).toMatchObject({ code: 1, err: 'mt: the gateway cannot be reached at MT_KANBAN_SOCKET, so nothing was unblocked' });
    }
    expect(getTask(db, taskId)?.phase).toBe('blocked');
  });

  it('reads its arguments leniently, and asks before any usage error: an unknown option, and no task id', async () => {
    const { taskId, socket } = await setup({ ok: false, code: 'not_this_wake', message: 'refused' });
    const odd = await fx.run(['kanban', 'task', 'unblock', taskId, '--frobnicate', 'why', 'not'], { env: cronOn(socket) });
    expect(odd).toMatchObject({ code: 1, err: 'mt: refused' });
    expect(asked[0]).toEqual({ wake: 'unblock', token: TOKEN, input: { task_id: taskId, comment: 'why not' } });
    await fx.run(['kanban', 'task', 'unblock'], { env: cronOn(socket) });
    expect(asked[1]).toEqual({ wake: 'unblock', token: TOKEN, input: { task_id: '' } });
    await fx.run(['kanban', 'task', 'show', taskId, 'extra', '--board'], { env: cronOn(socket) });
    expect(asked[2]).toEqual({ wake: 'show', token: TOKEN, input: { task_id: taskId } });
  });

  it("is not asked in a board run's shell, nor without a wake token", async () => {
    const { taskId, socket } = await setup({ ok: true });
    const run = await fx.run(['kanban', 'task', 'unblock', taskId], { env: { ...cronOn(socket), MT_KANBAN_RUN: 'r_1', MT_KANBAN_TOKEN: 'x'.repeat(43) } });
    expect(run.code).toBe(1);
    const plain = await fx.run(['kanban', 'task', 'unblock', taskId], { env: { MT_KANBAN_SOCKET: socket } });
    expect(plain).toMatchObject({ code: 0, out: `${taskId} is unblocked, back to open` });
    expect(asked).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('mt kanban task show in a woken shell', () => {
```

Create `src/cli/wake.ts`:

```ts
import { parseArgs } from 'node:util';
import { visible } from '../names.js';
import { INVISIBLE } from '../text.js';
import { hasBoardRun } from './gate.js';
import { ask } from './kanban.js';
import type { MtIo } from './mt.js';
import { jsonLine } from './operator.js';

/**
 * A woken turn's `mt kanban task show` and `task unblock` (wake spec §9.2): in a
 * shell with `MT_WAKE_TOKEN` and no board run's variables, asked of the gateway
 * first, `{wake, token, input}`, before any refusal and before the command's
 * other arguments are acted on. The token says whether the turn is woken, and
 * only the gateway can read it.
 *
 * The gateway answers the show or the unblock, a refusal, or `not_woken`. On
 * `not_woken` this answers nothing (`undefined`), and the caller goes on as
 * before wakes: an agent run's shell (cron on) gets today's refusal, any other
 * the operator's command. A socket that cannot be reached, or does not answer
 * in its time, is refused `unreachable`, with no fallback.
 */

/** How long the gateway is waited for. */
export const WAKE_ANSWER_MS = 30_000;

const FLAGS = { json: { type: 'boolean' }, board: { type: 'string' } } as const;

/** Whether this shell asks the gateway first for `mt kanban task <verb>`. */
export function asksWake(env: MtIo['env'], verb: string | undefined): verb is 'show' | 'unblock' {
  const token = env['MT_WAKE_TOKEN'];
  if (token === undefined || token === '') return false;
  if (hasBoardRun(env)) return false;
  return verb === 'show' || verb === 'unblock';
}

type Answer = { ok: true } & Record<string, unknown>;

/**
 * The command's arguments, read leniently: the gateway is asked before any
 * refusal (§9.2), so an option this form does not know, or a word too many, is
 * no usage error here; on `not_woken` the operator's command reads them strictly.
 */
function lenient(rest: readonly string[]): { taskId: string; words: string[]; json: boolean; board: string | undefined } {
  const { values, positionals } = parseArgs({ args: [...rest], options: FLAGS, allowPositionals: true, strict: false });
  const [taskId = '', ...words] = positionals;
  return { taskId, words, json: values.json === true, board: typeof values.board === 'string' ? values.board : undefined };
}

export async function wokenTask(verb: 'show' | 'unblock', rest: readonly string[], io: MtIo): Promise<number | undefined> {
  const { taskId, words, json, board: asked } = lenient(rest);
  const no = (code: string, message: string): number => {
    if (json) io.out(jsonLine({ ok: false, code, message }));
    else io.err(`mt: ${message.replace(INVISIBLE, '')}`);
    return 1;
  };
  const comment = words.join(' ').trim();
  const input = verb === 'show' ? { task_id: taskId } : { task_id: taskId, ...(comment === '' ? {} : { comment }) };
  const unreachable = `the gateway cannot be reached at MT_KANBAN_SOCKET, so nothing was ${verb === 'show' ? 'shown' : 'unblocked'}`;
  const socket = io.env['MT_KANBAN_SOCKET'];
  if (socket === undefined || socket === '') return no('unreachable', unreachable);
  let answer: unknown;
  try {
    const line = await ask(socket, `${JSON.stringify({ wake: verb, token: io.env['MT_WAKE_TOKEN'], input })}\n`, WAKE_ANSWER_MS);
    answer = JSON.parse(line);
  } catch {
    return no('unreachable', unreachable);
  }
  if (typeof answer !== 'object' || answer === null || typeof (answer as { ok?: unknown }).ok !== 'boolean') {
    return no('unreachable', unreachable);
  }
  const a = answer as { ok: boolean; code?: unknown; message?: unknown };
  if (!a.ok) {
    if (a.code === 'not_woken') return undefined;
    return no(typeof a.code === 'string' ? a.code : 'refused', typeof a.message === 'string' ? a.message : 'the gateway refused');
  }
  const ok = answer as Answer;
  if (verb === 'unblock') {
    if (json) io.out(jsonLine({ ok: true, task_id: ok['task_id'], phase: ok['phase'] }));
    else io.out(String(ok['message']));
    return 0;
  }
  // `--board` is checked against the task's board, as the operator's show checks it.
  const shown = ok['json'] as { task?: { board?: unknown } } | undefined;
  const board = asked?.trim();
  const on = shown?.task?.board;
  if (board !== undefined && board !== '' && typeof on === 'string' && on !== board) {
    return no('other_board', `task ${taskId} is on board ${visible(on)}, not ${visible(board)}`);
  }
  if (json) io.out(jsonLine({ ok: true, ...(shown ?? {}) }));
  else for (const l of (ok['lines'] as unknown[] | undefined) ?? []) io.out(String(l));
  return 0;
}
```

### Task 36: The wiring

**Files:**

- Create: `tests/wake-gateway.test.ts`
- Modify: `src/db/kanban-read.ts`, `src/index.ts`, `src/kanban/people.ts`

§5.1, §9.2, §11 and §13. `createGateway` builds, with `kanban.enabled` and `kanban.wake.enabled` set, the `Waker` beside the notifier, `WakeTokens`, and the `WakeApi` behind the socket's `wake` envelope; gives the service its switch and depth, and `KanbanChat` its zone for `task show`'s Wake line; and makes a chat session's environment `chatEnv` of the cron token's and the wake token's, in today's order after a run's and a fire's. The waker starts after the notifier once the channel is connected, and stops with it; its `idle` joins the shutdown's drain, under the same bound, before the channel disconnects. The startup line follows the board's: `wakeLine`, which says the cap and the depth, or with wakes off how many tasks with wake on stay notice-only, counted by `tasksWithWakeOn`. `PeopleDirectory.principalOf` gives a setter as a session's owner. With wakes off nothing is built: a wake's pending rows wait, as §5.3a's first row says.

```ts
    expect(wakeLine(ON, 0)).toBe('kanban: wakes on; at most 6 woken turns a conversation an hour, tasks up to 4 woken turns deep');
    expect(wakeLine({ ...ON, perHour: 10, maxDepth: 2 }, 3)).toBe('kanban: wakes on; at most 10 woken turns a conversation an hour, tasks up to 1 woken turns deep');

    expect(people.principalOf('lark:on_zhixi')).toEqual({ openId: 'ou_zhixi', unionId: 'on_zhixi', displayName: 'Zhixi Sun' });
    expect(people.principalOf('lark:on_nobody')).toBeUndefined();
```

```ts
/**
 * The wakes' startup line (wake spec §11), after the board's: the cap and the
 * depth with wakes on; with them off, how many tasks with wake on stay
 * notice-only; and nothing when off with none.
 */
export function wakeLine(wake: WakeSettings, withWakeOn: number): string | undefined {
  if (!wake.enabled) {
    return withWakeOn === 0 ? undefined : `kanban: wakes off (kanban.wake.enabled is false); ${withWakeOn} task(s) with wake on stay notice-only`;
  }
  return `kanban: wakes on; at most ${wake.perHour} woken turns a conversation an hour, tasks up to ${wake.maxDepth - 1} woken turns deep`;
}

 * token's merged, the socket and `PATH` being the same in both; nothing when
 * neither is given.
 */
export function chatEnv(
  cron: Readonly<Record<string, string>> | undefined,
  wake: Readonly<Record<string, string>> | undefined,
): Readonly<Record<string, string>> | undefined {
  if (cron === undefined && wake === undefined) return undefined;
  return { ...cron, ...wake };
```

```ts
  /**
   * A wake's setter as a session's owner (wake spec §2.1, §13): the open_id and
   * name this bot last saw for them; for the owner, the configuration's open_id,
   * matched to the setter through `personByOpenId`, as the terminal's wake found
   * the owner's union_id (§3.2). Undefined for a principal that is not a
   * person's, or one this bot has not seen: a session is owned by an open_id.
   */
  principalOf(principal: string): Principal | undefined {
    const unionId = unionIdOf(principal);
    if (unionId === undefined) return undefined;
    const ownerOpenId = this.#deps.ownerOpenId;
    if (ownerOpenId !== undefined && ownerOpenId !== '') {
      const owner = personByOpenId(this.#deps.db, this.#deps.appId, ownerOpenId);
      if (owner?.unionId === unionId) return { openId: ownerOpenId, unionId, displayName: owner.name };
    }
    const person = personOf(this.#deps.db, this.#deps.appId, unionId);
    return person === undefined ? undefined : { openId: person.openId, unionId, displayName: person.name };
  }
```

§14's end-to-end paragraph, the deferred button's aside (Phase 2's). Through `createGateway`, as `tests/cron-gateway.e2e.ts` and `tests/auth-gateway.e2e.ts` do: the fake chat stands in for Lark and the fake CLI agent, in a new mode `wake`, for the default role's agent, both a board run's (it completes, or blocks once when its title says BLOCK) and a chat session's (a woken turn unblocks, with its own `mt kanban task unblock`, the task its prompt says it may lift). The fake channel gains `slowTexts`, sends it holds for a while, and `landed`, what landed in order. Five cases: a completion's notice, then the marker, slowed, then the woken card, with a message typed during the woken turn queued behind it; a block lifted by the woken agent through the socket with its `MT_WAKE_TOKEN`, the event's actor and `wake`, the comment, and the notice redrawn "(woken by the board)"; a setter's grant revoked with `/auth revoke`, the next outcome noticed with the line and not woken; a direct message's task with `auth.directMessages` off, passed over with its log line; and a wake still pending when the gateway stops, woken once after a restart on the same database. The home's `config.yaml` turns the board on, so the terminal's `mt` reads it as the gateway does. No source changes: Tasks 1 to 36 built what this checks.

Create `tests/wake-gateway.e2e.ts`:

```ts
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, readFileSync, realpathSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { LarkAdapter } from '../src/channel/lark/adapter.js';
import type { Channel } from '../src/channel/types.js';
import { loadConfig, type GatewayConfig } from '../src/config.js';
import { createGateway, type Gateway } from '../src/index.js';
import { mtCommand } from '../src/kanban/shim.js';
import { clearSecrets } from '../src/secrets.js';
import { loadTeam } from '../src/team.js';
import { FakeChannel } from './helpers/channel.js';

/**
 * Wakes through createGateway (wake spec §14, end to end): the gateway's own
 * waker, wake tokens and socket, with the fake chat standing in for Lark and the
 * fake CLI agent for the default role's, both a board run's and a chat
 * session's. A completion's notice, then the marker, then the woken turn's
 * card, in that order, with the marker's send made slow; a message typed during
 * the woken turn queued; a block lifted by the woken agent's own `mt kanban task
 * unblock`, with its wake token, and its notice redrawn; a revoked grant's task
 * noticed and not woken; a direct message's task not woken with direct messages
 * off; and a pending wake woken once after a restart.
 */

const AGENT = fileURLToPath(new URL('./fakes/cli-agent.mjs', import.meta.url));

let root: string;
let home: string;
let log: string;
let env: Record<string, string>;
let config: GatewayConfig;
let lark: FakeChannel;
let handlers: { message: (msg: unknown) => Promise<void> } | undefined;
let gateway: Gateway | undefined;
let lines: string[];
let seq = 0;

const CHANNEL_METHODS = ['sendText', 'openCard', 'sendApprovalCard', 'updateApprovalCard', 'sendCard', 'updateCard', 'react', 'unreact', 'chatMembers'] as const;

interface Person {
  openId: string;
  unionId: string;
  name: string;
}
const OWNER: Person = { openId: 'ou_owner', unionId: 'on_owner', name: 'Alice' };
const CAROL: Person = { openId: 'ou_carol', unionId: 'on_carol', name: 'Carol Wu' };

beforeEach(() => {
  clearSecrets();
  root = realpathSync(mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'mt-wake-gw-')));
  home = join(root, 'home');
  mkdirSync(home);
  mkdirSync(join(root, 'repo'));
  log = join(root, 'agent.log');
  env = {
    MT_HOME: home,
    MT_DB: join(home, 'team.db'),
    MT_WORKSPACE: join(root, 'repo'),
    MT_OWNER_OPEN_ID: OWNER.openId,
    LARK_APP_ID: 'cli_app',
    LARK_APP_SECRET: 'app-secret',
    MT_AGENT_COMMAND: process.execPath,
    MT_AGENT_ARGS: AGENT,
    MT_AGENT_DRIVER: 'structured-cli',
    MT_AGENT_UNSUPERVISED: 'true',
    MT_AGENT_ENV_FAKE_CLI_MODE: 'wake',
    MT_AGENT_ENV_FAKE_CLI_LOG: log,
  };
  // In the home's file, so the terminal's mt reads the board as on too, and nudges the gateway after a change.
  writeFileSync(join(home, 'config.yaml'), 'kanban:\n  enabled: true\n');
  config = loadConfig(env);
  lark = new FakeChannel({ id: 'lark' });
  lines = [];
  vi.spyOn(process.stderr, 'write').mockImplementation((chunk: string | Uint8Array) => {
    lines.push(String(chunk));
    return true;
  });
  vi.spyOn(LarkAdapter.prototype, 'connect').mockResolvedValue(undefined);
  vi.spyOn(LarkAdapter.prototype, 'disconnect').mockResolvedValue(undefined);
  vi.spyOn(LarkAdapter.prototype, 'botOpenId', 'get').mockReturnValue('ou_bot');
  vi.spyOn(LarkAdapter.prototype, 'raw', 'get').mockReturnValue({
    on: (h: typeof handlers) => {
      handlers = h;
      return () => {
        handlers = undefined;
      };
    },
  } as never);
  for (const method of CHANNEL_METHODS) {
    vi.spyOn(LarkAdapter.prototype as unknown as Channel, method).mockImplementation(((...args: unknown[]) =>
      (lark as unknown as Record<string, (...a: unknown[]) => unknown>)[method]?.apply(lark, args)) as never);
  }
});

afterEach(async () => {
  await gateway?.stop();
  gateway = undefined;
  vi.restoreAllMocks();
  clearSecrets();
  rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
});

async function start(over: Partial<GatewayConfig> = {}): Promise<Gateway> {
  gateway = await createGateway({ ...config, ...over }, loadTeam(config, {}));
  await gateway.start();
  return gateway;
}

/** A message addressed to the bot, in the group or one of its threads, or in a direct message, as the SDK hands it on. */
async function say(sender: Person, text: string, at: { threadId?: string; dm?: boolean } = {}, mentions: Person[] = []): Promise<string> {
  if (handlers === undefined) throw new Error('the inbound side is not listening');
  const messageId = `om_wake_${++seq}`;
  await handlers.message({
    messageId,
    chatId: at.dm === true ? 'oc_alice_dm' : 'oc_team',
    chatType: at.dm === true ? 'p2p' : 'group',
    threadId: at.threadId,
    senderId: sender.openId,
    senderName: sender.name,
    content: text,
    mentionedBot: at.dm !== true,
    mentionAll: false,
    resources: [],
    createTime: Date.now(),
    raw: {
      sender: { sender_type: 'user', sender_id: { union_id: sender.unionId } },
      message: {
        mentions: [
          { key: '@_user_1', name: 'Bot', id: { open_id: 'ou_bot' } },
          ...mentions.map((m, i) => ({ key: `@_user_${i + 2}`, name: m.name, id: { open_id: m.openId, union_id: m.unionId } })),
        ],
      },
    },
  });
  return messageId;
}

/** Wait for `ok`, polling, for up to about 45 s: a loaded machine starts the fake agent slowly. */
async function until(what: string, ok: () => boolean): Promise<void> {
  for (let i = 0; i < 1800; i += 1) {
    if (ok()) return;
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 25));
  }
  throw new Error(`gave up waiting for ${what}`);
}

/** The chat turns the fake agent ran: each prompt, whether it had a wake token, and its unblock's answer. */
function chatTurns(): Array<{ prompt: string; token: boolean; unblocked: { status: number | null; out: string; err: string } | null }> {
  try {
    return readFileSync(join(root, 'wake.log'), 'utf8')
      .split('\n')
      .filter((l) => l !== '')
      .map((l) => JSON.parse(l) as { prompt: string; token: boolean; unblocked: { status: number | null; out: string; err: string } | null });
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

const woken = (): ReturnType<typeof chatTurns> => chatTurns().filter((t) => t.prompt.startsWith('Board update'));

const texts = (): string[] => lark.texts.map((m) => m.text);

/** The task a "Created" reply named, the latest. */
function createdTask(): string {
  const id = [...texts()].reverse().map((t) => /^Created `(k_[0-9a-z]+)`/.exec(t)?.[1]).find((x) => x !== undefined);
  if (id === undefined) throw new Error('no task created');
  return id;
}

function wakes(): Array<{ state: string; attempt: number; principal: string }> {
  return (gateway?.db.prepare('SELECT state, attempt, principal FROM kanban_wakes ORDER BY wake_id').all() ?? []) as Array<{ state: string; attempt: number; principal: string }>;
}

function phaseOf(taskId: string): string | undefined {
  return (gateway?.db.prepare('SELECT phase FROM kanban_tasks WHERE task_id = ?').get(taskId) as { phase: string } | undefined)?.phase;
}

/** `mt <args>` as another process: this build's, with the gateway's settings. */
function mt(args: string[]): Promise<{ status: number | null; out: string; err: string }> {
  const [command, ...rest] = mtCommand();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const child = spawn(command ?? process.execPath, [...rest, ...args], { env: { ...env, PATH: process.env['PATH'] ?? '', HOME: root }, stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
    let out = '';
    let err = '';
    child.stdout.setEncoding('utf8');
    child.stderr.setEncoding('utf8');
    child.stdout.on('data', (d: string) => (out += d));
    child.stderr.on('data', (d: string) => (err += d));
    child.once('error', reject);
    child.once('close', (status) => resolve({ status, out: out.trim(), err: err.trim() }));
  });
}

describe('wakes through createGateway', () => {
  it("sends the notice, then the marker, then the woken turn's card, and queues a message typed during the woken turn", async () => {
    await start();
    // Slow, but inside a send's bound: the turn waits for it all the same (wake spec §5.5 step 3).
    lark.slowTexts.push({ match: 'Waking the agent', ms: 1_500 });
    const command = await say(OWNER, '/kanban task new Book the SLOW venue\nassignee: default\nwake: on');
    expect(texts().at(-1)).toMatch(/^Created `k_[0-9a-z]+`.*Its outcomes wake the agent here\.$/s);
    const taskId = createdTask();
    const thread = `omt_${command}`;

    await until('the woken turn to start', () => lark.landed.includes('card'));
    const notice = lark.landed.findIndex((l) => l.startsWith('text:Done: **Book the SLOW venue**'));
    const marker = lark.landed.indexOf('text:Waking the agent for 1 board update.');
    expect(notice).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
    expect(marker).toBeGreaterThan(notice);
    expect(lark.landed.indexOf('card')).toBeGreaterThan(marker);
    expect(lark.texts.find((m) => m.text.startsWith('Waking the agent'))?.target.threadId).toBe(thread);
    expect(lark.cardOpens[0]?.target.threadId).toBe(thread);

    // A person's message during the woken turn waits behind it (wake spec §6.3).
    await say(OWNER, 'what is next?', { threadId: thread });
    await until('the queued reply', () => texts().some((t) => t.startsWith('Queued: 1 ahead of this one.')));
    writeFileSync(join(root, 'release'), '');
    await until('both turns to run', () => chatTurns().length === 2);
    const [first, second] = chatTurns();
    expect(first?.prompt).toMatch(/^Board update: you are woken because wake is on for these tasks \(set by Alice\)\./);
    expect(first?.prompt).toContain(`${taskId}: Book the SLOW venue`);
    expect(first?.token).toBe(true);
    expect(second?.prompt).toContain('what is next?');
    await until('the woken card to finish', () => (lark.cards[0]?.finishes.length ?? 0) > 0);
    expect(lark.cards[0]?.finishes[0]).toMatch(/^_\(woken by the board, as Alice\)_/);
    expect(wakes()).toEqual([{ state: 'delivered', attempt: 1, principal: 'lark:on_owner' }]);
  });

  it("lets the woken agent lift its block with its own mt kanban task unblock, and redraws the notice as woken by the board", async () => {
    await start();
    await say(OWNER, '/kanban task new Draft the BLOCK agenda\nassignee: default\nwake: on');
    const taskId = createdTask();
    await until('the woken unblock', () => woken().some((t) => t.unblocked !== null));
    const turn = woken().find((t) => t.unblocked !== null);
    expect(turn?.prompt).toContain(`lift it with mt kanban task unblock ${taskId} <comment>`);
    expect(turn?.unblocked).toMatchObject({ status: 0 });
    expect(turn?.unblocked?.out).toContain(`\`${taskId}\` is unblocked, back to open, as Alice (woken by the board)`);

    const notice = lark.texts.find((m) => m.text.includes(`\`${taskId}\``) && (m.buttons?.length ?? 0) > 0);
    if (notice === undefined) throw new Error('no notice with an Unblock button');
    await until('the notice redrawn', () => lark.cardUpdates.length > 0);
    expect(lark.cardUpdates[0]?.view.buttons).toEqual([]);
    expect(lark.cardUpdates[0]?.view.markdown).toMatch(new RegExp(`\`${taskId}\`: Unblocked by Alice \\(woken by the board\\) at \\d\\d:\\d\\d$`));

    const db = gateway?.db;
    const lifted = db?.prepare("SELECT actor, json_extract(payload, '$.wake') AS wake FROM kanban_events WHERE task_id = ? AND kind = 'unblocked'").get(taskId);
    expect(lifted).toEqual({ actor: 'lark:on_owner', wake: 1 });
    const comment = db?.prepare('SELECT author, body, steers FROM kanban_comments WHERE task_id = ?').get(taskId);
    expect(comment).toEqual({ author: 'lark:on_owner', body: '(woken by the board) Speaker two is confirmed.', steers: 1 });
    // The run after it reads the comment, and completes.
    await until('the task to complete', () => phaseOf(taskId) === 'done');
  });

  it("notices a revoked setter's next outcome without a wake, and says so once", async () => {
    await start();
    await say(OWNER, '/auth grant @Carol Wu talk', {}, [CAROL]);
    const command = await say(OWNER, '/kanban task new Check the BLOCK links\nassignee: default');
    const taskId = createdTask();
    const thread = `omt_${command}`;
    await until('the task to block', () => phaseOf(taskId) === 'blocked');
    await say(CAROL, `/kanban task wake ${taskId} on`, { threadId: thread });
    expect(texts().at(-1)).toBe(`Wake is on for \`${taskId}\`: its outcomes now start a turn of the agent where it is followed, run as Carol Wu.`);
    await say(OWNER, '/auth revoke lark:on_carol');
    await say(OWNER, `/kanban task unblock ${taskId}`, { threadId: thread });
    await until('the lapse line', () => texts().includes(`wake is off for \`${taskId}\`: Carol Wu no longer has talk tier`));
    expect(texts().some((t) => t.includes('Done: **Check the BLOCK links**'))).toBe(true);
    expect(wakes()).toEqual([]);
    expect(woken()).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("passes over a direct message's task with direct messages off, with a log line", async () => {
    await start();
    await say(OWNER, '/kanban task new Say hi\nwake: on', { dm: true });
    const taskId = createdTask();
    await gateway?.stop();
    gateway = undefined;
    await start({ auth: { ...config.auth, allowDirectMessages: false } });
    const assigned = await mt(['kanban', 'task', 'assign', taskId, 'default']);
    expect(assigned.status, assigned.err).toBe(0);
    const subscription = (): { cursor: number; wake: number } | undefined =>
      gateway?.db.prepare('SELECT cursor, wake_cursor AS wake FROM kanban_subscriptions WHERE task_id = ?').get(taskId) as { cursor: number; wake: number } | undefined;
    await until('the completion passed over', () => phaseOf(taskId) === 'done' && (subscription()?.wake ?? 0) > 0 && subscription()?.wake === subscription()?.cursor);
    expect(lines.some((l) => l.includes('kanban: oc_alice_dm is not admitted (dm_disabled); passing over its wakes until the gateway restarts'))).toBe(true);
    expect(wakes()).toEqual([]);
    expect(woken()).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('wakes a pending row once after a restart on the same database', async () => {
    await start();
    // Slower than the shutdown's drain: the stop comes while the marker is still being sent.
    lark.slowTexts.push({ match: 'Waking the agent', ms: 8_000 });
    await say(OWNER, '/kanban task new Pack the boxes\nassignee: default\nwake: on');
    await until('the wake to be recorded', () => wakes().length === 1);
    expect(wakes()).toEqual([{ state: 'pending', attempt: 1, principal: 'lark:on_owner' }]);
    await gateway?.stop();
    gateway = undefined;
    // The slow marker lands on the stopped gateway's channel; nothing more is written for it.
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 4_000));
    lark = new FakeChannel({ id: 'lark' });
    await start();
    await until('the woken turn', () => woken().length === 1);
    await until('the wake delivered', () => wakes()[0]?.state === 'delivered');
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 4_500));
    expect(woken()).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(wakes()).toEqual([{ state: 'delivered', attempt: 1, principal: 'lark:on_owner' }]);
    expect(texts().filter((t) => t === 'Waking the agent for 1 board update.').length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(existsSync(join(home, 'team.db'))).toBe(true);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, readFileSync, realpathSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { parse as parseYaml } from 'yaml';
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { runMt } from '../src/cli/mt.js';
import { loadConfig } from '../src/config.js';
import { migrate, openDb } from '../src/db/open.js';
import { notePerson } from '../src/db/people.js';
import { parseKanban } from '../src/kanban/chat-parse.js';
import { clearSecrets } from '../src/secrets.js';
import { SCHEMA_DIR } from './helpers/db.js';

/**
 * The wakes in the docs (wake spec §13): the guide's section on them, the
 * README's commands and settings, and docs/examples.md's workflow started with
 * a wake, each read as the gateway reads it. Each example is found by the
 * `<!-- example: … -->` comment on the line above its fence.
 */

const REPO = fileURLToPath(new URL('..', import.meta.url));
const read = (doc: string): string => readFileSync(join(REPO, doc), 'utf8');

/** The fenced block under `<!-- example: <marker> -->` in `doc`. */
function example(doc: string, marker: string): string {
  const lines = read(doc).split('\n');
  const at = lines.findIndex((l) => l.trim() === `<!-- example: ${marker} -->`);
  if (at === -1) throw new Error(`${doc} has no example ${marker}`);
  let i = at + 1;
  while ((lines[i] ?? '').trim() === '') i += 1;
  const fence = /^(`{3,})/.exec(lines[i] ?? '')?.[1];
  if (fence === undefined) throw new Error(`${doc}: no fence under ${marker}`);
  const body: string[] = [];
  for (let j = i + 1; j < lines.length && (lines[j] ?? '').trim() !== fence; j += 1) body.push(lines[j] ?? '');
  return body.join('\n');
}

/** A section of a markdown file, from its heading to the next of its level or higher. */
function section(doc: string, heading: string): string {
  const lines = read(doc).split('\n');
  const at = lines.indexOf(heading);
  if (at === -1) throw new Error(`${doc} has no ${heading}`);
  const level = /^#+/.exec(heading)?.[0].length ?? 0;
  const end = lines.findIndex((l, i) => i > at && /^#+ /.test(l) && (/^#+/.exec(l)?.[0].length ?? 0) <= level);
  return lines.slice(at, end === -1 ? undefined : end).join('\n');
}

const roots: string[] = [];
afterEach(() => {
  clearSecrets();
  while (roots.length > 0) rmSync(roots.pop() ?? '', { recursive: true, force: true });
});

describe("the guide's wakes", () => {

  it("turns an existing task's wake on and off, as chat parses it", () => {

    expect(lines.map((l) => parseKanban(l.slice('/kanban '.length), []))).toEqual([
      { ok: true, command: { verb: 'wake', taskId: 'k_7gq2', on: true } },
      { ok: true, command: { verb: 'wake', taskId: 'k_7gq2', on: false } },
    ]);
  });

  it('gives the settings with their defaults, as the configuration reads them', () => {

    const config = loadConfig({ MT_HOME: '/nonexistent-home', LARK_APP_ID: 'cli_app', LARK_APP_SECRET: 's', MT_OWNER_OPEN_ID: 'ou_owner', MT_AGENT_COMMAND: 'bytesec', MT_WORKSPACE: REPO }, () => file);
    expect(config.kanban.wake).toEqual({ enabled: true, perHour: 6, maxDepth: 5, holdMinutes: 10 });
    expect(parseYaml(file)).toEqual({ kanban: { enabled: true, wake: { enabled: true, per_hour: 6, max_depth: 5, hold_minutes: 10 } } });
  });
});
```

```md
## 9. When things go wrong
```

with:

````md

### Wakes

A task with **wake** on does more than notify: when it is done, has changes requested, blocks
in its run, gives up or is stranded, the agent of the conversation that follows it is woken
there, in its thread or the chat, to decide what to do next. Wake is off unless asked for, task
by task. Turn it on when you make the task, with a field line:

<!-- example: wake task new -->
```
/kanban task new Book the venue
assignee: worker
wake: on
```

The "Created" reply ends `Its outcomes wake the agent here.` For a task that exists, in a chat
that follows it (its thread, or the chat it was made at), at talk tier:

<!-- example: wake task wake -->
```
/kanban task wake k_7gq2 on
/kanban task wake k_7gq2 off
```

A workflow's start takes the trailing word `wake`, for every member; a step that says `wake: true`
asks for one by itself. At a terminal, `mt kanban task new … --chat oc_… --wake`, `mt kanban
workflow start … --chat oc_… --wake` and `mt kanban task wake <task_id> on|off` do the same; a
terminal's wake needs a chat to follow the task, and runs as the owner, once the gateway has seen
them in Lark. A task a run makes inherits its task's wake.

What the thread sees, for each outcome: the notice, as always; then one line,
`Waking the agent for 1 board update.`, or `2 board updates` for two at once; then the agent's card, whose first
line says it was woken by the board, and as whom. The woken turn runs as the person who turned
wake on, at talk tier: it is answered in the thread like any turn, a message typed during it
waits behind it, and `/stop` cancels it. Each outcome wakes once; a block nobody answers is not
woken again.

A woken turn may read the tasks that woke it with `mt kanban task show <id>`, and, when the
person who set the wake has operate tier, lift a block that woke it with `mt kanban task unblock
<id> <comment>`: the comment, marked `(woken by the board)`, goes to the task's next run, and the
notice is redrawn `Unblocked by <name> (woken by the board)`. It is told so in its prompt, and
told when it cannot. A block a person lifts before the turn starts is left out of it.

The limits: at most `kanban.wake.per_hour` woken turns a conversation in any hour, 6 by default
(past it the thread is told `wakes are paused here until HH:MM`, and what comes meanwhile waits
for one later turn); a task made in a woken turn's own shell is one level deeper, and a task 5
deep (`kanban.wake.max_depth`) stays notice-only; and a woken turn's agent may unblock one task
at most 5 times between two completions. A setter who loses talk tier has their tasks' outcomes
noticed and not woken, and the thread is told once. The settings, with their defaults:

<!-- example: config wake -->
```yaml
kanban:
  enabled: true
  wake:
    enabled: true
    per_hour: 6
    max_depth: 5
    hold_minutes: 10
```

With `kanban.wake.enabled: false` nothing is woken, and a wake asked for is refused; turned on
again, what waited is woken, one turn a conversation and setter. `/kanban task show` says each
task's wake: `Wake: on, set by Zhixi Sun, depth 0`, with when it last woke.
````

## Phase 2: the agent-first Unblock button

Tasks 39 to 48, the wake spec's §5.9. For a block of a task with wake on that the agent could lift, the notice goes at once without its Unblock button, the agent gets the first try, and the waker sends the button when the turn ends with the block still there, at once when the agent gets no real try, or after `kanban.wake.hold_minutes`. Phase 2 ends green and can be merged on top of Phase 1 alone.

### Task 39: A card with no actions

**Files:**

- Modify: `src/channel/lark/adapter.ts`, `src/channel/types.ts`, `tests/helpers/channel.ts`, `tests/lark-adapter.test.ts`

§5.9 and §13. A notice whose block's Unblock button the waker deferred may be left with no button at all, and must still be redrawn later, which only a card can be. `Channel.sendText` takes a fifth argument, `SendTextOptions`, whose `card: true` asks for a card even with no buttons: the Lark adapter sends its markdown as a card with no actions, by the same path as a card of buttons, and falls back to text, answering `card: false`, on the same refusals. The fake channel records `card: true` on its `texts`. Nothing asks for it yet, so nothing a person sees changes.

**Files:**

- Create: `tests/wake-deferred-writer.test.ts`

§4.2, §4.3, §5.9 and §13. `kanban_deferred_buttons`, made by Task 1, gets its writers in `src/db/kanban.ts`: `deferButton`, `held` at most once a subscription and block event (`INSERT OR IGNORE`), and `buttonDue`, `buttonLifted`, `buttonSent`, `buttonFailed` and `buttonTried`, each one transaction, each moving the row only from the state it names, with `KanbanService`'s pass-throughs. `recordUnblockButtons` takes a row's `hasButton`, written as `has_button`; `unblockMessage` reads it, with a buttonless row's deferred state, and `deferredButton` and `deferredButtons` read the rows. `WRITERS.md` gains the table's row and `has_button`'s sentence. Nothing writes a deferral yet, and every row recorded without `hasButton` is a button, as before.

Create `tests/wake-deferred-writer.test.ts`:

```ts
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import {
  buttonDue,
  buttonFailed,
  buttonLifted,
  buttonSent,
  buttonTried,
  deferButton,
  recordUnblockButtons,
  setWake,
} from '../src/db/kanban.js';
import { deferredButton, deferredButtons, eventsOf, subscriptionsOf, unblockMessage } from '../src/db/kanban-read.js';
import type { TaskRow } from '../src/kanban/types.js';
import { testDb, type TestDb } from './helpers/db.js';
import { ALICE, NOW, newTask } from './helpers/kanban.js';

/**
 * The deferred Unblock buttons' writers and reads (wake spec §4.3, §5.9): a row
 * `held` at most once a subscription and block, written after its notice's
 * send; its state moving forward only, each write only from the state it names;
 * and a buttonless notice recorded with `has_button` 0, read with its deferred
 * button's state, so the unblock redraw can add its lifted line.
 */

const APP = 'cli_app';
const VIA_THREAD = { kind: 'chat', channel: 'lark', appId: APP, conversationId: 'oc_chat', threadId: 'omt_1', rootId: 'om_root' } as const;

let h: TestDb;
beforeEach(() => {
  h = testDb();
});
afterEach(() => h.close());

function blocked(): { task: TaskRow; sub: number; block: number } {
  const task = newTask(h.db, { createdVia: VIA_THREAD });
  setWake(h.db, task.taskId, { on: true, as: ALICE, maxDepth: 5 }, ALICE, APP, NOW);
  h.db.prepare("UPDATE kanban_tasks SET phase = 'blocked', blocked_from = 'open', block_kind = 'needs_input' WHERE task_id = ?").run(task.taskId);
  h.db
    .prepare("INSERT INTO kanban_events (task_id, kind, actor, payload, created_at) VALUES (?, 'blocked', 'run:r_1', jsonb('{\"kind\":\"needs_input\",\"reason\":\"which?\"}'), ?)")
    .run(task.taskId, NOW);
  const block = eventsOf(h.db, task.taskId).at(-1)?.id ?? 0;
  return { task, sub: subscriptionsOf(h.db, task.taskId)[0]?.id ?? 0, block };
}

describe('deferButton', () => {
  it('writes the row held, with its task, its bot and the send time, at most once a subscription and block', () => {
    const b = blocked();
    const key = { subscriptionId: b.sub, eventId: b.block };
    expect(deferButton(h.db, key, NOW + 10)).toEqual({ ok: true, deferred: true });
    expect(deferredButton(h.db, b.sub, b.block)).toEqual({
      subscriptionId: b.sub,
      eventId: b.block,
      taskId: b.task.taskId,
      appId: APP,
      heldAt: NOW + 10,
      state: 'held',
      why: null,
      attempts: 0,
      messageId: null,
      endedAt: null,
    });
    // A notice sent again, after a restart or a failed record: the first row stands.
    expect(deferButton(h.db, key, NOW + 99)).toEqual({ ok: true, deferred: false });
    expect(deferredButton(h.db, b.sub, b.block)?.heldAt).toBe(NOW + 10);
  });

  it('refuses a subscription that does not exist, or an event of another task', () => {
    const b = blocked();
    const other = newTask(h.db);
    expect(deferButton(h.db, { subscriptionId: 9999, eventId: b.block }, NOW)).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: 'not_found' });
    const otherEvent = eventsOf(h.db, other.taskId)[0]?.id ?? 0;
    expect(deferButton(h.db, { subscriptionId: b.sub, eventId: otherEvent }, NOW)).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: 'invalid' });
  });
});

describe('the deferred button moves forward only', () => {
  it('goes held to due with its why, then due to sent with the card, ended once', () => {
    const b = blocked();
    const key = { subscriptionId: b.sub, eventId: b.block };
    deferButton(h.db, key, NOW);
    expect(buttonSent(h.db, key, 'om_card', NOW + 1)).toEqual({ ok: true, changed: false });
    expect(buttonDue(h.db, key, 'tried')).toEqual({ ok: true, changed: true });
    expect(buttonDue(h.db, key, 'running')).toEqual({ ok: true, changed: false });
    expect(deferredButton(h.db, b.sub, b.block)).toMatchObject({ state: 'due', why: 'tried', endedAt: null });
    expect(buttonTried(h.db, key)).toEqual({ ok: true, attempts: 1 });
    expect(buttonTried(h.db, key)).toEqual({ ok: true, attempts: 2 });
    expect(buttonSent(h.db, key, 'om_card', NOW + 5)).toEqual({ ok: true, changed: true });
    expect(deferredButton(h.db, b.sub, b.block)).toMatchObject({ state: 'sent', messageId: 'om_card', endedAt: NOW + 5, attempts: 2 });
    // Ended: nothing moves it again.
    expect(buttonLifted(h.db, key, NOW + 6)).toEqual({ ok: true, changed: false });
    expect(buttonFailed(h.db, key, NOW + 6)).toEqual({ ok: true, changed: false });
    expect(buttonTried(h.db, key)).toEqual({ ok: true, attempts: 2 });
  });

  it('lifts or fails a held row and a due one, but never a sent one', () => {
    const one = blocked();
    const two = blocked();
    const held = { subscriptionId: one.sub, eventId: one.block };
    const due = { subscriptionId: two.sub, eventId: two.block };
    deferButton(h.db, held, NOW);
    deferButton(h.db, due, NOW);
    buttonDue(h.db, due, 'not_woken');
    expect(buttonLifted(h.db, held, NOW + 3)).toEqual({ ok: true, changed: true });
    expect(buttonFailed(h.db, due, NOW + 4)).toEqual({ ok: true, changed: true });
    expect(deferredButton(h.db, one.sub, one.block)).toMatchObject({ state: 'lifted', endedAt: NOW + 3 });
    expect(deferredButton(h.db, two.sub, two.block)).toMatchObject({ state: 'failed', endedAt: NOW + 4, why: 'not_woken' });
  });

  it('lists the held and due rows of this bot, oldest held first, and no ended one', () => {
    const one = blocked();
    const two = blocked();
    const three = blocked();
    deferButton(h.db, { subscriptionId: two.sub, eventId: two.block }, NOW + 1);
    deferButton(h.db, { subscriptionId: one.sub, eventId: one.block }, NOW + 2);
    deferButton(h.db, { subscriptionId: three.sub, eventId: three.block }, NOW + 3);
    buttonDue(h.db, { subscriptionId: one.sub, eventId: one.block }, 'restart');
    buttonLifted(h.db, { subscriptionId: three.sub, eventId: three.block }, NOW + 4);
    expect(deferredButtons(h.db, APP).map((r) => [r.taskId, r.state])).toEqual([
      [two.task.taskId, 'held'],
      [one.task.taskId, 'due'],
    ]);
    expect(deferredButtons(h.db, 'cli_other')).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('a buttonless notice, recorded for the redraw', () => {
  it('records has_button 0 beside a real button, and reads each with its deferred state', () => {
    const deferred = blocked();
    const real = blocked();
    deferButton(h.db, { subscriptionId: deferred.sub, eventId: deferred.block }, NOW);
    const r = recordUnblockButtons(
      h.db,
      {
        messageId: 'om_n',
        channel: 'lark',
        appId: APP,
        markdown: 'two blocks',
        buttons: [
          { taskId: deferred.task.taskId, blockEvent: deferred.block, hasButton: false },
          { taskId: real.task.taskId, blockEvent: real.block },
        ],
      },
      NOW,
    );
    expect(r).toEqual({ ok: true, recorded: 2 });
    const read = unblockMessage(h.db, APP, 'om_n');
    expect(read?.buttons.map((b) => [b.taskId, b.hasButton, b.deferred])).toEqual([
      [deferred.task.taskId, false, 'held'],
      [real.task.taskId, true, undefined],
    ]);
    buttonDue(h.db, { subscriptionId: deferred.sub, eventId: deferred.block }, 'tried');
    buttonSent(h.db, { subscriptionId: deferred.sub, eventId: deferred.block }, 'om_card', NOW + 1);
    expect(unblockMessage(h.db, APP, 'om_n')?.buttons[0]?.deferred).toBe('sent');
  });

  it('records every row of a message as a button when none says otherwise, as before', () => {
    const b = blocked();
    recordUnblockButtons(h.db, { messageId: 'om_m', channel: 'lark', appId: APP, markdown: 'one', buttons: [{ taskId: b.task.taskId, blockEvent: b.block }] }, NOW);
    expect(h.db.prepare<[], { has_button: number }>("SELECT has_button FROM kanban_unblock_buttons WHERE message_id = 'om_m'").get()?.has_button).toBe(1);
    expect(unblockMessage(h.db, APP, 'om_m')?.buttons[0]).toMatchObject({ hasButton: true });
  });
});
```

```ts
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Deferred Unblock buttons (wake spec §5.9)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

interface DeferredButtonRaw {
  subscription_id: number;
  event_id: number;
  task_id: string;
  app_id: string;
  held_at: number;
  state: string;
  why: string | null;
  attempts: number;
  message_id: string | null;
  ended_at: number | null;
}

const DEFERRED_COLS = 'subscription_id, event_id, task_id, app_id, held_at, state, why, attempts, message_id, ended_at';

function decodeDeferred(r: DeferredButtonRaw): DeferredButtonRow {
  return {
    subscriptionId: r.subscription_id,
    eventId: r.event_id,
    taskId: r.task_id,
    appId: r.app_id,
    heldAt: r.held_at,
    state: r.state as DeferredState,
    why: r.why as DeferredWhy | null,
    attempts: r.attempts,
    messageId: r.message_id,
    endedAt: r.ended_at,
  };
}

/** A deferred button, by its subscription and block event; none on a database before migration 013. */
export function deferredButton(db: Db, subscriptionId: number, eventId: number): DeferredButtonRow | undefined {
  if (!hasWakeColumns(db)) return undefined;
  const r = db
    .prepare<[number, number], DeferredButtonRaw>(`SELECT ${DEFERRED_COLS} FROM kanban_deferred_buttons WHERE subscription_id = ? AND event_id = ?`)
    .get(subscriptionId, eventId);
  return r === undefined ? undefined : decodeDeferred(r);
}

/** This bot's deferred buttons still `held` or `due` (wake spec §5.9), the oldest held first: what each round releases and sends. */
export function deferredButtons(db: Db, appId: string): DeferredButtonRow[] {
  if (!hasWakeColumns(db)) return [];
  return db
    .prepare<[string], DeferredButtonRaw>(
      `SELECT ${DEFERRED_COLS} FROM kanban_deferred_buttons WHERE app_id = ? AND state IN ('held', 'due') ORDER BY held_at, subscription_id, event_id`,
    )
    .all(appId)
    .map(decodeDeferred);
}
```

```ts
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Deferred Unblock buttons (wake spec §5.9)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/**
 * A block's Unblock button deferred for the agent's try (wake spec §5.9):
 * written `held`, at most once a subscription and block event (`INSERT OR
 * IGNORE`), by the notifier once a notice it rendered without that button has
 * been sent, as a card or as text, `heldAt` the send's time. A batch sent again
 * finds the row already there, and the first stands. Writes no event: the row is
 * the waker's own, as a cursor is the notifier's.
 */
export function deferButton(db: Db, key: DeferredKey, heldAt: number): Result<{ deferred: boolean }> {
  return tx(db, (d) => {
    const sub = d
      .prepare<[number], { task_id: string; account_id: string }>('SELECT task_id, account_id FROM kanban_subscriptions WHERE id = ?')
      .get(key.subscriptionId);
    if (sub === undefined) return refuse('not_found', `no subscription ${key.subscriptionId}`);
    const event = d.prepare<[number], { task_id: string }>('SELECT task_id FROM kanban_events WHERE id = ?').get(key.eventId);
    if (event === undefined || event.task_id !== sub.task_id) {
      return refuse('invalid', `event ${key.eventId} is not of task ${sub.task_id}, which subscription ${key.subscriptionId} follows`);
    }
    const { changes } = d
      .prepare(
        `INSERT OR IGNORE INTO kanban_deferred_buttons (subscription_id, event_id, task_id, app_id, held_at, state)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'held')`,
      )
      .run(key.subscriptionId, key.eventId, sub.task_id, sub.account_id, heldAt);
    return { ok: true, deferred: changes === 1 };
  });
}

/** One move of a deferred button, only from the states named: answers whether it moved. */
function moveButton(db: Db, key: DeferredKey, from: readonly DeferredState[], set: string, values: readonly unknown[]): Result<{ changed: boolean }> {
  return tx(db, (d) => {
    const { changes } = d
      .prepare(
        `UPDATE kanban_deferred_buttons SET ${set}
          WHERE subscription_id = ? AND event_id = ? AND state IN (${from.map(() => '?').join(', ')})`,
      )
      .run(...values, key.subscriptionId, key.eventId, ...from);
    return { ok: true, changed: changes === 1 };
  });
}

/** A held button made due, with why (wake spec §5.9): the agent has had its try, or will get none. */
export function buttonDue(db: Db, key: DeferredKey, why: DeferredWhy): Result<{ changed: boolean }> {
  return moveButton(db, key, ['held'], "state = 'due', why = ?", [why]);
}

/** A held or due button whose block was lifted, by any path, or whose task was archived: no card is owed. */
export function buttonLifted(db: Db, key: DeferredKey, now: number): Result<{ changed: boolean }> {
  return moveButton(db, key, ['held', 'due'], "state = 'lifted', ended_at = ?", [now]);
}

/** A due button's card sent, with its message id. */
export function buttonSent(db: Db, key: DeferredKey, messageId: string, now: number): Result<{ changed: boolean }> {
  return moveButton(db, key, ['due'], "state = 'sent', message_id = ?, ended_at = ?", [messageId, now]);
}

/** A held or due button given up: its task is gone, or its card could not be sent. */
export function buttonFailed(db: Db, key: DeferredKey, now: number): Result<{ changed: boolean }> {
  return moveButton(db, key, ['held', 'due'], "state = 'failed', ended_at = ?", [now]);
}

/** One more send of a due button's card tried; answers the attempts so far. An ended row is not counted. */
export function buttonTried(db: Db, key: DeferredKey): Result<{ attempts: number }> {
  return tx(db, (d) => {
    d.prepare(
      "UPDATE kanban_deferred_buttons SET attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE subscription_id = ? AND event_id = ? AND state IN ('held', 'due')",
    ).run(key.subscriptionId, key.eventId);
    const row = d
      .prepare<[number, number], { attempts: number }>('SELECT attempts FROM kanban_deferred_buttons WHERE subscription_id = ? AND event_id = ?')
      .get(key.subscriptionId, key.eventId);
    if (row === undefined) return refuse('not_found', `no deferred button for subscription ${key.subscriptionId} and event ${key.eventId}`);
    return { ok: true, attempts: row.attempts };
  });
}
```

```ts
/** Where a deferred Unblock button stands (wake spec §5.9): `held` for the agent, `due` to people, then ended once. */
export type DeferredState = 'held' | 'due' | 'sent' | 'lifted' | 'failed';

/** Why a deferred button is due (wake spec §5.9), which its card's text says. */
export type DeferredWhy = 'tried' | 'not_woken' | 'turn_failed' | 'running' | 'restart';

/** A deferred button's key: the subscription whose notice left it out, and the block event (wake spec §4.2). */
export interface DeferredKey {
  subscriptionId: number;
  eventId: number;
}

/**
 * A block's Unblock button the waker deferred (wake spec §5.9): written `held`
 * once its notice, without the button, was sent; `due` once the agent has had
 * its try or will get none; then `sent`, with its card, `lifted`, or `failed`.
 */
export interface DeferredButtonRow extends DeferredKey {
  taskId: string;
  appId: string;
  /** When its notice, without the button, was sent. */
  heldAt: number;
  state: DeferredState;
  why: DeferredWhy | null;
  /** Sends of the button card tried. */
  attempts: number;
  /** The button card, once sent. */
  messageId: string | null;
  endedAt: number | null;
}

/** One outcome a woken turn was told of (wake spec §4.2). */
```

### Task 41: The notifier defers

**Files:**

- Create: `tests/wake-notifier-defer.test.ts`
- Modify: `src/kanban/chat-render.ts`, `src/kanban/notices.ts`

§5.9 and §13. `NotifierDeps` gains `wouldDefer(sub, event)`, the waker's read, given only when the waker runs. For the latest block of each task in a batch, the one an Unblock button would be drawn for, the notifier asks it: a block it answers true for is left out of the buttons, its notice ends with `The agent is looking at it first.` (`AGENT_FIRST_LINE`, in `chat-render.ts`, which the redraw of Task 47 replaces), and the batch is sent as a card even with no button left (`{ card: true }`, Task 39). Once the send succeeded, and before `#advanceAll` moves the cursor, the message is recorded with `has_button` 0 for each deferred block beside its real buttons when Lark answered a card, and each deferral is written `held` by `service.deferButton`, whether the notice went as a card or as text. A failed send writes neither; a record or a deferral that fails is said, and the cursor still moves. Without `wouldDefer`, nothing changes: the notifier's own tests pass as they are. A deferral already written, as for a batch sent again, keeps its row and its time, and is said in the log. Its tests also hold a waker's word that throws (the button stays, said), a `has_button` 0 record that fails (said; the deferral is still written and the cursor moves), and a deferred block leaving its place among the five buttons to the next block.

```ts
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { ChannelError } from '../src/channel/types.js';
import { deferredButton, eventsOf, subscriptionsOf, unblockMessage } from '../src/db/kanban-read.js';
import { unblockButton } from '../src/kanban/chat-render.js';
import { Notifier } from '../src/kanban/notices.js';
import { KanbanService } from '../src/kanban/service.js';
import type { CreatedVia, KanbanEvent, SubscriptionRow, TaskRow } from '../src/kanban/types.js';
import { clearSecrets } from '../src/secrets.js';
import { FakeChannel } from './helpers/channel.js';
import { ManualClock, testDb, type TestDb } from './helpers/db.js';
import { DEFAULT_ROLES } from './helpers/dispatch.js';
import { ALICE, WORKSPACES } from './helpers/kanban.js';

/**
 * The notifier defers a block's Unblock button at the waker's word (wake spec
 * §5.9): the notice goes at once, without the button, ending "The agent is
 * looking at it first.", as a card even with no button left; once the send
 * succeeded, and before the cursor moves, the message is recorded with
 * `has_button` 0 for the block and the deferral written `held`, for a card and
 * for a text notice; a failed send writes neither.
 */

const VIA: CreatedVia = { kind: 'chat', channel: 'lark', appId: 'cli_app', conversationId: 'oc_team', threadId: 'omt_topic' };
const LOOKING = 'The agent is looking at it first.';
const person = { kind: 'person', principal: ALICE } as const;

let t: TestDb;
let clock: ManualClock;
let service: KanbanService;
let lark: FakeChannel;
let notes: string[];
let asked: Array<{ sub: number; event: number; kind: string }>;
let defer: Set<string>;

beforeEach(() => {
  clearSecrets();
  t = testDb();
  clock = new ManualClock();
  service = new KanbanService({ db: t.db, roles: new Map(DEFAULT_ROLES.map((r) => [r.name, r])), workspaces: WORKSPACES, clock });
  lark = new FakeChannel({ id: 'lark', clock });
  notes = [];
  asked = [];
  defer = new Set();
});
afterEach(() => {
  clearSecrets();
  t.close();
});

function notifier(wouldDefer: boolean = true): Notifier {
  return new Notifier({
    db: t.db,
    service,
    channels: new Map([['lark', lark]]),
    appId: 'cli_app',
    blockRecurrenceLimit: 2,
    clock,
    note: (line) => notes.push(line),
    ...(wouldDefer
      ? {
          wouldDefer: (sub: SubscriptionRow, event: KanbanEvent) => {
            asked.push({ sub: sub.id, event: event.id, kind: event.kind });
            return defer.has(event.taskId);
          },
        }
      : {}),
  });
}

function create(title: string): TaskRow {
  const r = service.create({ title, assignee: 'implementer', createdBy: ALICE, createdVia: VIA });
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.message);
  return r.task;
}

function blocked(title: string): { task: TaskRow; block: number; sub: SubscriptionRow } {
  const task = create(title);
  expect(service.block(task.taskId, person, { kind: 'needs_input', reason: 'which wiki?' }).ok).toBe(true);
  const block = eventsOf(t.db, task.taskId).find((e) => e.kind === 'blocked')?.id ?? 0;
  const sub = subscriptionsOf(t.db, task.taskId)[0];
  if (sub === undefined) throw new Error('no subscription');
  return { task, block, sub };
}

function cursorOf(task: TaskRow): number {
  return subscriptionsOf(t.db, task.taskId)[0]?.cursor ?? -1;
}

describe('the notifier, asked to defer a block', () => {
  it('sends the notice at once as a card with no button, ending with its line, and records it and the deferral before the cursor moves', async () => {
    const b = blocked('Draft the agenda');
    defer.add(b.task.taskId);
    clock.advance(123_000);
    expect(await notifier().deliver()).toBe(1);
    expect(lark.texts).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(lark.texts[0]?.buttons).toBeUndefined();
    expect(lark.texts[0]?.card).toBe(true);
    const notice = lark.texts[0]?.text.split('\n\n').at(-1) ?? '';
    expect(notice.endsWith(`\n${LOOKING}`)).toBe(true);

      { taskId: b.task.taskId, blockEvent: b.block, redrawnFor: null, hasButton: false, deferred: 'held' },
    ]);
    expect(deferredButton(t.db, b.sub.id, b.block)).toMatchObject({ state: 'held', heldAt: 1_760_000_123_000 });
    expect(cursorOf(b.task)).toBe(b.block);
```
