```ts
  #unblocks<N extends { event: KanbanEvent; sub: SubscriptionRow }>(batch: readonly N[]): { buttons: CardButton[]; deferred: N[] } {
    const latest = new Map<string, N>();
    for (const n of batch) if (blocksTask(n.event)) latest.set(n.event.taskId, n);
    const blocks = [...latest.values()].sort((a, b) => a.event.id - b.event.id);
    const wouldDefer = this.#deps.wouldDefer;
    const deferred = wouldDefer === undefined ? [] : blocks.filter((n) => this.#asks(wouldDefer, n.sub, n.event));
    return {
      buttons: blocks
        .filter((n) => !deferred.includes(n))
        .slice(0, UNBLOCK_BUTTONS)
        .map((n) => unblockButton(this.#deps.appId, n.event)),

  #asks(wouldDefer: NonNullable<NotifierDeps['wouldDefer']>, sub: SubscriptionRow, event: KanbanEvent): boolean {
    try {
      return wouldDefer(sub, event);
    } catch (err) {
      this.#note(`kanban: asking whether to defer the Unblock button of task ${event.taskId} failed (${message(err)}); it stays on its notice`);
      return false;

   * cannot be written is said, and the cursor still moves: the notice then says
   * the agent is looking at it first, with no button to follow, and its typed
   * commands still unblock it.

  #defer(sub: SubscriptionRow, event: KanbanEvent): void {
    let why: string | undefined;
    try {
      const r = this.#deps.service.deferButton(sub, event, this.#clock.now());
      if (!r.ok) why = r.message;
      else if (!r.deferred) {
        // A batch sent again, after a failed send or a restart: the first send's row stands, its time with it.
        this.#note(`kanban: the Unblock button of task ${event.taskId} (event ${event.id}) was deferred already; its row is kept as it was`);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      why = message(err);
    }
    if (why !== undefined) {
      this.#note(`kanban: deferring the Unblock button of task ${event.taskId} (event ${event.id}) failed (${why}); its notice will get no button card`);
```

§5.9. The read the notifier asks at render, which writes nothing: true when a `kanban_deferred_buttons` row already exists for the subscription and event, whatever else holds, so a batch sent again after a failed send or a restart is rendered as the first one was; otherwise true only when the agent could lift the block. That is a run's block (§2.2: a run's `blocked` not of `dependency`, or a `run_ended` whose `next` is `blocked`) of a task with wake on, past the subscription's `wake_cursor`, in a conversation admitted and not let go of by the notifier, set by someone with talk tier and operate tier, whose `blockRecurrences` is below `kanban.block_recurrence_limit` and whose task's `wokenUnblocksSince` is below `kanban.wake.max_depth`. The notifier is not given it yet: Task 48 wires it.

```ts
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { deferButton, unblock } from '../src/db/kanban.js';
import { getSubscription, subscriptionsOf } from '../src/db/kanban-read.js';
import type { KanbanEvent, SubscriptionRow, TaskRow } from '../src/kanban/types.js';
import { clearSecrets } from '../src/secrets.js';
import { ALICE, NOW } from './helpers/kanban.js';
import { BOB, wakeHarness, type WakeHarness } from './helpers/waker.js';

/**
 * The waker's word on a block's Unblock button (wake spec §5.9): true when a
 * deferral is already written for it, whatever else holds, so the decision is
 * sticky; otherwise true only when the agent could lift the block: a run's
 * block of a task with wake on, past the wake cursor, in a conversation admitted
 * and not let go of, set by someone with talk and operate tier, below both
 * unblock limits. A read: it writes nothing.
 */

let h: WakeHarness;
let letGo: boolean;
let admitted: 'chat_not_allowed' | 'dm_disabled' | undefined;

beforeEach(() => {
  clearSecrets();
  letGo = false;
  admitted = undefined;
  h = wakeHarness({ letGo: () => letGo, admitsConversation: () => admitted });
});
afterEach(() => {
  clearSecrets();
  h.t.close();
});

function asEvent(h: WakeHarness, id: number): KanbanEvent {
  const e = h.db
    .prepare<[number], { id: number; task_id: string; run_id: string | null; kind: string; actor: string; payload: string; created_at: number }>(
      'SELECT id, task_id, run_id, kind, actor, json(payload) AS payload, created_at FROM kanban_events WHERE id = ?',
    )
    .get(id);
  if (e === undefined) throw new Error(`no event ${id}`);
  return { id: e.id, taskId: e.task_id, runId: e.run_id, kind: e.kind, actor: e.actor, payload: JSON.parse(e.payload), createdAt: e.created_at };
}

function subOf(task: TaskRow): SubscriptionRow {
  const s = subscriptionsOf(h.db, task.taskId)[0];
  if (s === undefined) throw new Error('no subscription');
  return getSubscription(h.db, s.id) ?? s;
}

function runBlock(task: TaskRow, extra: Record<string, unknown> = {}): KanbanEvent {
  h.db.prepare("UPDATE kanban_tasks SET phase = 'blocked', blocked_from = 'open', block_kind = 'needs_input' WHERE task_id = ?").run(task.taskId);
  return asEvent(h, h.event(task, 'blocked', 'run:r_1', { kind: 'needs_input', reason: 'which?', blockRecurrences: 1, ...extra }, false));
}

describe('Waker.wouldDefer', () => {
  it("says yes for a run's block the agent could lift", () => {
    const task = h.woken();
    const e = runBlock(task);
    expect(h.waker.wouldDefer(subOf(task), e)).toBe(true);
    // A read: nothing is written.
    expect(h.db.prepare<[], { n: number }>('SELECT count(*) AS n FROM kanban_deferred_buttons').get()?.n).toBe(0);
  });

  it("says yes for a run's end that blocks, and no for one that retries", () => {
    const task = h.woken();
    const blocks = asEvent(h, h.event(task, 'run_ended', 'run:r_1', { outcome: 'blocked', next: 'blocked', blockKind: 'gave_up', blockReason: 'tried twice' }, false));
    const retries = asEvent(h, h.event(task, 'run_ended', 'run:r_1', { outcome: 'failed', next: 'retry' }, false));
    expect(h.waker.wouldDefer(subOf(task), blocks)).toBe(true);
    expect(h.waker.wouldDefer(subOf(task), retries)).toBe(false);
  });

  it("says no for a person's block, a dependency, and a task with wake off", () => {
    const task = h.woken();
    const byPerson = asEvent(h, h.event(task, 'blocked', ALICE, { kind: 'needs_input', reason: 'mine' }, false));
    const dependency = asEvent(h, h.event(task, 'blocked', 'run:r_1', { kind: 'dependency', reason: 'parents' }, false));
    expect(h.waker.wouldDefer(subOf(task), byPerson)).toBe(false);
    expect(h.waker.wouldDefer(subOf(task), dependency)).toBe(false);
    const off = h.woken();
    h.db.prepare('UPDATE kanban_tasks SET wake_by = NULL WHERE task_id = ?').run(off.taskId);
    expect(h.waker.wouldDefer(subOf(off), runBlock(off))).toBe(false);
  });

  it('says no for an event at or before the wake cursor, which the waker will not read', () => {
    const task = h.woken();
    const e = runBlock(task);
    h.db.prepare('UPDATE kanban_subscriptions SET wake_cursor = ? WHERE task_id = ?').run(e.id, task.taskId);
    expect(h.waker.wouldDefer(subOf(task), e)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('says no for a conversation let go of, or not admitted', () => {
    const task = h.woken();
    const e = runBlock(task);
    letGo = true;
    expect(h.waker.wouldDefer(subOf(task), e)).toBe(false);
    letGo = false;
    admitted = 'chat_not_allowed';
    expect(h.waker.wouldDefer(subOf(task), e)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('says no when the setter lacks talk tier, or only operate tier is missing', () => {
    const talkOnly = h.woken(BOB);
    expect(h.waker.wouldDefer(subOf(talkOnly), runBlock(talkOnly))).toBe(false);
    const lapsed = h.woken();
    const e = runBlock(lapsed);
    h.talk.delete(ALICE);
    expect(h.waker.wouldDefer(subOf(lapsed), e)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('says no at the recurrence limit, and at the woken-unblock limit', () => {
    const recurring = h.woken();
    expect(h.waker.wouldDefer(subOf(recurring), runBlock(recurring, { blockRecurrences: 3 }))).toBe(false);
    const looped = h.woken();
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i += 1) {
      runBlock(looped);
      const r = unblock(h.db, looped.taskId, ALICE, undefined, NOW + i, { wake: 1 });
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.message);
    }
    expect(h.waker.wouldDefer(subOf(looped), runBlock(looped))).toBe(false);
  });

  it('says yes once a deferral is written, though nothing else holds any more: the decision is sticky', () => {
    const task = h.woken();
    const e = runBlock(task);
    const sub = subOf(task);
    expect(deferButton(h.db, { subscriptionId: sub.id, eventId: e.id }, NOW).ok).toBe(true);
    h.talk.delete(ALICE);
    letGo = true;
    h.db.prepare('UPDATE kanban_subscriptions SET wake_cursor = ? WHERE id = ?').run(e.id, sub.id);
    expect(h.waker.wouldDefer(subOf(task), e)).toBe(true);
  });
});
```

with:

```ts

  /**
   * The waker's word to the notifier on a block's Unblock button (§5.9): whether
   * it waits for the agent's try. A read that writes nothing. True whenever a
   * deferral is already written for the subscription and event, whatever else
   * holds, so a batch sent again is rendered as the first one was; otherwise
   * true only when the agent could lift the block: a run's block (§2.2) of a
   * task with wake on, past the subscription's wake cursor, in a conversation
   * admitted and not let go of, set by someone with talk and operate tier, and
   * below both the recurrence limit and the woken-unblock limit (§9.2).
   */
  wouldDefer(sub: SubscriptionRow, event: KanbanEvent): boolean {
    const deps = this.#deps;
    if (deferredButton(deps.db, sub.id, event.id) !== undefined) return true;
    if (!isBlockOutcome(event) || event.id <= sub.wakeCursor) return false;
    const task = getTask(deps.db, event.taskId);
    if (task === undefined || task.wakeBy === null || task.phase === 'archived') return false;
    const at = threadAtOf(sub);
    if (deps.letGo(at) || deps.admitsConversation(at.conversationId, sub.chatType) !== undefined) return false;
    if (!deps.people.canTalk(task.wakeBy) || !deps.people.canOperate(task.wakeBy)) return false;
    if (recurrencesOf(event) >= deps.blockRecurrenceLimit) return false;
    return wokenUnblocksSince(deps.db, task.taskId) < deps.settings.maxDepth;
  }

  /** A round every `WAKE_POLL_MS`, starting now: the first is the catch-up after a restart (§5.7). */
```

### Task 43: A turn's end decides its deferred blocks

**Files:**

- Create: `tests/wake-deferred-turn.test.ts`
- Modify: `src/kanban/waker.ts`, `tests/helpers/waker.ts`

§5.2 step 1, §5.9 and §7. A delivered wake's `#underWay` entry is now kept until its turn's promise settles, not only until its settling write lands: then, for each of the wake's block events whose deferred button is still `held`, the lift is read (`liftOf`): lifted, `buttonLifted`; still blocked after a turn that ended `completed`, `buttonDue` with `tried`; after `failed`, `cancelled` or `ambiguous`, `turn_failed`. A refused attempt decides nothing: the button waits for the turn that comes. The prompt's block note says the button is deferred, with `kanban.wake.hold_minutes` (`WakerDeps.settings.holdMinutes`, 10 unless given), only when its row is still `held` at the submit, and otherwise keeps Phase 1's notes. A deferred block cut from the prompt by its 4,000 characters has its button released at the submit, `not_woken`, as the agent is not told of it. The `#underWay` entry of a delivered wake is kept until every one of its decision writes has landed: a write that fails is said, and tried again from the next round. A submit that rejects after its prompt reached the agent ends the turn `failed`, so its blocks are `turn_failed`.

```ts
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { deferButton, unblock } from '../src/db/kanban.js';
import { deferredButton, subscriptionsOf } from '../src/db/kanban-read.js';
import type { TaskRow } from '../src/kanban/types.js';
import type { TurnTerminal } from '../src/types.js';
import { clearSecrets } from '../src/secrets.js';
import { settle } from './helpers/db.js';
import { ALICE, NOW } from './helpers/kanban.js';
import { wakeHarness, type WakeHarness } from './helpers/waker.js';

/**
 * A woken turn's end decides its deferred blocks (wake spec §5.9): each still
 * held is read for its lift once the turn's promise settles, `lifted` if it
 * was, else `due`, `tried` after a completed turn and `turn_failed` after any
 * other; the prompt says a block's button is deferred only while its row is
 * still held at the submit (§7); and a deferred block cut from the prompt by
 * its 4,000 characters is released at the submit, `not_woken`, as the agent is
 * not told of it.
 */

const DEFERRED_NOTE =
  'People in this thread have seen this block, but have no Unblock button for it yet: you have the first try. If it is still blocked when your turn ends, or after 10 minutes, the button goes to them.';

let h: WakeHarness;
beforeEach(() => {
  clearSecrets();
  h = wakeHarness();
});
afterEach(() => {
  clearSecrets();
  h.t.close();
});

/** A run's block of a wake-on task, its notice sent without its button: the deferral written. */
function deferredBlock(task: TaskRow, reason = 'which speaker?'): { sub: number; event: number } {
  h.db.prepare("UPDATE kanban_tasks SET phase = 'blocked', blocked_from = 'open', block_kind = 'needs_input' WHERE task_id = ?").run(task.taskId);
  const event = h.event(task, 'blocked', 'run:r_1', { kind: 'needs_input', reason, blockRecurrences: 1 });
  const sub = subscriptionsOf(h.db, task.taskId)[0]?.id ?? 0;
  const r = deferButton(h.db, { subscriptionId: sub, eventId: event }, NOW);
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.message);
  return { sub, event };
}

async function turnEnds(terminal: TurnTerminal): Promise<void> {
  h.registry.actor('s_w1').release(terminal);
  await settle();
}

describe("a woken turn's end", () => {
  it('makes a deferred block still standing due as tried after a completed turn, and tells the prompt the button waits', async () => {
    const task = h.woken();
    const b = deferredBlock(task);
    h.registry.actor('s_w1').answers.push('hold');
    expect(await h.round()).toBe(1);
    const prompt = h.registry.submits[0]?.input.text ?? '';
    expect(prompt).toContain(DEFERRED_NOTE);
    expect(prompt).not.toContain('An Unblock button is on its notice in this thread.');
    expect(prompt).toContain(`If you can answer the block yourself, lift it with mt kanban task unblock ${task.taskId} <comment>`);
    // Delivered, but the turn still runs: the button waits.
    expect(h.wakes()[0]?.state).toBe('delivered');
    expect(deferredButton(h.db, b.sub, b.event)?.state).toBe('held');
    await turnEnds('completed');
    expect(deferredButton(h.db, b.sub, b.event)).toMatchObject({ state: 'due', why: 'tried' });
  });

  it.each(['failed', 'cancelled', 'ambiguous'] as const)('makes it due as turn_failed after a turn that ended %s', async (terminal) => {
    const task = h.woken();
    const b = deferredBlock(task);
    h.registry.actor('s_w1').answers.push('hold');
    await h.round();
    await turnEnds(terminal);
    expect(deferredButton(h.db, b.sub, b.event)).toMatchObject({ state: 'due', why: 'turn_failed' });
  });

  it('makes it lifted, with no card owed, when the agent lifted the block during its turn', async () => {
    const task = h.woken();
    const b = deferredBlock(task);
    h.registry.actor('s_w1').answers.push('hold');
    await h.round();

    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.message);
    await turnEnds('completed');
    expect(deferredButton(h.db, b.sub, b.event)).toMatchObject({ state: 'lifted' });
  });

    const task = h.woken();
    const b = deferredBlock(task);
    h.registry.actor('s_w1').answers.push({ rejectAfterPrompt: new Error('session s_w1 is closed') });
    await h.round();
    await settle();
    expect(h.wakes()[0]?.state).toBe('delivered');
    expect(deferredButton(h.db, b.sub, b.event)).toMatchObject({ state: 'due', why: 'turn_failed' });
  });

  it('keeps the wake in hand until every decision is written, and tries a failed one again from the round', async () => {
    const task = h.woken();
    const b = deferredBlock(task);
    h.registry.actor('s_w1').answers.push('hold');
    await h.round();
    const due = vi.spyOn(h.service, 'buttonDue').mockImplementationOnce(() => {
      throw new Error('database is locked');
    });
    await turnEnds('completed');
    expect(deferredButton(h.db, b.sub, b.event)?.state).toBe('held');
    expect(h.notes.some((n) => n.includes(`event ${b.event} was not moved (database is locked)`))).toBe(true);
    await h.round();
    expect(due).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    expect(deferredButton(h.db, b.sub, b.event)).toMatchObject({ state: 'due', why: 'tried' });
    // Decided: the next round writes nothing more.
    await h.round();
    expect(due).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
  });

  it('decides nothing on a refused attempt: the button still waits for the turn that comes', async () => {
    const task = h.woken();
    const b = deferredBlock(task);
    h.registry.actor('s_w1').answers.push('fail_start');
    await h.round();
    expect(h.wakes()[0]).toMatchObject({ state: 'pending', attempt: 2 });
    expect(deferredButton(h.db, b.sub, b.event)?.state).toBe('held');
  });

  it("uses the button's other note once its row is no longer held at the submit", async () => {
    const task = h.woken();
    const b = deferredBlock(task);
    h.db.prepare("UPDATE kanban_deferred_buttons SET state = 'due', why = 'running'").run();
    await h.round();
    const prompt = h.registry.submits[0]?.input.text ?? '';
    expect(prompt).not.toContain(DEFERRED_NOTE);
    expect(prompt).toContain('Its notice in this thread has no Unblock button; /kanban task unblock lifts it.');
    expect(deferredButton(h.db, b.sub, b.event)?.state).toBe('due');
  });

  it('says the hold in the minutes kanban.wake.hold_minutes gives', async () => {
    h.t.close();
    h = wakeHarness({ settings: { perHour: 6, maxDepth: 5, holdMinutes: 15 } });
    deferredBlock(h.woken());
    await h.round();
    expect(h.registry.submits[0]?.input.text).toContain('If it is still blocked when your turn ends, or after 15 minutes, the button goes to them.');
  });
});

describe('a deferred block cut from the prompt', () => {
  it('has its button released at the submit, not_woken, while the blocks the prompt tells of stay held', async () => {
    const blocks = Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_x, i) => deferredBlock(h.woken(), `${'why '.repeat(150)}${i}`));
    h.registry.actor('s_w1').answers.push('hold');
    await h.round();
    const prompt = h.registry.submits[0]?.input.text ?? '';
    expect(prompt).toMatch(/and \d+ more: \/kanban task list$/);
    const states = blocks.map((b) => deferredButton(h.db, b.sub, b.event));
    const told = states.filter((r) => r?.state === 'held');
    const cut = states.filter((r) => r?.state === 'due');
    expect(told.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(cut.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(told.length + cut.length).toBe(8);
    for (const r of cut) expect(r?.why).toBe('not_woken');
    expect(prompt.match(/no Unblock button for it yet/g)).toHaveLength(told.length);
  });
});
```

```ts
  /** A batch's outcomes but its blocks lifted since (§5.3b): an `unblocked` or `archived` of the task after the block. */
```

with:

```ts

  /**
   * The submit's promise settled (§5.5, §5.9): a wake not yet delivered is
   * refused; a delivered one has its deferred blocks decided by how its turn
   * ended, and its entry is let go of once its settling write has landed.
   */
  #turnEnded(wakeId: number, terminal: TurnTerminal, error: string): void {
    if (this.#stopped) return;
    const entry = this.#underWay.get(wakeId);
    if (entry === undefined) return;
    entry.terminal = terminal;
    if (entry.settled === undefined) {
      this.#ended(wakeId, error);
      return;
    }
    if (entry.settled.outcome === 'delivered') entry.decided = this.#decideButtons(wakeId, terminal);
    this.#forget(wakeId, entry);
  }

  /**
   * A delivered wake's deferred blocks, once its turn ended (§5.9): each still
   * held, its lift read: lifted, no card; still blocked, due, `tried` after a
   * completed turn and `turn_failed` after a failed, cancelled or ambiguous one.
   * True once every write landed; a write that failed is tried again by the
   * next round, from the entry kept for it.
   */
  #decideButtons(wakeId: number, terminal: TurnTerminal): boolean {
    const db = this.#deps.db;
    let landed = true;
    for (const e of wakeEventsOf(db, wakeId)) {
      const row = deferredButton(db, e.subscriptionId, e.eventId);
      if (row?.state !== 'held') continue;
      const key = { subscriptionId: e.subscriptionId, eventId: e.eventId };
      const wrote =
        liftOf(db, e.taskId, e.eventId) !== undefined
          ? this.#buttonWrite(key, () => this.#deps.service.buttonLifted(key))
          : this.#buttonWrite(key, () => this.#deps.service.buttonDue(key, terminal === 'completed' ? 'tried' : 'turn_failed'));
      landed &&= wrote;
    }
    return landed;
  }

  /** A held deferred button of an outcome released, due with `why` (§5.9). */
  #release(c: Covered, why: DeferredWhy): void {
    const key = { subscriptionId: c.sub.id, eventId: c.event.id };
    if (deferredButton(this.#deps.db, key.subscriptionId, key.eventId)?.state !== 'held') return;
    this.#buttonWrite(key, () => this.#deps.service.buttonDue(key, why));
  }

  /** One write of a deferred button, said when it fails: the next round reads the row again. True when it landed. */
  #buttonWrite(key: DeferredKey, write: () => Result<{ changed: boolean }>): boolean {
    try {
      const r = write();
      if (r.ok) return true;
      this.#note(`kanban: the deferred button of subscription ${key.subscriptionId}, event ${key.eventId} was not moved (${r.message})`);
    } catch (err) {
      this.#note(`kanban: the deferred button of subscription ${key.subscriptionId}, event ${key.eventId} was not moved (${message(err)})`);
    }
    return false;
  }

  /**
   * An entry let go of once its settling write has landed and, for a delivered
   * wake, its turn has ended and its deferred blocks are all decided (§5.2 step 1, §5.9).
   */
  #forget(wakeId: number, entry: UnderWay): void {
    if (entry.written !== true) return;
    if (entry.settled?.outcome === 'delivered' && (entry.terminal === undefined || entry.decided !== true)) return;
    this.#underWay.delete(wakeId);
  }

  /** A batch's outcomes but its blocks lifted since (§5.3b): an `unblocked` or `archived` of the task after the block. */
```

### Task 44: A held button released, the hold bounded, a restart, and release mode

**Files:**

- Create: `tests/wake-deferred-release.test.ts`
- Modify: `src/db/kanban-read.ts`, `src/kanban/waker.ts`

§5.9's "Released at once", "The hold is bounded", "Wakes off" and "A stop and a restart". Each round, before any wake, the waker checks every `held` deferred button. Its task gone from the board, `failed`, with one log line; its block lifted, or its task archived, `lifted`; otherwise `due`, `not_woken`, when the conversation is let go of or no longer admitted, wake is off, the setter has lost talk or operate tier, the wake was taken over by another setter than the one its wake runs as, or its event will never be woken (its wake cursor past it and no pending or delivered wake carrying it, as after a pass-over or a dropped batch); `due`, `restart`, when an earlier boot delivered its wake; and once `hold_minutes` have passed since its notice, `due`, `running` while its woken turn runs, `not_woken` otherwise. `WakerDeps.releaseOnly` builds the waker in release mode: it forms no wakes and makes every held row due, `not_woken`. A due button is not sent yet: that is the next task's. `wakesOfEvent` in `src/db/kanban-read.ts` reads the wakes that carry an event. Its tests also drop a batch after ten real refusals, its button then released `not_woken`, and drop a pending row at the check before its submit (§5.3a), the setter's tier lost, with the same release.

- [ ] **Step 44.1: Write the tests.**

Create `tests/wake-deferred-release.test.ts`:

```ts
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { archive, deferButton, setWake, unblock } from '../src/db/kanban.js';
import { deferredButton, subscriptionsOf } from '../src/db/kanban-read.js';
import type { TaskRow } from '../src/kanban/types.js';
import { clearSecrets } from '../src/secrets.js';
import { ALICE, NOW } from './helpers/kanban.js';
import { WAKE_BACKOFF_MAX_MS, WAKE_REFUSALS } from '../src/kanban/waker.js';
import { APP, BOB, wakeHarness, type WakeHarness } from './helpers/waker.js';

/**
 * A deferred button released (wake spec §5.9): each round checks every `held`
 * row and makes it `due` at once whenever the agent will no longer get a real
 * try, `lifted` when its block is lifted or its task archived, and `failed` when
 * its task is gone; a row still held `hold_minutes` after its notice is made
 * due, `running` while its woken turn runs and `not_woken` otherwise; after a
 * restart a row whose wake an earlier boot delivered is due, `restart`; and a
 * waker built in release mode forms no wakes and makes every held row due.
 */

const MINUTE = 60_000;

let admits: 'chat_not_allowed' | 'dm_disabled' | undefined;
let letGo: boolean;
let h: WakeHarness;
beforeEach(() => {
  clearSecrets();
  admits = undefined;
  letGo = false;
  h = wakeHarness({ admitsConversation: () => admits, letGo: () => letGo });
});
afterEach(() => {
  clearSecrets();
  h.t.close();
});

/** A run's block of a wake-on task, its notice sent without its button now: the deferral written. */
function deferredBlock(task: TaskRow): { sub: number; event: number } {
  h.db.prepare("UPDATE kanban_tasks SET phase = 'blocked', blocked_from = 'open', block_kind = 'needs_input' WHERE task_id = ?").run(task.taskId);
  const event = h.event(task, 'blocked', 'run:r_1', { kind: 'needs_input', reason: 'which speaker?', blockRecurrences: 1 });
  const sub = subscriptionsOf(h.db, task.taskId)[0]?.id ?? 0;
  const r = deferButton(h.db, { subscriptionId: sub, eventId: event }, h.clock.now());
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.message);
  return { sub, event };
}

function state(b: { sub: number; event: number }): { state: string; why: string | null } | undefined {
  const r = deferredButton(h.db, b.sub, b.event);
  return r === undefined ? undefined : { state: r.state, why: r.why };
}

describe('a held button released at once', () => {
  it("goes due, not_woken, when the setter's operate tier is lost after the deferral", async () => {
    const b = deferredBlock(h.woken());
    h.operate.delete(ALICE);
    await h.round();
    expect(state(b)).toEqual({ state: 'due', why: 'not_woken' });
  });

  it("goes due, not_woken, when the setter's talk tier is lost", async () => {
    const b = deferredBlock(h.woken());
    h.talk.delete(ALICE);
    await h.round();
    expect(state(b)).toEqual({ state: 'due', why: 'not_woken' });
  });

  it('goes due, not_woken, when wake is turned off', async () => {
    const task = h.woken();
    const b = deferredBlock(task);
    const off = setWake(h.db, task.taskId, { on: false }, ALICE, APP, NOW + 1);
    if (!off.ok) throw new Error(off.message);
    await h.round();
    expect(state(b)).toEqual({ state: 'due', why: 'not_woken' });
  });

  it('goes due, not_woken, when another setter takes the wake over from the one its turn runs as', async () => {
    const task = h.woken();
    const b = deferredBlock(task);
    h.registry.actor('s_w1').answers.push('hold');
    await h.round();
    expect(h.wakes()[0]?.state).toBe('delivered');
    const over = setWake(h.db, task.taskId, { on: true, as: BOB, maxDepth: 5 }, BOB, APP, NOW + 1);
    if (!over.ok) throw new Error(over.message);
    await h.round();
    expect(state(b)).toEqual({ state: 'due', why: 'not_woken' });
  });

  it('goes due, not_woken, when the notifier lets the conversation go, or the gateway no longer admits it', async () => {
    const b = deferredBlock(h.woken());
    letGo = true;
    await h.round();
    expect(state(b)).toEqual({ state: 'due', why: 'not_woken' });
    letGo = false;
    const c = deferredBlock(h.woken());
    admits = 'chat_not_allowed';
    await h.round();
    expect(state(c)).toEqual({ state: 'due', why: 'not_woken' });
  });

  it('goes due, not_woken, once its batch is dropped and its cursor moved past it', async () => {
    const b = deferredBlock(h.woken());
    h.registry.actor('s_w1').answers.push({ reject: new Error('mailbox full') });
    await h.round();
    const pending = h.wakes()[0];
    expect(pending?.state).toBe('pending');
    expect(state(b)?.state).toBe('held');
    const dropped = h.service.dropWake(pending?.wakeId ?? 0, 'dropped after its refusals');
    if (!dropped.ok) throw new Error(dropped.message);
    await h.round();
    expect(state(b)).toEqual({ state: 'due', why: 'not_woken' });
  });

  it('goes due, not_woken, when its batch is dropped after ten refusals in a row', async () => {
    h.t.close();
    // A hold longer than the refusals' pauses, so only the drop releases it.
    h = wakeHarness({ settings: { perHour: 6, maxDepth: 5, holdMinutes: 60 } });
    const b = deferredBlock(h.woken());
    const held = new Error('session s_w1 is quarantined and will not be resumed automatically');
    for (let i = 0; i < WAKE_REFUSALS; i += 1) h.registry.actor('s_w1').answers.push({ reject: held });
    for (let i = 0; i < WAKE_REFUSALS - 1; i += 1) {
      await h.round();
      expect(state(b)?.state).toBe('held');
      await h.clock.delay(WAKE_BACKOFF_MAX_MS);
    }
    await h.round();
    expect(h.wakes()[0]?.state).toBe('dropped');
    await h.round();
    expect(state(b)).toEqual({ state: 'due', why: 'not_woken' });
  });

  it("goes due, not_woken, when its pending row is dropped by the check before the submit, the setter's tier lost", async () => {
    const b = deferredBlock(h.woken());
    h.registry.actor('s_w1').answers.push({ reject: new Error('mailbox full') });
    await h.round();
    expect(h.wakes()[0]?.state).toBe('pending');
    h.talk.delete(ALICE);
    await h.clock.delay(WAKE_BACKOFF_MAX_MS);
    await h.round();
    expect(h.wakes()[0]).toMatchObject({ state: 'dropped' });
    expect(state(b)).toEqual({ state: 'due', why: 'not_woken' });
    expect(h.registry.submits).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('goes lifted, owing no card, when its task is archived', async () => {
    const task = h.woken();
    const b = deferredBlock(task);
    const r = archive(h.db, task.taskId, ALICE, NOW + 1);
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.message);
    await h.round();
    expect(state(b)?.state).toBe('lifted');
  });

  it('goes lifted when its block is lifted before the turn, and no turn is woken for it', async () => {
    const task = h.woken();
    const b = deferredBlock(task);
    const r = unblock(h.db, task.taskId, ALICE, undefined, NOW + 1, { blockedAt: b.event });
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.message);
    expect(await h.round()).toBe(0);
    expect(state(b)?.state).toBe('lifted');
  });

  it('goes failed, with one log line and no card, when its task is deleted from the board', async () => {
    const task = h.woken();
    const b = deferredBlock(task);
    // As a task gone from the board: nothing in the gateway deletes one, so the test does it under the foreign keys.
    h.db.pragma('foreign_keys = OFF');
    h.db.prepare('DELETE FROM kanban_tasks WHERE task_id = ?').run(task.taskId);
    h.db.pragma('foreign_keys = ON');
    await h.round();
    expect(state(b)?.state).toBe('failed');
    expect(h.notes.filter((n) => n.includes(`deferred Unblock button of task ${task.taskId}`))).toEqual([
      `kanban: the deferred Unblock button of task ${task.taskId} (subscription ${b.sub}, event ${b.event}) is dropped: the task is not on the board`,
    ]);
    expect(h.lark.texts).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('stays held while the agent still gets its try', async () => {
    const b = deferredBlock(h.woken());
    h.registry.actor('s_w1').answers.push('hold');
    await h.round();
    await h.round();
    expect(state(b)?.state).toBe('held');
  });
});

describe('the hold, bounded by hold_minutes', () => {
  it('makes a row whose wake still waits due, not_woken, at the limit and not before', async () => {
    const b = deferredBlock(h.woken());
    h.registry.actor('s_w1').answers.push({ reject: new Error('mailbox full') }, { reject: new Error('mailbox full') });
    await h.round();
    h.clock.advance(10 * MINUTE - 1);
    await h.round();
    expect(state(b)?.state).toBe('held');
    h.clock.advance(1);
    await h.round();
    expect(state(b)).toEqual({ state: 'due', why: 'not_woken' });
  });

  it('makes a row whose woken turn still runs due, running', async () => {
    const b = deferredBlock(h.woken());
    h.registry.actor('s_w1').answers.push('hold');
    await h.round();
    h.clock.advance(10 * MINUTE);
    await h.round();
    expect(state(b)).toEqual({ state: 'due', why: 'running' });
    // A turn that ends after that changes nothing: the button has gone.
    h.registry.actor('s_w1').release('completed');
    await h.round();
    expect(state(b)).toEqual({ state: 'due', why: 'running' });
  });

  it('counts in the minutes kanban.wake.hold_minutes gives', async () => {
    h.t.close();
    h = wakeHarness({ settings: { perHour: 6, maxDepth: 5, holdMinutes: 15 } });
    const b = deferredBlock(h.woken());
    h.registry.actor('s_w1').answers.push('hold');
    await h.round();
    h.clock.advance(10 * MINUTE);
    await h.round();
    expect(state(b)?.state).toBe('held');
    h.clock.advance(5 * MINUTE);
    await h.round();
    expect(state(b)).toEqual({ state: 'due', why: 'running' });
  });
});

describe('after a restart', () => {
  it('makes a row whose wake an earlier boot delivered due, restart, at the first round', async () => {
    const b = deferredBlock(h.woken());
    h.registry.actor('s_w1').answers.push('hold');
    await h.round();
    expect(h.wakes()[0]?.state).toBe('delivered');
    h.rebuild();
    await h.round();
    expect(state(b)).toEqual({ state: 'due', why: 'restart' });
  });

  it('leaves a row whose wake is pending waiting within its limit, and makes one past it due at once', async () => {
    const b = deferredBlock(h.woken());
    h.registry.actor('s_w1').answers.push({ reject: new Error('mailbox full') }, 'hold');
    await h.round();
    h.rebuild();
    h.registry.actor('s_w1').answers.length = 0;
    h.registry.actor('s_w1').answers.push({ reject: new Error('mailbox full') });
    await h.round();
    expect(state(b)?.state).toBe('held');
    h.rebuild();
    h.clock.advance(10 * MINUTE);
    await h.round();
    expect(state(b)).toEqual({ state: 'due', why: 'not_woken' });
  });
});

describe('release mode', () => {
  it('forms no wakes, and makes every held row due, not_woken, leaving a due row as it was', async () => {
    h.t.close();
    h = wakeHarness({ releaseOnly: true });
    const b = deferredBlock(h.woken());
    const c = deferredBlock(h.woken());
    h.db.prepare("UPDATE kanban_deferred_buttons SET state = 'due', why = 'tried' WHERE event_id = ?").run(c.event);
    expect(await h.round()).toBe(0);
    expect(h.wakes()).toEqual([]);
    expect(h.registry.submits).toEqual([]);
    expect(state(b)).toEqual({ state: 'due', why: 'not_woken' });
    expect(state(c)).toEqual({ state: 'due', why: 'tried' });
  });
});
```

```ts
/**
 * The wakes that carry a subscription's event and may still tell the agent of
 * it, `pending` or `delivered`, the newest first (wake spec §5.9): what a held
 * deferred button waits on.
 */
export function wakesOfEvent(db: Db, subscriptionId: number, eventId: number): WakeRow[] {
  return db
    .prepare<[number, number], WakeRaw>(
      `SELECT w.* FROM kanban_wakes w JOIN kanban_wake_events we ON we.wake_id = w.wake_id
        WHERE we.subscription_id = ? AND we.event_id = ? AND w.state IN ('pending', 'delivered')
        ORDER BY w.wake_id DESC`,
    )
    .all(subscriptionId, eventId)
    .map(decodeWake);
}
```

```ts
  /** A held deferred button of an outcome released, due with `why` (§5.9). */
```

with:

```ts

  /**
   * Each round, every `held` deferred button checked (§5.9): its task gone,
   * `failed`, with one log line; its block lifted or its task archived,
   * `lifted`; in release mode, `due`, `not_woken`; otherwise `due` with the
   * reason `#heldWhy` gives, or left held while the agent still gets its try.
   */
  #releaseButtons(): void {
    const deps = this.#deps;
    const db = deps.db;
    for (const row of deferredButtons(db, deps.appId)) {
      if (row.state !== 'held') continue;
      const key = { subscriptionId: row.subscriptionId, eventId: row.eventId };
      if (getTask(db, row.taskId) === undefined) {
        this.#buttonWrite(key, () => deps.service.buttonFailed(key));
        this.#note(
          `kanban: the deferred Unblock button of task ${row.taskId} (subscription ${row.subscriptionId}, event ${row.eventId}) is dropped: the task is not on the board`,
        );
        continue;
      }
      if (liftOf(db, row.taskId, row.eventId) !== undefined) {
        this.#buttonWrite(key, () => deps.service.buttonLifted(key));
        continue;
      }
      const why = deps.releaseOnly === true ? 'not_woken' : this.#heldWhy(row);
      if (why !== undefined) this.#buttonWrite(key, () => deps.service.buttonDue(key, why));
    }
  }

  /**
   * Why a held button, its task on the board and its block standing, goes to
   * people now (§5.9), or undefined while the agent still gets its try: the
   * conversation let go of or no longer admitted, wake turned off, its setter's
   * talk or operate tier lost, or the wake taken over by another setter than
   * the one its wake runs as, `not_woken`; the block never to be woken, its
   * cursor past it and no wake carrying it (passed over, or its batch
   * dropped), `not_woken`; its wake delivered by an earlier boot, its turn cut
   * by the restart, `restart`; and once `hold_minutes` have passed since its
   * notice, `running` while its woken turn runs, `not_woken` otherwise.
   */
  #heldWhy(row: DeferredButtonRow): DeferredWhy | undefined {
    const deps = this.#deps;
    const db = deps.db;
    const sub = getSubscription(db, row.subscriptionId);
    const task = getTask(db, row.taskId);
    if (sub === undefined || task === undefined) return 'not_woken';
    const at = threadAtOf(sub);
    if (deps.letGo(at) || deps.admitsConversation(at.conversationId, sub.chatType) !== undefined) return 'not_woken';
    const setter = task.wakeBy;
    if (setter === null || !deps.people.canTalk(setter) || !deps.people.canOperate(setter)) return 'not_woken';
    const wake = wakesOfEvent(db, row.subscriptionId, row.eventId)[0];
    if (wake !== undefined && wake.principal !== setter) return 'not_woken';
    if (wake === undefined && sub.wakeCursor >= row.eventId) return 'not_woken';
    const entry = wake === undefined ? undefined : this.#underWay.get(wake.wakeId);
    if (wake?.state === 'delivered' && entry === undefined) return 'restart';
    const holdMs = (deps.settings.holdMinutes ?? WAKE_DEFAULTS.holdMinutes) * 60_000;
    if (this.#clock.now() - row.heldAt < holdMs) return undefined;
    return wake?.state === 'delivered' && entry?.terminal === undefined ? 'running' : 'not_woken';
  }

  /** A held deferred button of an outcome released, due with `why` (§5.9). */
```

### Task 45: Sending a due button

**Files:**

- Create: `tests/wake-deferred-send.test.ts`
- Modify: `src/db/kanban-read.ts`, `src/kanban/chat-render.ts`, `src/kanban/waker.ts`, `tests/wake-deferred-release.test.ts`, `tests/wake-deferred-turn.test.ts`

§5.9's "Sending a due button", the send itself. At the end of each round the waker sends each `due` deferred button: its lift read first, and a lifted one made `lifted` with no card; a task gone, `failed`; a conversation the notifier has let go of, `failed` at once, with one log line; otherwise one card to the subscription's conversation, replying to the thread's root, with one Unblock button for the block (`unblockButton`), bounded by `NOTICE_SEND_MS`, its uuid `replyUuid(appId, 'wake-button:<subscription>:<event>', 'unblock')`. Its words are `deferredButtonText` in `src/kanban/chat-render.ts`, by why, and a second line with the typed command, `` `/kanban task unblock k_…` lifts it too. ``, as Lark may take the card as text. Once sent: `buttonSent` with the card's message id; the card recorded for the unblock redraw, `has_button` 1, when it went as a card; and the notice that deferred it (`deferredNoticeOf`) redrawn through `WakerDeps.redrawNotice`, which the gateway wires to `UnblockRedraws.redrawMessage` later in this phase. A block lifted while the card's send is slow: the card is still recorded with its button, so the unblock redraw takes it. A send that fails leaves the row due, said in the log, for the next round; the next task adds the pause and the limit. A waker in release mode sends too. The earlier tests that read a released row as `due` now read it `sent`, as it is sent in the same round, or `failed` for the conversation let go of, so their files are in this task's tests.

```ts
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { deferButton, unblock } from '../src/db/kanban.js';
import { deferredButton, hasUnblockButton, subscriptionsOf } from '../src/db/kanban-read.js';
import { replyUuid } from '../src/core/ids.js';
import { unblockButton } from '../src/kanban/chat-render.js';
import type { DeferredWhy, TaskRow } from '../src/kanban/types.js';
import { ChannelError } from '../src/channel/types.js';
import { clearSecrets } from '../src/secrets.js';
import { ALICE, NOW } from './helpers/kanban.js';
import { APP, wakeHarness, type WakeHarness } from './helpers/waker.js';

/**
 * Sending a due button (wake spec §5.9): each round, a due row's lift is read
 * first, and a lifted one owes no card; otherwise one card goes to its
 * conversation, replying to the thread's root, with one Unblock button for the
 * block, its words by why, its uuid the same however often it is tried; once
 * sent, the row is `sent` with the card's message id, the card is recorded for
 * the unblock redraw, and the notice that deferred it is redrawn. Once the
 * notifier has let the conversation go, the row is `failed` at once. A send
 * that fails leaves the row due for the next round. Its words carry the typed
 * command, as Lark may take the card as text.
 */

let letGo: boolean;
let redrawn: string[];
let h: WakeHarness;
function harness(extra: Parameters<typeof wakeHarness>[0] = {}): WakeHarness {
  return wakeHarness({ letGo: () => letGo, redrawNotice: async (messageId) => void redrawn.push(messageId), ...extra });
}
beforeEach(() => {
  clearSecrets();
  letGo = false;
  redrawn = [];
  h = harness();
});
afterEach(() => {
  clearSecrets();
  h.t.close();
});

/**
 * A run's block of a wake-on task whose notice went without its button, as
 * `om_notice`, recorded for its redraw, and whose button is now due with `why`.
 */
function dueBlock(why: DeferredWhy, title = 'Draft the agenda'): { task: TaskRow; sub: number; event: number } {
  const task = h.woken(ALICE, { title });
  h.db.prepare("UPDATE kanban_tasks SET phase = 'blocked', blocked_from = 'open', block_kind = 'needs_input' WHERE task_id = ?").run(task.taskId);
  const event = h.event(task, 'blocked', 'run:r_1', { kind: 'needs_input', reason: 'which speaker?', blockRecurrences: 1 });
  const sub = subscriptionsOf(h.db, task.taskId)[0]?.id ?? 0;
  const key = { subscriptionId: sub, eventId: event };
  const deferred = deferButton(h.db, key, h.clock.now());
  if (!deferred.ok) throw new Error(deferred.message);
  const recorded = h.service.recordUnblockButtons({
    messageId: `om_notice_${event}`,
    channel: 'lark',
    appId: APP,
    markdown: 'blocked: which speaker?\nThe agent is looking at it first.',
    buttons: [{ taskId: task.taskId, blockEvent: event, hasButton: false }],
  });
  if (!recorded.ok) throw new Error(recorded.message);
  const due = h.service.buttonDue(key, why);
  if (!due.ok) throw new Error(due.message);
  // Its wake is past: the turn it was woken for has been and gone.
  h.db.prepare('UPDATE kanban_subscriptions SET wake_cursor = cursor WHERE id = ?').run(sub);
  return { task, sub, event };
}

/** A card's words: its line by why, then the typed command, as Lark may take the card as text. */
function words(line: string, taskId: string): string {
  return `${line}\n\`/kanban task unblock ${taskId}\` lifts it too.`;
}

function buttonCards(): typeof h.lark.texts {
  return h.lark.texts.filter((t) => t.buttons !== undefined);
}

describe('a due button', () => {
  it('goes as one card with one Unblock button, replying in the thread, and is recorded and its notice redrawn', async () => {
    const b = dueBlock('tried');
    await h.round();
    const cards = buttonCards();
    expect(cards).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(cards[0]?.text).toBe(words(`The agent could not lift the block on \`${b.task.taskId}\` **Draft the agenda**.`, b.task.taskId));
    expect(cards[0]?.buttons).toEqual([unblockButton(APP, { id: b.event, taskId: b.task.taskId })]);
    expect(cards[0]?.uuid).toBe(replyUuid(APP, `wake-button:${b.sub}:${b.event}`, 'unblock'));
    expect(cards[0]?.target).toMatchObject({ chatId: 'oc_chat', threadId: 'omt_1', root: 'om_root' });
    const row = deferredButton(h.db, b.sub, b.event);
    expect(row?.state).toBe('sent');
    expect(row?.messageId).toMatch(/^om_text_/);
    // The card is an Unblock button's record, so a later lift redraws it.
    expect(hasUnblockButton(h.db, APP, b.task.taskId, b.event)).toBe(true);
    expect(redrawn).toEqual([`om_notice_${b.event}`]);
    await h.round();
    expect(buttonCards()).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it.each([
    ['tried', 'The agent could not lift the block on `{id}` **Draft the agenda**.'],
    ['turn_failed', "The agent's turn ended without lifting the block on `{id}` **Draft the agenda**."],
    ['running', 'The agent is still working on the block on `{id}` **Draft the agenda**; lift it here if you can answer it.'],
    ['not_woken', 'The agent was not woken for the block on `{id}` **Draft the agenda**; lift it here.'],
    ['restart', 'The agent was not woken for the block on `{id}` **Draft the agenda**; lift it here.'],
  ] as const)('says, for %s, %s', async (why, line) => {
    const b = dueBlock(why);
    await h.round();
    expect(buttonCards()[0]?.text).toBe(words(line.replace('{id}', b.task.taskId), b.task.taskId));
  });

  it('owes no card once its block is lifted before the send', async () => {
```

```ts
/**
 * The card a deferred Unblock button goes in once it is due (wake spec §5.9):
 * the task by id and title, the reason not repeated, worded by why it is due.
 */
export function deferredButtonText(why: DeferredWhy, taskId: string, title: string, nameOf?: NameOf): string {
  return `${deferredButtonLine(why, taskId, title, nameOf)}\n${typedUnblock(taskId)} lifts it too.`;
}

/** The card's first line, by why (wake spec §5.9). */
function deferredButtonLine(why: DeferredWhy, taskId: string, title: string, nameOf?: NameOf): string {
  const block = `the block on ${id(taskId)} **${titleText(title, nameOf)}**`;
  switch (why) {
    case 'tried':
      return `The agent could not lift ${block}.`;
    case 'turn_failed':
      return `The agent's turn ended without lifting ${block}.`;
    case 'running':
      return `The agent is still working on ${block}; lift it here if you can answer it.`;
    case 'not_woken':
    case 'restart':
      return `The agent was not woken for ${block}; lift it here.`;
  }
}

/**
 * The typed command that lifts a block, for a card whose button may not
 * arrive: Lark can refuse a card and take its text alone.
 */
export function typedUnblock(taskId: string): string {
  return `\`/kanban task unblock ${taskId}\``;
}
```

```ts
  }

  /**
   * Each due deferred button sent (§5.9), the waker's own send: its lift read
   * first, and a lifted one owes no card; then one card to its conversation,
   * replying to the thread's root, with one Unblock button for the block,
   * bounded by the notifier's bound, its uuid the same however often it is
   * tried. Once sent: `sent` with the card's message id, the card recorded for
   * the unblock redraw when it went as a card, and the notice that deferred it
   * redrawn. A conversation the notifier has let go of makes the row `failed`
   * at once, with one log line. A send that fails leaves the row due, said in
   * the log, for the next round; nothing more is sent once stopped.
   */
  async #sendButtons(): Promise<void> {
    const deps = this.#deps;
    const db = deps.db;
    for (const row of deferredButtons(db, deps.appId)) {
      if (this.#stopped) return;
      if (row.state !== 'due') continue;
      const key = { subscriptionId: row.subscriptionId, eventId: row.eventId };
      const which = `task ${row.taskId} (subscription ${row.subscriptionId}, event ${row.eventId})`;
      const task = getTask(db, row.taskId);
      const sub = getSubscription(db, row.subscriptionId);
      if (task === undefined || sub === undefined) {
        this.#buttonWrite(key, () => deps.service.buttonFailed(key));
        this.#note(`kanban: the deferred Unblock button of ${which} is dropped: the task is not on the board`);
        continue;
      }
      if (liftOf(db, row.taskId, row.eventId) !== undefined) {
        this.#buttonWrite(key, () => deps.service.buttonLifted(key));
        continue;
      }
      const at = threadAtOf(sub);
      if (deps.letGo(at)) {
        this.#buttonWrite(key, () => deps.service.buttonFailed(key));
        this.#note(`kanban: the Unblock button of ${which} is dropped: the notifier has let ${describe(at)} go`);
        continue;
      }
      const channel = deps.channels.get(sub.channel);
      if (channel === undefined) {
        this.#note(`kanban: no channel ${sub.channel} for the Unblock button of ${which}`);
        continue;
      }
      const text = redactKnownSecrets(deferredButtonText(row.why ?? 'not_woken', task.taskId, task.title, deps.people.chatNames()));
      const uuid = replyUuid(deps.appId, `wake-button:${row.subscriptionId}:${row.eventId}`, 'unblock');
      let sent: SendResult;
      try {
        sent = await this.#bounded(channel.sendText(targetOf(db, at), text, uuid, [unblockButton(deps.appId, { id: row.eventId, taskId: row.taskId })]));
      } catch (err) {
        this.#note(`kanban: the Unblock button of ${which} was not sent (${message(err)}); trying again next round`);
        continue;
      }
      this.#buttonWrite(key, () => deps.service.buttonSent(key, sent.messageId));
      // Recorded as any Unblock card, so a later lift redraws it; a card that went as text has no button to redraw.
      if (sent.card !== false) {
        try {
          const r = deps.service.recordUnblockButtons({
            messageId: sent.messageId,
            channel: sub.channel,
            appId: deps.appId,
            markdown: text,
            buttons: [{ taskId: row.taskId, blockEvent: row.eventId }],
          });
          if (!r.ok) this.#note(`kanban: recording the Unblock button of ${which} failed (${r.message}); it will not be redrawn`);
        } catch (err) {
          this.#note(`kanban: recording the Unblock button of ${which} failed (${message(err)}); it will not be redrawn`);
        }
      }
      const notice = deferredNoticeOf(db, deps.appId, row.taskId, row.eventId);
      if (notice !== undefined) void deps.redrawNotice?.(notice);
    }
  }

  /** A send, waited for at most the notifier's bound; past it, it fails here, and may still land. */
  async #bounded<T>(send: Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    const ms = this.#deps.sendTimeoutMs ?? NOTICE_SEND_MS;
    let timer: NodeJS.Timeout | undefined;
    const late = new Promise<never>((_resolve, reject) => {
      timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error(`the send took longer than ${ms < 1000 ? `${ms} ms` : `${Math.round(ms / 1000)} s`}`)), ms);
    });
    try {
      return await Promise.race([send, late]);
    } finally {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      send.catch(() => undefined);
    }
  }
```

### Task 46: A due button's retries, its tenth failure, and the round's budget

**Files:**

- Modify: `src/kanban/waker.ts`, `tests/wake-deferred-send.test.ts`

§5.9's last rules for a due button's send. A send that fails is counted (`buttonTried`) and tried again after a pause of 2 s doubling to five minutes, in memory; after `WAKE_REFUSALS` tries the row is `failed`, with one log line, `/kanban task unblock` still lifting the block. A row whose subscription's channel the gateway has not got is counted as a failed try, so it too is `failed` at the tenth. And none starts once the round has spent its `ROUND_MARKER_MS`, which the markers share (§5.5 step 3): a slow marker leaves the buttons for the next round, and so does a slow button the ones after it.

```ts
  /** A due button's card that did not go (§5.9): tried again after the pause, failed after `WAKE_REFUSALS` tries. */
  #buttonFailedSend(key: DeferredKey, which: string, pauseKey: string, why: string): void {
    let attempts: number;
    try {
      const r = this.#deps.service.buttonTried(key);
      if (!r.ok) {
        this.#note(`kanban: the Unblock button of ${which} was not sent (${why}), and its try not counted (${r.message})`);
        return;
      }
      attempts = r.attempts;
    } catch (err) {
      this.#note(`kanban: the Unblock button of ${which} was not sent (${why}), and its try not counted (${message(err)})`);
      return;
    }
    if (attempts >= WAKE_REFUSALS) {
      this.#buttonPause.delete(pauseKey);
      this.#buttonWrite(key, () => this.#deps.service.buttonFailed(key));
      this.#note(`kanban: the Unblock button of ${which} was not sent after ${WAKE_REFUSALS} tries (${why}); /kanban task unblock still lifts it`);
      return;
    }
    const waitMs = Math.min((this.#buttonPause.get(pauseKey)?.waitMs ?? WAKE_POLL_MS / 2) * 2, WAKE_BACKOFF_MAX_MS);
    this.#buttonPause.set(pauseKey, { until: this.#clock.now() + waitMs, waitMs });
  }

  /** A send, waited for at most the notifier's bound; past it, it fails here, and may still land. */
```

### Task 47: The redraw of a buttonless notice

**Files:**

- Create: `tests/wake-deferred-redraw.test.ts`
- Modify: `src/db/kanban-read.ts`, `src/kanban/chat-render.ts`

§5.9's "The redraw of a notice that deferred a button". `renderUnblockRedraw` reads each row's `hasButton` and, for a `has_button` 0 row, its deferred button's state, both of which `unblockMessage` already gives (Task 40) and `UnblockShown` now carries: for each such row whose button card is `sent`, that block's `The agent is looking at it first.` reads `The agent could not lift it; the Unblock button is below.` (`AGENT_COULD_NOT_LINE`), the Nth sentence of the message the Nth such row's by block event; every lifted row gains its lifted line, button or not, as before; and buttons are drawn only for rows with a button and no lift. The waker's send (Task 45) asks for the notice's redraw by `redrawMessage`; a later lift is found by the redraw loop, as any lift is. Only the line the notifier wrote is replaced, matched as a line of its own at a notice's end (`/\nThe agent is looking at it first\.(?=\n\n|$)/`), so a block's reason that quotes the sentence is left as it is. A button card that went as text, so no button came (its message holds no `kanban_unblock_buttons` row), reads `` The agent could not lift it; `/kanban task unblock k_…` lifts it. `` instead; `unblockMessage` gives that as `deferredAsText`.

```ts
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { buttonDue, buttonSent, deferButton, unblock } from '../src/db/kanban.js';
import { subscriptionsOf } from '../src/db/kanban-read.js';
import { AGENT_FIRST_LINE, AGENT_COULD_NOT_LINE, agentCouldNotTyped, renderUnblockRedraw, unblockButton, type UnblockShown } from '../src/kanban/chat-render.js';
import { KanbanService } from '../src/kanban/service.js';
import { UnblockRedraws } from '../src/kanban/unblock-redraw.js';
import type { TaskRow } from '../src/kanban/types.js';
import { FakeChannel } from './helpers/channel.js';
import { ManualClock, testDb, type TestDb } from './helpers/db.js';
import { ALICE, newTask, WORKSPACES } from './helpers/kanban.js';
import { APP, IN_THREAD } from './helpers/waker.js';

/**
 * The redraw of a notice that deferred a button (wake spec §5.9): for each of
 * its `has_button` 0 rows whose button card was sent, that block's "The agent
 * is looking at it first." reads "The agent could not lift it; the Unblock
 * button is below.", the Nth sentence the Nth such row's by block event; every
 * lifted row gains its lifted line, button or not; and buttons are drawn only
 * for rows with a button and no lift. A card that went as text, so no button
 * came, has the typed command said instead; and only the line the notifier
 * wrote is replaced, never the sentence quoted in a block's reason.
 */

const when = (): string => '14:05';

function notice(blocks: number): string {
  return Array.from({ length: blocks }, (_x, i) => `\`k_${i}\` is blocked: why ${i}?\n${AGENT_FIRST_LINE}`).join('\n\n');
}

describe('renderUnblockRedraw of a notice with deferred buttons', () => {
  it('leaves a held deferral as sent, and draws no button for it', () => {
    const view = renderUnblockRedraw(APP, notice(1), [{ taskId: 'k_0', blockEvent: 7, hasButton: false, deferred: 'held' }], when);
    expect(view).toEqual({ markdown: notice(1), buttons: [] });
  });

  it("replaces a sent deferral's sentence with the line that the button is below", () => {
    const view = renderUnblockRedraw(APP, notice(1), [{ taskId: 'k_0', blockEvent: 7, hasButton: false, deferred: 'sent' }], when);
    expect(view.markdown).toBe(`\`k_0\` is blocked: why 0?\n${AGENT_COULD_NOT_LINE}`);
    expect(AGENT_COULD_NOT_LINE).toBe('The agent could not lift it; the Unblock button is below.');
    expect(view.buttons).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('says the typed command instead when the button card went as text, so no button came', () => {
    const view = renderUnblockRedraw(APP, notice(1), [{ taskId: 'k_0', blockEvent: 7, hasButton: false, deferred: 'sent', deferredAsText: true }], when);
    expect(view.markdown).toBe('`k_0` is blocked: why 0?\nThe agent could not lift it; `/kanban task unblock k_0` lifts it.');
    expect(agentCouldNotTyped('k_0')).toBe('The agent could not lift it; `/kanban task unblock k_0` lifts it.');
  });

  it('replaces only the line the notifier wrote, never the sentence quoted in a reason', () => {
    const quoted = `\`k_0\` is blocked: they said "The agent is looking at it first." twice\n${AGENT_FIRST_LINE}`;
    const inline = `\`k_1\` is blocked: why?\nThe agent is looking at it first. Or not.\n${AGENT_FIRST_LINE}`;
    const rows: UnblockShown[] = [
      { taskId: 'k_0', blockEvent: 7, hasButton: false, deferred: 'sent' },
      { taskId: 'k_1', blockEvent: 8, hasButton: false, deferred: 'sent' },
    ];
    const view = renderUnblockRedraw(APP, `${quoted}\n\n${inline}`, rows, when);
    expect(view.markdown).toBe(
      `\`k_0\` is blocked: they said "The agent is looking at it first." twice\n${AGENT_COULD_NOT_LINE}\n\n` +
        `\`k_1\` is blocked: why?\nThe agent is looking at it first. Or not.\n${AGENT_COULD_NOT_LINE}`,
    );
  });

  it('replaces the Nth sentence for the Nth deferred row, in block event order', () => {
    const rows: UnblockShown[] = [
      { taskId: 'k_0', blockEvent: 7, hasButton: false, deferred: 'held' },
      { taskId: 'k_1', blockEvent: 8, hasButton: false, deferred: 'sent' },
      { taskId: 'k_2', blockEvent: 9, hasButton: false, deferred: 'due' },
    ];
    const view = renderUnblockRedraw(APP, notice(3), rows, when);
    expect(view.markdown.split('\n').filter((l) => l === AGENT_FIRST_LINE || l === AGENT_COULD_NOT_LINE)).toEqual([
      AGENT_FIRST_LINE,
      AGENT_COULD_NOT_LINE,
      AGENT_FIRST_LINE,
    ]);
  });

  it('adds the lifted line for a deferred row, and draws a button only for a real one not lifted', () => {
    const rows: UnblockShown[] = [
      { taskId: 'k_0', blockEvent: 7, hasButton: false, deferred: 'lifted', lift: { kind: 'unblocked', actor: ALICE, at: 1, woken: true } },
      { taskId: 'k_1', blockEvent: 8, hasButton: true },
    ];
    const view = renderUnblockRedraw(APP, notice(1), rows, when, (p) => (p === ALICE ? 'Zhixi Sun' : undefined));
    expect(view.markdown).toBe(`${notice(1)}\n\n\`k_0\`: Unblocked by Zhixi Sun (woken by the board) at 14:05`);
    expect(view.buttons).toEqual([unblockButton(APP, { id: 8, taskId: 'k_1' })]);
  });
});

describe('UnblockRedraws of a buttonless notice', () => {
  let t: TestDb;
  let clock: ManualClock;
  let service: KanbanService;
  let lark: FakeChannel;
  beforeEach(() => {
    t = testDb();
    clock = new ManualClock();
    service = new KanbanService({ db: t.db, roles: new Map(), workspaces: WORKSPACES, clock });
    lark = new FakeChannel({ id: 'lark', clock });
  });
  afterEach(() => t.close());

  function redraws(): UnblockRedraws {
    return new UnblockRedraws({ db: t.db, service, channels: new Map([['lark', lark]]), appId: APP, zone: 'UTC' });
  }

  function deferredNotice(): { task: TaskRow; sub: number; event: number } {
    const task = newTask(t.db, { createdVia: IN_THREAD });
    t.db.prepare("UPDATE kanban_tasks SET phase = 'blocked', blocked_from = 'open', block_kind = 'needs_input' WHERE task_id = ?").run(task.taskId);
    t.db
      .prepare("INSERT INTO kanban_events (task_id, kind, actor, payload, created_at) VALUES (?, 'blocked', 'run:r_1', jsonb(?), ?)")
      .run(task.taskId, JSON.stringify({ kind: 'needs_input', reason: 'which?' }), clock.now());
    const event = t.db.prepare<[], { id: number }>('SELECT max(id) AS id FROM kanban_events').get()?.id ?? 0;
    const sub = subscriptionsOf(t.db, task.taskId)[0]?.id ?? 0;
    const key = { subscriptionId: sub, eventId: event };
    for (const r of [
      deferButton(t.db, key, clock.now()),
      service.recordUnblockButtons({
        messageId: 'om_notice',
        channel: 'lark',
        appId: APP,
        markdown: `\`${task.taskId}\` is blocked: which?\n${AGENT_FIRST_LINE}`,
        buttons: [{ taskId: task.taskId, blockEvent: event, hasButton: false }],
      }),
    ]) {
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.message);
    }
    return { task, sub, event };
  }

  it('redraws the notice once its button card is sent, its sentence replaced and no button drawn', async () => {
    const n = deferredNotice();
    const key = { subscriptionId: n.sub, eventId: n.event };
    for (const r of [
      buttonDue(t.db, key, 'tried'),
      buttonSent(t.db, key, 'om_card', clock.now()),
      // The card, recorded as the waker records one that went as a card.
      service.recordUnblockButtons({ messageId: 'om_card', channel: 'lark', appId: APP, markdown: 'card', buttons: [{ taskId: n.task.taskId, blockEvent: n.event }] }),
    ]) {
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.message);
    }
    await redraws().redrawMessage('om_notice');
    expect(lark.cardUpdates).toEqual([
      { messageId: 'om_notice', view: { markdown: `\`${n.task.taskId}\` is blocked: which?\n${AGENT_COULD_NOT_LINE}`, buttons: [] } },
    ]);
  });

  it('redraws it with the typed command when the button card went as text, unrecorded', async () => {
    const n = deferredNotice();
    const key = { subscriptionId: n.sub, eventId: n.event };
    for (const r of [buttonDue(t.db, key, 'tried'), buttonSent(t.db, key, 'om_plain', clock.now())]) if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.message);
    await redraws().redrawMessage('om_notice');
    expect(lark.cardUpdates[0]?.view.markdown).toBe(
      `\`${n.task.taskId}\` is blocked: which?\nThe agent could not lift it; \`/kanban task unblock ${n.task.taskId}\` lifts it.`,
    );
  });

  it("is found by the loop once its block is lifted, and gains the lift's line", async () => {
    const n = deferredNotice();
    const r = unblock(t.db, n.task.taskId, ALICE, undefined, clock.now(), { blockedAt: n.event });
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.message);
    expect(await redraws().redrawDue()).toBe(1);
    expect(lark.cardUpdates[0]?.view.markdown).toMatch(new RegExp(`^\`${n.task.taskId}\` is blocked: which\\?\\n${AGENT_FIRST_LINE}\\n\\n\`${n.task.taskId}\`: Unblocked by `));
    expect(lark.cardUpdates[0]?.view.buttons).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

```ts
    const turnAt = lark.landed.indexOf('card');
    const card = lark.texts.find((m) => m.text === words);
    expect(lark.landed.indexOf(`text:${words}`)).toBeGreaterThan(turnAt);
    const button = card?.buttons?.[0];
    if (card === undefined || button === undefined || card.buttons?.length !== 1) throw new Error('no Unblock on the button card');
    expect(button.value['task']).toBe(taskId);
    const db = gateway?.db;
    const row = (): { state: string; why: string; message_id: string | null } | undefined =>
      db?.prepare('SELECT state, why, message_id FROM kanban_deferred_buttons WHERE task_id = ?').get(taskId) as { state: string; why: string; message_id: string | null } | undefined;
    expect(row()).toMatchObject({ state: 'sent', why: 'tried' });
    const noticeId = (db?.prepare('SELECT message_id FROM kanban_unblock_buttons WHERE task_id = ? AND has_button = 0').get(taskId) as { message_id: string } | undefined)?.message_id;
    if (noticeId === undefined) throw new Error('no record of the notice');
    await until('the notice redrawn with the button below', () => lark.cardUpdates.some((u) => u.messageId === noticeId));
    expect(lark.cardUpdates.find((u) => u.messageId === noticeId)?.view).toMatchObject({ buttons: [] });
    expect(lark.cardUpdates.find((u) => u.messageId === noticeId)?.view.markdown).toContain(AGENT_COULD_NOT_LINE);

    // A person's press of the card's Unblock: the card loses its button, and the notice gains the lifted line.
    const cardId = row()?.message_id ?? '';
    await press(OWNER, cardId, button.value);
    await until('the card redrawn', () => lark.cardUpdates.some((u) => u.messageId === cardId));
    const drawn = lark.cardUpdates.find((u) => u.messageId === cardId)?.view;
    expect(drawn?.buttons).toEqual([]);
    expect(drawn?.markdown).toMatch(new RegExp(`\`${taskId}\`: Unblocked by Alice at \\d\\d:\\d\\d$`));
    await until('the notice redrawn with the lift', () => lark.cardUpdates.filter((u) => u.messageId === noticeId).length === 2);
    const again = lark.cardUpdates.filter((u) => u.messageId === noticeId)[1]?.view;
    expect(again?.buttons).toEqual([]);
    expect(again?.markdown).toContain(AGENT_COULD_NOT_LINE);
    expect(again?.markdown).toMatch(new RegExp(`\`${taskId}\`: Unblocked by Alice at \\d\\d:\\d\\d$`));
    await until('the task to complete', () => phaseOf(taskId) === 'done');
```

## Phase 3: role targets and reaction tasks

Tasks 49 to 63, the wake spec's §19. A wake may name a role: its outcomes make a reaction task that role runs on the board, through the dispatcher, scoped by the wake rows to the worker commands `wake-show` and `wake-unblock`. Phase 3 ends green and can be merged on top of Phases 1 and 2.

---

### Task 49: A role as a wake's target, in the writer and the service

**Files:**

- Create: `tests/wake-role.test.ts`
- Modify: `src/db/WRITERS.md`, `src/db/kanban.ts`, `src/kanban/service.ts`, `src/kanban/types.ts`

§19.1, §19.3 and §4.3's rows for §19. `kanban_tasks.wake_role` is written with `wake_by` and cleared with it: by `createTask` and `applyDag`'s inserts (`NewWake.role`), copied by a run's follow-up with its setter and depth, and by `setWake` (`WakeChange.role`), where a switch of target with the same setter is a change and the `wake_set` names its `role`. `setWake` refuses a reaction task. The service checks the role when a wake is set, on `setWake`, `create` and a start (`StartWake.role`), by `assignable`. Who may name a role, operate tier, is the caller's, as who may set any wake is, so nothing in chat or at the terminal changes yet; the waker still reads only `wake_by`, and Task 56 batches a role's wake apart.

- [ ] **Step 49.1: Write the tests.**

Create `tests/wake-role.test.ts`:

```ts
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { createTask, setWake } from '../src/db/kanban.js';
import { eventsOf, getTask } from '../src/db/kanban-read.js';
import { KanbanService, type KanbanServiceDeps } from '../src/kanban/service.js';
import type { Role } from '../src/roles.js';
import { ManualClock, testDb, type TestDb } from './helpers/db.js';
import { ALICE, NOW, VIA, WORKSPACES, claimed, newTask } from './helpers/kanban.js';

/**
 * A role as a wake's target, in the writer and the service (wake spec §19.1):
 * `wake_role` written with `wake_by` and cleared with it, the `wake_set`'s
 * `role`, a switch of target either way, a run's follow-up inheriting it, a
 * reaction task's wake never set, and the role checked by `assignable` when it
 * is set.
 */

const APP = 'cli_app';
const BOB = 'lark:on_bob';

let h: TestDb;
beforeEach(() => {
  h = testDb();
});
afterEach(() => h.close());

function role(name: string, unsupervised = true): Role {
  return {
    name,
    source: 'directory',
    dir: undefined,
    description: undefined,
    workspace: undefined,
    agent: {
      driver: 'structured-cli',
      command: 'bytesec',
      args: [],
      env: {},
      unsupervised,
      passEnv: [],
      readOnlyTools: [],
      maskExempt: [],
    },
    roleMdPath: undefined,
    skills: [],
    secretValues: [],
  };
}

const ROLES: ReadonlyMap<string, Role> = new Map([
  ['implementer', role('implementer')],
  ['vi-coordinator', role('vi-coordinator')],
  ['watcher', role('watcher', false)],
]);

function service(extra: Partial<KanbanServiceDeps> = {}): KanbanService {
  return new KanbanService({ db: h.db, roles: ROLES, workspaces: WORKSPACES, clock: new ManualClock(), ...extra });
}

function wakeSets(taskId: string): unknown[] {
  return eventsOf(h.db, taskId)
    .filter((e) => e.kind === 'wake_set')
    .map((e) => e.payload);
}

describe('setWake with a role', () => {
  it('writes the role with the setter, and names it in the wake_set', () => {
    const task = newTask(h.db);
    const r = setWake(h.db, task.taskId, { on: true, as: ALICE, maxDepth: 5, role: 'vi-coordinator' }, ALICE, APP, NOW);
    expect(r).toMatchObject({ ok: true, changed: true, task: { wakeBy: ALICE, wakeRole: 'vi-coordinator' } });
    expect(wakeSets(task.taskId)).toEqual([{ on: true, as: ALICE, depth: 0, role: 'vi-coordinator' }]);
  });

  it('switches the target both ways with the same setter, each a change with its wake_set', () => {
    const task = newTask(h.db);
    setWake(h.db, task.taskId, { on: true, as: ALICE, maxDepth: 5 }, ALICE, APP, NOW);
    const toRole = setWake(h.db, task.taskId, { on: true, as: ALICE, maxDepth: 5, role: 'vi-coordinator' }, ALICE, APP, NOW + 1);
    expect(toRole).toMatchObject({ ok: true, changed: true, task: { wakeRole: 'vi-coordinator' } });
    const again = setWake(h.db, task.taskId, { on: true, as: ALICE, maxDepth: 5, role: 'vi-coordinator' }, ALICE, APP, NOW + 2);
    expect(again).toMatchObject({ ok: true, changed: false });
    const toSession = setWake(h.db, task.taskId, { on: true, as: ALICE, maxDepth: 5 }, ALICE, APP, NOW + 3);
    expect(toSession).toMatchObject({ ok: true, changed: true, task: { wakeBy: ALICE, wakeRole: null } });
    expect(wakeSets(task.taskId)).toEqual([
      { on: true, as: ALICE, depth: 0 },
      { on: true, as: ALICE, depth: 0, role: 'vi-coordinator' },
      { on: true, as: ALICE, depth: 0 },
    ]);
  });

  it('clears the role with the setter when turned off', () => {
    const task = newTask(h.db);
    setWake(h.db, task.taskId, { on: true, as: ALICE, maxDepth: 5, role: 'vi-coordinator' }, ALICE, APP, NOW);
    setWake(h.db, task.taskId, { on: false }, BOB, APP, NOW + 1);
    expect(getTask(h.db, task.taskId)).toMatchObject({ wakeBy: null, wakeRole: null });
  });

  it("refuses a reaction task's wake, which never wakes anyone", () => {
    const task = newTask(h.db);
    h.db.prepare('UPDATE kanban_tasks SET reaction_of = 1 WHERE task_id = ?').run(task.taskId);
    for (const change of [{ on: true, as: ALICE, maxDepth: 5 } as const, { on: false } as const]) {
      expect(setWake(h.db, task.taskId, change, ALICE, APP, NOW)).toEqual({
        ok: false,
        code: 'invalid',
        message: `\`${task.taskId}\` is a reaction task, which never wakes anyone`,
      });
    }
    expect(wakeSets(task.taskId)).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('a task made with a role as its wake', () => {
  it('records the role, and a follow-up of its run inherits it', () => {
    const parent = newTask(h.db, { wake: { by: ALICE, depth: 1, role: 'vi-coordinator' } });
    expect(parent).toMatchObject({ wakeBy: ALICE, wakeDepth: 1, wakeRole: 'vi-coordinator' });
    expect(wakeSets(parent.taskId)).toEqual([{ on: true, as: ALICE, depth: 1, role: 'vi-coordinator' }]);
    const run = claimed(h.db, parent.taskId);
    const r = createTask(h.db, { title: 'a follow-up', createdBy: `run:${run.runId}`, createdVia: { kind: 'run', runId: run.runId } }, NOW + 1);
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.message);
    expect(r.task).toMatchObject({ wakeBy: ALICE, wakeDepth: 1, wakeRole: 'vi-coordinator' });
    expect(wakeSets(r.task.taskId)).toEqual([{ on: true, as: ALICE, depth: 1, role: 'vi-coordinator', from: parent.taskId }]);
  });
});

describe("the service's role check", () => {
  it('turns a role wake on for a configured, unsupervised role', () => {
    const s = service();
    const task = newTask(h.db);
    const r = s.setWake(task.taskId, { on: true, as: ALICE, role: 'vi-coordinator' }, ALICE, APP);
    expect(r).toMatchObject({ ok: true, changed: true, task: { wakeRole: 'vi-coordinator' } });
  });

  it("refuses a role that is not configured, or that assignable refuses, as invalid in assignable's words", () => {
    const s = service();
    const task = newTask(h.db);
    expect(s.setWake(task.taskId, { on: true, as: ALICE, role: 'nobody' }, ALICE, APP)).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      code: 'invalid',
      message: 'role "nobody" is not configured',
    });
    expect(s.setWake(task.taskId, { on: true, as: ALICE, role: 'watcher' }, ALICE, APP)).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      code: 'invalid',
      message: 'role "watcher" has a supervised agent; its approval requests would reach nobody until the board is in Lark',
    });
    expect(getTask(h.db, task.taskId)).toMatchObject({ wakeBy: null, wakeRole: null });
  });

  it("refuses a person's principal as a role", () => {
    const s = service({ people: { canTalk: () => true } });
    const task = newTask(h.db);
    const r = s.setWake(task.taskId, { on: true, as: ALICE, role: BOB }, ALICE, APP);
    expect(r).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: 'invalid' });
  });

  it('makes a task with a role as its wake, and refuses one with an unknown role', () => {
    const s = service();
    const made = s.create({ title: 'Book the venue', assignee: 'implementer', createdBy: ALICE, createdVia: VIA, wake: { by: ALICE, depth: 0, role: 'vi-coordinator' } });
    expect(made).toMatchObject({ ok: true, task: { wakeBy: ALICE, wakeRole: 'vi-coordinator' } });
    const refused = s.create({ title: 'Book the hall', assignee: 'implementer', createdBy: ALICE, createdVia: VIA, wake: { by: ALICE, depth: 0, role: 'nobody' } });
    expect(refused).toEqual({ ok: false, code: 'invalid', message: 'role "nobody" is not configured' });
  });
});
```

```ts
  /**
   * The role a wake targets, checked when it is set (wake spec §19.1): configured,
   * and taken by `assignable` as an assignee, which judges the role alone; refused
   * `invalid` in `assignable`'s words, as `task assign` would refuse it. A
   * person's principal is not a role.
   */
  #wakeRole(role: string | undefined): Result<{ role: { role?: string } }> {
    if (role === undefined) return { ok: true, role: {} };
    const who = assignable(role, this.#facts());
    if (!who.ok) return board.refuse('invalid', who.message);
    if (who.assignee.kind !== 'role') return board.refuse('invalid', `${JSON.stringify(role)} is not a role: a wake targets a role, or the chat session`);
    return { ok: true, role: { role } };
```

```ts
describe("chat's role forms (wake spec §19.1)", () => {
  it('reads wake: <role> on task new, and wake:<role> as a start\'s last word', () => {
    const made = parseKanban('task new Book the venue\nwake: reviewer');
    expect(made).toMatchObject({ ok: true, command: { verb: 'new', wake: true, wakeRole: 'reviewer' } });
    expect(parseKanban('workflow start flow topic=x wake:reviewer')).toEqual({
      ok: true,
      command: { verb: 'workflow start', name: 'flow', pairs: [{ key: 'topic', value: 'x', quoted: false }], wake: true, wakeRole: 'reviewer' },
    });
    // `on` and `off` are words, never roles.
    expect(parseKanban('workflow start flow wake:on')).toEqual({ ok: true, command: { verb: 'workflow start', name: 'flow', pairs: [], wake: true } });
    expect(parseKanban('workflow start flow wake:off')).toEqual({ ok: true, command: { verb: 'workflow start', name: 'flow', pairs: [] } });
    expect(parseKanban('task wake k_one reviewer')).toEqual({ ok: true, command: { verb: 'wake', taskId: 'k_one', on: true, role: 'reviewer' } });
    expect(parseKanban('task wake k_one ON')).toEqual({ ok: true, command: { verb: 'wake', taskId: 'k_one', on: true } });
  });

  it('makes a task whose wake targets a role, and says so', async () => {
    const { chat } = harness();
    const reply = await say(chat, 'task new Book the venue\nwake: reviewer');
    expect(reply).toContain('Its outcomes wake role reviewer here.');
    expect(getTask(t.db, created(reply))).toMatchObject({ wakeBy: 'lark:on_owner', wakeRole: 'reviewer' });
  });

  it('refuses a role that is not configured, and makes nothing', async () => {
    const { chat } = harness();
    expect(await say(chat, 'task new Book the venue\nwake: nobody')).toBe('Not done: role "nobody" is not configured');
    expect(t.db.prepare('SELECT count(*) AS n FROM kanban_tasks').get()).toEqual({ n: 0 });
  });

  it('sets a role as the target at operate tier, switches it both ways, and refuses it at talk tier', async () => {
    const { chat } = harness();
    const taskId = created(await say(chat, 'task new Book the venue'));
    expect(await say(chat, `task wake ${taskId} reviewer`, GUEST)).toBe(
      '`/kanban task wake <task> <role>` gives a role work, and needs operator permission.',
    );
    expect(getTask(t.db, taskId)?.wakeBy).toBeNull();
    expect(await say(chat, `task wake ${taskId} reviewer`)).toBe(
      `Wake is on for \`${taskId}\`: its outcomes now make a task for role reviewer where it is followed, set by Zhixi Sun.`,
    );
    expect(getTask(t.db, taskId)).toMatchObject({ wakeBy: 'lark:on_owner', wakeRole: 'reviewer' });
    expect(await say(chat, `task wake ${taskId} reviewer`)).toBe(`Wake is already on for \`${taskId}\`, for role reviewer, set by Zhixi Sun.`);
    expect(await say(chat, `task wake ${taskId} on`)).toContain('start a turn of the agent');
    expect(getTask(t.db, taskId)).toMatchObject({ wakeBy: 'lark:on_owner', wakeRole: null });
    expect(await say(chat, `task wake ${taskId} reviewer`)).toContain('for role reviewer');
    expect(await say(chat, `task wake ${taskId} off`, GUEST)).toBe(`Wake is off for \`${taskId}\`: its outcomes are notices only.`);
    expect(getTask(t.db, taskId)).toMatchObject({ wakeBy: null, wakeRole: null });
  });
});
```
