### Task 51: The terminal's and a step's role forms

**Files:**

- Create: `tests/mt-wake-role.test.ts`, `tests/wake-role-forms.test.ts`
- Modify: `src/cli/gate.ts`, `src/cli/mt.ts`, `src/cli/operator.ts`, `src/cli/plain.ts`, `src/kanban/dag.ts`, `src/kanban/service.ts`, `src/kanban/workflow.ts`, `tests/mt-wake.test.ts`, `tests/wake-workflow.test.ts`

§19.1's terminal and step rows. `--wake-role <role>` on `mt kanban task new` and `workflow start`, which implies `--wake` (node's `parseArgs` takes a flag or a value, never both); `mt kanban task wake <task> <role>`, `on` and `off` being the words; a step's `wake: { role: <name> }` and a DAG task's `"wake": {"role": "<name>"}`, each checked as the other fields are, the DAG's canonical form holding the object. A start's members take the start's role, else their own step's. In a woken turn's shell (§3.2a), a role needs the wake's setter's operate tier, read by `BoardAccess.canOperate`. `--json`'s `wake` gains `role` when the wake has one. Two refusal messages of Tasks 16 and 17 change, as the field now takes a role too.

```ts
import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { advanceWake, recordWake, wakeSubmitted } from '../src/db/kanban.js';
import { eventsOf, getTask } from '../src/db/kanban-read.js';
import { migrate, openDb, type Db } from '../src/db/open.js';
import { notePerson } from '../src/db/people.js';
import { createSession } from '../src/db/sessions.js';
import { createTurn, setTurnState } from '../src/db/turns.js';
import { listenWorker, workerSocketPath, type WorkerServer } from '../src/kanban/socket.js';
import { clearSecrets } from '../src/secrets.js';
import { SCHEMA_DIR } from './helpers/db.js';
import { NOW, newTask } from './helpers/kanban.js';
import { mtFixture, type MtFixture } from './helpers/mt.js';

/**
 * A role as a wake's target at the terminal (wake spec §19.1): `--wake-role
 * <role>` on `task new` and `workflow start`, which implies `--wake`, and `mt
 * kanban task wake <task> <role>`, as the owner; in a woken turn's shell, as
 * its setter, who must have operate tier.
 */

let fx: MtFixture;
let db: Db;
let server: WorkerServer | undefined;
const OWNER = 'lark:on_owner';
const SETTER = 'lark:on_kevin';

afterEach(async () => {
  clearSecrets();
  await server?.close();
  server = undefined;
  db?.close();
  fx?.cleanup();
});

/** A home with the board on, the owner seen, a task in thread omt_topic of oc_team, and the workflow brief. */
async function setup(): Promise<string> {
  clearSecrets();
  fx = mtFixture((ws) =>
    [`workspace: ${ws}`, 'lark:', '  appId: cli_app', 'kanban:', '  enabled: true', 'agent:', '  driver: structured-cli', '  command: bytesec', '  unsupervised: true', ''].join('\n'),
  );
  db = openDb(join(fx.home, 'team.db'));
  migrate(db, SCHEMA_DIR);
  notePerson(db, { appId: 'cli_app', unionId: 'on_owner', openId: 'ou_owner', name: 'Zhixi Sun' }, NOW);
  const task = newTask(db, { createdVia: { kind: 'chat', channel: 'lark', appId: 'cli_app', conversationId: 'oc_team', threadId: 'omt_topic', rootId: 'om_root' } });
  mkdirSync(join(fx.home, 'workflows'));
  writeFileSync(join(fx.home, 'workflows', 'brief.yaml'), 'steps:\n  a: { title: "Draft the brief", assignee: default }\n');
  server = await listenWorker(workerSocketPath(fx.home), () => ({ ok: true }));
  return task.taskId;
}

/** Session s_1's running turn t_1, a delivered wake of `taskId` by SETTER at depth 1. */
function woken(taskId: string): void {
  createSession(db, { id: 's_1', agentId: 'default', workspaceId: 'default', ownerPrincipal: SETTER }, NOW);
  createTurn(db, { sessionId: 's_1', turnId: 't_1', generation: 0, idempotencyKey: 'key-1' }, NOW);
  setTurnState(db, 's_1', 't_1', 'running');
  const event = eventsOf(db, taskId).at(-1);
  const sub = db.prepare<[string], { id: number }>('SELECT id FROM kanban_subscriptions WHERE task_id = ?').get(taskId);
  const r = recordWake(
    db,
    {
      uuid: 'u-1',
      channel: 'lark',
      appId: 'cli_app',
      conversationId: 'oc_team',
      threadId: 'omt_topic',
      principal: SETTER,
      depth: 1,
      events: [{ subscriptionId: sub?.id ?? 0, eventId: event?.id ?? 0, taskId }],
    },
    NOW,
  );
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.message);
  wakeSubmitted(db, r.wake.wakeId, 's_1', 'key-1', 'boot-1');
  advanceWake(db, r.wake.wakeId, NOW + 1);
}

const kanban = (argv: string[], env: Record<string, string> = {}) => fx.run(['kanban', ...argv], { env: { MT_OWNER_OPEN_ID: 'ou_owner', ...env } });
const created = (out: string): string => /^created (k_[0-9a-z]+)/.exec(out)?.[1] ?? '';

describe('--wake-role', () => {
  it('makes the task with wake on for the role, as the owner, without --wake, and says so', async () => {
    await setup();
    const r = await kanban(['task', 'new', 'Book the venue', '--chat', 'oc_team', '--wake-role', 'default']);
    expect(r.code, r.err).toBe(0);
    expect(r.out).toContain('; its outcomes wake role default');
    expect(getTask(db, created(r.out))).toMatchObject({ wakeBy: OWNER, wakeRole: 'default' });
    const json = JSON.parse((await kanban(['task', 'new', 'Order food', '--chat', 'oc_team', '--wake-role', 'default', '--json'])).out);
    expect(json.wake).toEqual({ on: true, by: OWNER, depth: 0, role: 'default' });
  });

  it('refuses a role that is not configured, and makes nothing', async () => {
    await setup();
    expect(await kanban(['task', 'new', 'x', '--chat', 'oc_team', '--wake-role', 'nobody'])).toEqual({
      code: 1,
      out: '',
      err: 'mt: role "nobody" is not configured',
    });
    expect((db.prepare('SELECT count(*) AS n FROM kanban_tasks').get() as { n: number }).n).toBe(1);
  });

  it('turns it on for every member of a start', async () => {
    await setup();
    const r = JSON.parse((await kanban(['workflow', 'start', 'brief', '--chat', 'oc_team', '--wake-role', 'default', '--json'])).out);
    expect(r.ok).toBe(true);
    const ids = (r.tasks as Array<{ task_id: string }>).map((t) => t.task_id);
    expect(ids.map((id) => getTask(db, id)?.wakeRole)).toEqual(['default']);
  });
});

describe('mt kanban task wake <task> <role>', () => {
  it('targets the role as the owner, names where, and switches back with on', async () => {
    const id = await setup();
    expect(await kanban(['task', 'wake', id, 'default'])).toEqual({
      code: 0,
      out: `wake on for ${id}: its outcomes make a task for role default in oc_team/omt_topic, as ${OWNER} (the owner)`,
      err: '',
    });
    expect(getTask(db, id)).toMatchObject({ wakeBy: OWNER, wakeRole: 'default' });
    expect(JSON.parse((await kanban(['task', 'wake', id, 'default', '--json'])).out)).toEqual({
      ok: true,
      task_id: id,
      wake: { on: true, by: OWNER, depth: 0, role: 'default' },
    });
    expect((await kanban(['task', 'wake', id, 'on'])).out).toContain('its outcomes start a turn');
    expect(getTask(db, id)).toMatchObject({ wakeBy: OWNER, wakeRole: null });
  });
});

describe("a woken turn's shell naming a role", () => {
  it("refuses it when the wake's setter does not have operate tier, and takes it when they do", async () => {
    const id = await setup();
    woken(id);
    const deeper = newTask(db, {
      createdVia: { kind: 'chat', channel: 'lark', appId: 'cli_app', conversationId: 'oc_team', threadId: 'omt_topic', rootId: 'om_root' },
      wake: { by: null, depth: 2 },
    });
    const refusal = `a role as a wake's target gives the role work, which needs operate tier, and ${SETTER}, who set this woken turn's wake, does not have it`;
    const shell = { MT_AGENT_SESSION: 's_1' };
    expect(await kanban(['task', 'wake', deeper.taskId, 'default'], shell)).toEqual({ code: 1, out: '', err: `mt: ${refusal}` });
    expect(await kanban(['task', 'new', 'x', '--chat', 'oc_team', '--thread', 'omt_topic', '--wake-role', 'default'], shell)).toEqual({
      code: 1,
      out: '',
      err: `mt: ${refusal}`,
    });
    notePerson(db, { appId: 'cli_app', unionId: 'on_kevin', openId: 'ou_kevin', name: 'Kevin Tu' }, NOW);
    const operator = { ...shell, MT_ALLOW_TALK: 'ou_kevin', MT_ALLOW_OPERATE: 'ou_kevin' };
    const r = await kanban(['task', 'wake', deeper.taskId, 'default'], operator);
    expect(r.code, r.err).toBe(0);
    expect(getTask(db, deeper.taskId)).toMatchObject({ wakeBy: SETTER, wakeRole: 'default' });
  });
});
```

Create `tests/wake-role-forms.test.ts`:

```ts
import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { getTask } from '../src/db/kanban-read.js';
import { canonicalDag, checkDagShape } from '../src/kanban/dag.js';
import { KanbanService, type StartRequest, type WorkflowMade } from '../src/kanban/service.js';
import type { Result } from '../src/kanban/types.js';
import { readWorkflow } from '../src/kanban/workflow.js';
import { clearSecrets } from '../src/secrets.js';
import { testDb, type TestDb } from './helpers/db.js';
import { role } from './helpers/dispatch.js';
import { ALICE, VIA } from './helpers/kanban.js';

/**
 * A step's and a DAG task's role as a wake's target (wake spec §19.1):
 * `wake: { role: <name> }` in a step, checked as the step's other fields are and
 * carried into the DAG as `"wake": {"role": "<name>"}`; a start's members made
 * with that role as their wake's target, the start's own role first; and a role
 * the board cannot give work refused at the start.
 */

const FLOW = `steps:
  draft:
    title: Draft the agenda
    assignee: implementer
  book:
    parents: [draft]
    title: Book the venue
    assignee: implementer
    wake: { role: vi-coordinator }
`;

const ROLES = new Map([
  ['implementer', role('implementer')],
  ['vi-coordinator', role('vi-coordinator')],
]);
const FACTS = { roles: ROLES, workspaces: new Set(['default']), supervisedRoles: false };

let h: TestDb;
let dir: string;

beforeEach(() => {
  clearSecrets();
  h = testDb();
  dir = join(h.dir, 'workflows');
  mkdirSync(dir);
  writeFileSync(join(dir, 'flow.yaml'), FLOW);
});
afterEach(() => {
  clearSecrets();
  h.close();
});

function service(roles = ROLES): KanbanService {
  return new KanbanService({ db: h.db, roles, workspaces: new Set(['default']), workflowsDir: dir, wake: { enabled: true, maxDepth: 5 } });
}

function made(r: Result<object>): WorkflowMade {
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`${r.code}: ${r.message}`);
  return r as unknown as WorkflowMade;
}

function start(s: KanbanService, over: Partial<StartRequest> = {}): Result<WorkflowMade> {
  return s.startWorkflow({ workflow: 'flow', params: { from: 'json', params: {} }, createdBy: ALICE, createdVia: VIA, ...over });
}

function targets(r: WorkflowMade): Array<[string, string | null, string | null]> {
  return r.tasks.map((t) => {
    const task = getTask(h.db, t.taskId);
    return [t.ref, task?.wakeBy ?? null, task?.wakeRole ?? null];
  });
}

describe("a step's role", () => {
  it('reads wake: { role }, and carries it into the DAG', () => {
    const r = readWorkflow(dir, 'flow', FACTS);
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.message);
    expect(r.workflow.steps.map((s) => [s.name, s.wake])).toEqual([
      ['draft', false],
      ['book', { role: 'vi-coordinator' }],
    ]);
    const preview = service().previewWorkflow({ workflow: 'flow', params: { from: 'json', params: {} }, createdBy: ALICE, createdVia: VIA });
    if (!preview.ok) throw new Error(preview.message);
    expect(preview.dag.tasks.map((t) => t.wake)).toEqual([undefined, { role: 'vi-coordinator' }]);
    expect(canonicalDag(preview.dag)).toContain('"wake":{"role":"vi-coordinator"}');
  });

  it('refuses a wake that is no role, naming its place', () => {
    for (const [bad, said] of [
      ['wake: { role: "" }', 'steps.book.wake.role is a role\'s name'],
      ['wake: { name: x }', 'unknown setting steps.book.wake.name'],
      ['wake: maybe', 'steps.book.wake is true, false or { role: <name> }'],
    ] as const) {
      writeFileSync(join(dir, 'flow.yaml'), FLOW.replace('wake: { role: vi-coordinator }', bad));
      const r = readWorkflow(dir, 'flow', FACTS);
      expect(r.ok, bad).toBe(false);
      if (!r.ok) expect(r.message, bad).toContain(said);
    }
  });

  it("makes a start's asking member with the role as its wake's target, as the starter", () => {
    const r = made(start(service(), { wake: { by: ALICE, depth: 0, all: false } }));
    expect(targets(r)).toEqual([
      ['draft', null, null],
      ['book', ALICE, 'vi-coordinator'],
    ]);
  });

  it("gives a start's own role to every member, and a member its step's when the start names none", () => {
    expect(targets(made(start(service(), { wake: { by: ALICE, depth: 0, all: true, role: 'implementer' } })))).toEqual([
      ['draft', ALICE, 'implementer'],
      ['book', ALICE, 'implementer'],
    ]);
    expect(targets(made(start(service(), { idempotencyKey: 'again', wake: { by: ALICE, depth: 0, all: true } })))).toEqual([
      ['draft', ALICE, null],
      ['book', ALICE, 'vi-coordinator'],
    ]);
  });

  it('refuses a start whose step names a role the board cannot give work, and makes nothing', () => {
    const r = start(service(new Map([['implementer', role('implementer')]])), { wake: { by: ALICE, depth: 0, all: false } });
    expect(r).toEqual({ ok: false, code: 'invalid', message: 'role "vi-coordinator" is not configured' });
    expect(h.db.prepare('SELECT count(*) AS n FROM kanban_tasks').get()).toEqual({ n: 0 });
  });
});

describe("a DAG task's role", () => {
  const dag = (wake: unknown) => ({
    format: 1,
    tasks: [{ ref: 'a', title: 'Book the venue', assignee: 'implementer', wake }],
  });

  it('is {"role": "<name>"}, and nothing else of an object', () => {
    const on = checkDagShape(dag({ role: 'vi-coordinator' }), 'terminal');
    if (!on.ok) throw new Error(on.message);
    expect(on.dag.tasks[0]?.wake).toEqual({ role: 'vi-coordinator' });
    for (const bad of [{ role: '' }, { role: 'x', more: 1 }, { name: 'x' }]) {
      expect(checkDagShape(dag(bad), 'terminal')).toEqual({ ok: false, code: 'invalid', message: 'tasks[0] (a).wake is true, false or {"role": "<name>"}' });
    }
  });

  it("makes an apply's member with its role as its wake's target", () => {
    const r = made(
      service().applyDag({
        dag: { format: 1, tasks: [{ ref: 'a', title: 'A', wake: { role: 'vi-coordinator' } }, { ref: 'b', title: 'B' }] },
        createdBy: ALICE,
        createdVia: VIA,
        wake: { by: ALICE, depth: 0, all: false },
      }),
    );
    expect(targets(r)).toEqual([
      ['a', ALICE, 'vi-coordinator'],
      ['b', null, null],
    ]);
  });
});
```

```ts
/** A woken turn naming a role as a wake's target, its setter without operate tier (wake spec §19.1). */
function roleNeedsOperate(principal: string): string {
  return `a role as a wake's target gives the role work, which needs operate tier, and ${principal}, who set this woken turn's wake, does not have it`;
}

/** `--wake-role <role>`, which implies `--wake` (wake spec §19.1); a role's name is one word. */
function wakeRoleFlag(raw: unknown): string | undefined {
  if (raw === undefined) return undefined;
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || !/^\S+$/.test(raw)) throw new UsageError('--wake-role takes a role name');
  return raw;
```

```ts
/** A step's `wake`: true or false, or `{ role: <name> }` (wake spec §3.1, §19.1), checked as the other fields are. */
function stepWake(path: string, place: string, raw: unknown): boolean | { role: string } {
  if (typeof raw === 'boolean') return raw;
  if (!isRecord(raw)) fail(`${place}.wake is true, false or { role: <name> }`);
  const map = raw as Record<string, unknown>;
  reject(path, `${place}.wake`, map, ['role'], HINTS);
  const role = map['role'];
  if (typeof role !== 'string' || role.trim() === '') fail(`${place}.wake.role is a role's name`);
  return { role: role as string };
}
```

### Task 52: A role's wake set with no chat

**Files:**

- Create: `tests/wake-chatless-set.test.ts`
- Modify: `src/cli/operator.ts`, `src/db/kanban.ts`, `src/kanban/service.ts`

§19.16, the user's decision, and §3.4 as it amends. A role's wake wakes no conversation, so it needs no chat to follow the task: `setWake` takes a role for a task with no subscription of this bot, and sets the task's own `kanban_tasks.wake_cursor` (migration 013) to its `wake_set`, beside its subscriptions' cursors, whatever chat follows it; a task made with a wake has its own cursor set to its latest event in the insert, and a chatless task's follow-ups, which have no subscription either, inherit its wake as every follow-up does. At the terminal, `--wake-role` on `task new` and on `workflow start` needs no `--chat`, and `mt kanban task wake <id> <role>` of a task no chat follows is accepted; a start with no `--chat` keeps the wake of its role steps (`wake: { role }`) and makes its chat-session steps (`wake: true`) notice-only, its answer ending with the note of Task 16. The chat session's wake without a chat stays refused: `--wake`, `task wake <id> on`, and in an agent's shell every wake with no `--chat`. Nothing reads the task's cursor yet: the waker's chatless wakes are a later task. When the owner is not yet known, the owner note wins over the no-chat note, and a role step is notice-only too.

- [ ] **Step 52.1: Write the tests.**

Create `tests/wake-chatless-set.test.ts`:

```ts
import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { addComment, createTask, setWake } from '../src/db/kanban.js';
import { eventsOf, getTask, subscriptionsOf } from '../src/db/kanban-read.js';
import { migrate, openDb, type Db } from '../src/db/open.js';
import { notePerson } from '../src/db/people.js';
import { listenWorker, workerSocketPath, type WorkerServer } from '../src/kanban/socket.js';
import { clearSecrets } from '../src/secrets.js';
import { SCHEMA_DIR, testDb, type TestDb } from './helpers/db.js';
import { ALICE, NOW, claimed, newTask } from './helpers/kanban.js';
import { mtFixture, type MtFixture } from './helpers/mt.js';

/**
 * A role's wake with no chat (wake spec §19.16): it keeps its wake, read
 * through the task's own `wake_cursor`, which `setWake` sets to the task's
 * latest event; the terminal's `--wake-role` and `task wake <id> <role>` need
 * no `--chat`, nor a step's `wake: { role }`; the chat session's wake without
 * a chat stays refused, or notice-only for a start's steps; a chatless task's
 * follow-ups inherit it.
 */

const APP = 'cli_app';
const OWNER = 'lark:on_owner';
const OPERATOR = { kind: 'operator' } as const;

describe('setWake for a role, with no chat', () => {
  let h: TestDb;
  afterEach(() => h.close());

  it("keeps it, and sets the task's own cursor to its wake_set", () => {
    h = testDb();
    const task = newTask(h.db, { createdVia: OPERATOR });
    expect(subscriptionsOf(h.db, task.taskId)).toEqual([]);
    const r = setWake(h.db, task.taskId, { on: true, as: ALICE, maxDepth: 5, role: 'worker' }, 'operator:x', APP, NOW + 1);
    expect(r).toMatchObject({ ok: true, changed: true, task: { wakeBy: ALICE, wakeRole: 'worker' } });
    const set = eventsOf(h.db, task.taskId).at(-1);
    expect(set?.kind).toBe('wake_set');
    expect(getTask(h.db, task.taskId)?.wakeCursor).toBe(set?.id);
  });

  it("still refuses the chat session's wake with no chat", () => {
    h = testDb();
    const task = newTask(h.db, { createdVia: OPERATOR });
    expect(setWake(h.db, task.taskId, { on: true, as: ALICE, maxDepth: 5 }, 'operator:x', APP, NOW)).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: 'invalid' });
  });

  it('makes a task with one at its latest event, and gives its follow-ups the same wake, with no chat either', () => {
    h = testDb();
    const parent = newTask(h.db, { createdVia: OPERATOR, wake: { by: ALICE, depth: 1, role: 'worker' } });
    expect(parent).toMatchObject({ wakeBy: ALICE, wakeRole: 'worker', wakeCursor: eventsOf(h.db, parent.taskId).at(-1)?.id });
    const run = claimed(h.db, parent.taskId);
    const r = createTask(h.db, { title: 'a follow-up', createdBy: `run:${run.runId}`, createdVia: { kind: 'run', runId: run.runId } }, NOW + 1);
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.message);
    expect(r.task).toMatchObject({ wakeBy: ALICE, wakeRole: 'worker', wakeDepth: 1, wakeCursor: eventsOf(h.db, r.task.taskId).at(-1)?.id });
    expect(subscriptionsOf(h.db, r.task.taskId)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("sets the task's own cursor beside its subscriptions', so a task followed only by another app's chat replays nothing", () => {
    h = testDb();
    const other = { kind: 'chat', channel: 'lark', appId: 'cli_other', conversationId: 'oc_x', threadId: '' } as const;
    const task = newTask(h.db, { createdVia: other });
    const comment = addComment(h.db, task.taskId, ALICE, 'an earlier event', NOW, false);
    if (!comment.ok) throw new Error(comment.message);
    const r = setWake(h.db, task.taskId, { on: true, as: ALICE, maxDepth: 5, role: 'worker' }, 'operator:x', APP, NOW + 1);
    expect(r).toMatchObject({ ok: true, changed: true });
    const latest = eventsOf(h.db, task.taskId).at(-1)?.id ?? 0;
    expect(getTask(h.db, task.taskId)?.wakeCursor).toBe(latest);
    // The other app's chat keeps its own cursor; this bot reads the task as chatless, from its latest event.
    expect(subscriptionsOf(h.db, task.taskId).map((s) => s.appId)).toEqual(['cli_other']);
    const made = newTask(h.db, { createdVia: { ...other, conversationId: 'oc_y' }, wake: { by: ALICE, depth: 0, role: 'worker' } });
    expect(made.wakeCursor).toBe(eventsOf(h.db, made.taskId).at(-1)?.id);
    expect(made.wakeCursor).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });
});

    mkdirSync(join(fx.home, 'workflows'));

    );
    writeFileSync(join(fx.home, 'workflows', 'brief.yaml'), 'steps:\n  a: { title: "Draft the brief", assignee: default }\n');
    server = await listenWorker(workerSocketPath(fx.home), () => ({ ok: true }));
  }

  const created = (out: string): string => /^created (k_[0-9a-z]+)/.exec(out)?.[1] ?? '';

  it('makes a task with --wake-role, as the owner, and still refuses --wake', async () => {
    await setup();
    const r = await kanban(['task', 'new', 'Book the venue', '--wake-role', 'default']);
    expect(r.code, r.err).toBe(0);
    expect(r.out).toContain('; its outcomes wake role default');
    const id = created(r.out);
    expect(getTask(db, id)).toMatchObject({ wakeBy: OWNER, wakeRole: 'default', wakeCursor: eventsOf(db, id).at(-1)?.id });
    expect(subscriptionsOf(db, id)).toEqual([]);
    expect(await kanban(['task', 'new', 'x', '--wake'])).toEqual({ code: 1, out: '', err: 'mt: a wake needs a chat that follows the task: add --chat' });
  });

  it('turns a role on for a task no chat follows, and refuses on', async () => {
    await setup();

    const r = await kanban(['task', 'wake', id, 'default']);
    expect(r.code, r.err).toBe(0);
    expect(r.out).toBe(`wake on for ${id}: its outcomes make a task for role default, as ${OWNER} (the owner)`);
    expect(getTask(db, id)?.wakeCursor).toBe(eventsOf(db, id).at(-1)?.id);
    expect((await kanban(['task', 'wake', id, 'on'])).err).toBe(
      `mt: a wake needs a chat that follows the task, and no chat follows ${id}: a chat is chosen when a task is made`,
    );
  });

  it('keeps the wake of every member of a start with --wake-role', async () => {
    await setup();
    const r = JSON.parse((await kanban(['workflow', 'start', 'brief', '--wake-role', 'default', '--json'])).out);
    expect(r.ok).toBe(true);
    const ids = (r.tasks as Array<{ task_id: string }>).map((t) => t.task_id);
    expect(ids.map((id) => getTask(db, id)?.wakeRole)).toEqual(['default']);
    expect(r.wake_note).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("keeps a role step's wake, and makes a chat-session step notice-only, with the note", async () => {
    await setup();
    const r = JSON.parse((await kanban(['workflow', 'start', 'mixed', '--json'])).out);
    expect(r.ok).toBe(true);
    const [a, b] = (r.tasks as Array<{ task_id: string }>).map((t) => getTask(db, t.task_id));
    expect(a).toMatchObject({ wakeBy: OWNER, wakeRole: 'default' });
    expect(b).toMatchObject({ wakeBy: null, wakeRole: null });
    expect(r.wake_note).toBe('no chat follows this start (add --chat), so the steps that wake the chat session are notice-only');
  });

  it('makes a role step notice-only too when the owner is not yet known, with the owner note alone', async () => {
    await setup({ seen: false });
    const r = JSON.parse((await kanban(['workflow', 'start', 'mixed', '--json'])).out);
    expect(r.ok).toBe(true);
    const [a, b] = (r.tasks as Array<{ task_id: string }>).map((t) => getTask(db, t.task_id));
    expect(a).toMatchObject({ wakeBy: null, wakeRole: null });
    expect(b).toMatchObject({ wakeBy: null, wakeRole: null });
    expect(r.wake_note).toBe('the owner has not used /kanban in Lark yet, so the steps that ask for a wake are notice-only');
  });
});
```

### Task 54: `recordRoleWake` and `wake_root`

**Files:**

- Create: `tests/wake-role-writer.test.ts`
- Modify: `src/db/WRITERS.md`, `src/db/kanban.ts`, `src/kanban/limits.ts`, `src/kanban/service.ts`

§19.3 and §19.8's mark. `recordRoleWake(db, batch, facts, now)` writes a role's batch in one transaction: the `kanban_wakes` row, already `delivered`, with `target_role` and `reaction_task`; its `kanban_wake_events`; every covered subscription's `wake_cursor` moved; and the reaction task, through `insertTask`, as `createTask` makes any, with each field of §19.3's table and its subscription a copy of the batch's conversation's. It makes `createTask`'s checks in its order: the key `wake:<uuid>` first, whose task answers a repeat; `liveBoard` on the oldest task's board and `assignable` for the role, each a skip with nothing written, answered as `{skipped, reason}`; the checked fields by `checkTask`, the title and body cut to `WORKER_LIMITS` first; any other refusal rolls everything back. `insertTask` writes `wake_root`: its own id for a reaction task, else the creating run's task's, so a run's follow-ups and a run's workflow members carry it however deep. `KanbanService.recordRoleWake(batch)` gives it the team's facts. Nothing calls it yet: Task 56's waker does. The repeat is answered by the wake row first (`wakeByUuid`), a uuid a chat turn recorded skipped; a batch of a conversation whose subscription is gone is skipped, writing nothing; the title and body are cut by UTF-8 bytes on a whole character (`cutToBytes`, `src/kanban/limits.ts`), as the limits are bytes. A test pins that the reaction run's brief names the source task's own directory, through `created_from_task`.

- [ ] **Step 54.1: Write the tests.**

Create `tests/wake-role-writer.test.ts`:

```ts
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { addComment, archive, archiveBoard, claim, createBoard, createTask, recordWake, type NewRoleWake } from '../src/db/kanban.js';
import { eventsOf, getTask, getWake, subscriptionsOf, wakeEventsOf } from '../src/db/kanban-read.js';
import { registerWorktree } from '../src/db/workspaces.js';
import { briefFor } from '../src/kanban/brief.js';
import { KanbanService } from '../src/kanban/service.js';
import type { Role } from '../src/roles.js';
import { ManualClock, testDb, type TestDb } from './helpers/db.js';
import { role } from './helpers/dispatch.js';
import { ALICE, NOW, WORKSPACES, claimantFor, claimed, newTask } from './helpers/kanban.js';

/**
 * `recordRoleWake` (wake spec §19.3, §19.8): a role's batch made into one
 * reaction task in one transaction, with its `kanban_wakes` row, already
 * delivered, its events, its subscription and the wake cursors; `createTask`'s
 * checks in order, the key first, an archived board and a role removed each a
 * skip, a title cut and never refused, a refusal rolling everything back; and
 * `wake_root`, written for a reaction task and every task made from one,
 * however deep, and for no other.
 */

const APP = 'cli_app';
const THREAD = { kind: 'chat' as const, channel: 'lark', appId: APP, conversationId: 'oc_team', threadId: 'omt_topic', rootId: 'om_root', chatType: 'group' as const };
const ROLES: ReadonlyMap<string, Role> = new Map([
  ['implementer', role('implementer')],
  ['vi-coordinator', role('vi-coordinator')],
]);

let h: TestDb;
beforeEach(() => {
  h = testDb();
});
afterEach(() => h.close());

function service(roles: ReadonlyMap<string, Role> = ROLES): KanbanService {
  return new KanbanService({ db: h.db, roles, workspaces: WORKSPACES, clock: new ManualClock(NOW + 10) });
}

const count = (table: string): number => (h.db.prepare(`SELECT count(*) AS n FROM ${table}`).get() as { n: number }).n;

/** A task with wake on for vi-coordinator in thread omt_topic, an outcome-like event of it, and the batch of that event. */
function batch(over: Partial<NewRoleWake> = {}, board?: string): { source: string; event: number; sub: number; b: NewRoleWake } {
  const source = newTask(h.db, { createdVia: THREAD, wake: { by: ALICE, depth: 1, role: 'vi-coordinator' }, ...(board === undefined ? {} : { board }) });
  addComment(h.db, source.taskId, ALICE, 'an outcome stands in here', NOW + 1, false);
  const event = eventsOf(h.db, source.taskId).at(-1)?.id ?? 0;
  const sub = subscriptionsOf(h.db, source.taskId)[0]?.id ?? 0;
  return {
    source: source.taskId,
    event,
    sub,
    b: {
      uuid: 'u-1',
      channel: 'lark',
      appId: APP,
      conversationId: 'oc_team',
      threadId: 'omt_topic',
      principal: ALICE,
      depth: 1,
      events: [{ subscriptionId: sub, eventId: event, taskId: source.taskId }],
      role: 'vi-coordinator',
      title: `React to board updates: ${source.taskId} completed`,
      body: 'Board update: you are this task\'s run …',
      ...over,
    },
  };
}

function made(r: ReturnType<KanbanService['recordRoleWake']>): { wakeId: number; taskId: string; existing: boolean } {
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`${r.code}: ${r.message}`);
  if (!('wake' in r)) throw new Error(`skipped: ${r.reason}`);
  return { wakeId: r.wake.wakeId, taskId: r.task.taskId, existing: r.existing };
}

describe('recordRoleWake', () => {
  it('makes the reaction task with its row, its events, its subscription and the cursors, in one transaction', () => {
    const { source, event, sub, b } = batch();
    const { wakeId, taskId, existing } = made(service().recordRoleWake(b));
    expect(existing).toBe(false);
    expect(getWake(h.db, wakeId)).toMatchObject({
      state: 'delivered',
      deliveredAt: NOW + 10,
      targetRole: 'vi-coordinator',
      reactionTask: taskId,
      sessionId: null,
      principal: ALICE,
      depth: 1,
    });
    expect(wakeEventsOf(h.db, wakeId)).toEqual([{ wakeId, subscriptionId: sub, eventId: event, taskId: source }]);
    expect(subscriptionsOf(h.db, source)[0]?.wakeCursor).toBe(event);
    const task = getTask(h.db, taskId);
    expect(task).toMatchObject({
      title: `React to board updates: ${source} completed`,
      body: "Board update: you are this task's run …",
      assignee: { kind: 'role', name: 'vi-coordinator' },
      board: 'default',
      createdBy: ALICE,
      createdVia: { kind: 'wake', wakeId },
      createdFromTask: source,
      idempotencyKey: 'wake:u-1',
      wakeBy: null,
      wakeRole: null,
      wakeDepth: 2,
      reactionOf: wakeId,
      wakeRoot: taskId,
      phase: 'open',
    });
    expect(subscriptionsOf(h.db, taskId)).toEqual([
      expect.objectContaining({ appId: APP, conversationId: 'oc_team', threadId: 'omt_topic', rootMessageId: 'om_root', chatType: 'group', wakeCursor: 0 }),
    ]);
    // Not a link: it is ready at once.
    expect(h.db.prepare('SELECT count(*) AS n FROM kanban_links WHERE child_id = ?').get(taskId)).toEqual({ n: 0 });
  });

  it('answers a second attempt with the same uuid by its key, and writes nothing', () => {
    const { b } = batch();
    const first = made(service().recordRoleWake(b));
    const [tasks, wakes, events] = [count('kanban_tasks'), count('kanban_wakes'), count('kanban_events')];
    expect(made(service().recordRoleWake(b))).toEqual({ ...first, existing: true });
    expect([count('kanban_tasks'), count('kanban_wakes'), count('kanban_events')]).toEqual([tasks, wakes, events]);
  });

  it('skips the wake for a board archived since, and writes nothing', () => {
    createBoard(h.db, 'research', ALICE, NOW);
    const { source, b } = batch({}, 'research');
    archive(h.db, source, ALICE, NOW + 2);
    archiveBoard(h.db, 'research', ALICE, NOW + 3);
    const [tasks, wakes] = [count('kanban_tasks'), count('kanban_wakes')];
    expect(service().recordRoleWake(b)).toEqual({ ok: true, skipped: 'board', reason: 'board research is archived' });
    expect([count('kanban_tasks'), count('kanban_wakes')]).toEqual([tasks, wakes]);
  });

  it('skips the wake for a role removed since the round began', () => {
    const { b } = batch();
    const r = service(new Map([['implementer', role('implementer')]])).recordRoleWake(b);
    expect(r).toEqual({ ok: true, skipped: 'role', reason: 'role "vi-coordinator" is not configured' });
    expect(count('kanban_wakes')).toBe(0);
  });

  it('cuts a title past its limit, never refusing it', () => {
    const { b } = batch({ title: `React to board updates: ${'x'.repeat(600)}` });
    const { taskId } = made(service().recordRoleWake(b));
    expect(getTask(h.db, taskId)?.title.length).toBe(512);
  });

  it('cuts a title and a body by their bytes, on a whole character', () => {
    const { b } = batch({ title: '\u8bae'.repeat(300), body: '\u00e9'.repeat(40_000) });
    const task = getTask(h.db, made(service().recordRoleWake(b)).taskId);
    expect(Buffer.byteLength(task?.title ?? '')).toBe(510);
    expect(task?.title).toBe('\u8bae'.repeat(170));
    expect(Buffer.byteLength(task?.body ?? '')).toBe(64 * 1024);
    expect(task?.body).not.toContain('\ufffd');
  });

  it("answers a uuid already recorded by its wake row first, skipping a chat turn's", () => {
    const { b } = batch();
    const turn = recordWake(h.db, { ...b }, NOW + 2);
    if (!turn.ok) throw new Error(turn.message);
    const [tasks, wakes] = [count('kanban_tasks'), count('kanban_wakes')];
    expect(service().recordRoleWake(b)).toEqual({ ok: true, skipped: 'turn', reason: 'wake u-1 is recorded already, as a turn of the chat session, and makes no reaction task' });
    expect([count('kanban_tasks'), count('kanban_wakes')]).toEqual([tasks, wakes]);
  });

  it('skips a batch of a conversation whose subscription is gone, and writes nothing', () => {
    const { source, event, b } = batch();
    const gone = { ...b, events: [{ subscriptionId: 999, eventId: event, taskId: source }] };
    const [tasks, wakes] = [count('kanban_tasks'), count('kanban_wakes')];
    expect(service().recordRoleWake(gone)).toEqual({ ok: true, skipped: 'subscription', reason: 'no subscription 999 for the reaction task to follow' });
    expect([count('kanban_tasks'), count('kanban_wakes')]).toEqual([tasks, wakes]);
  });

  it("tells the reaction task's run of its source task's own directory", () => {
    const source = newTask(h.db, { createdVia: THREAD, workspace: 'web', wake: { by: ALICE, depth: 0, role: 'vi-coordinator' } });
    const run = claim(h.db, { taskId: source.taskId, claimant: claimantFor(h.db, source.taskId), workspaces: new Set(['web']), isolated: new Set(['web']) }, NOW + 1);
    if (!run.ok) throw new Error(run.message);
    registerWorktree(h.db, { id: `wt:${source.taskId}`, kind: 'git-worktree', rootPath: `/home/mt/worktrees/web/${source.taskId}`, repoRoot: '/srv/web', branch: `mt/${source.taskId}` }, NOW + 1);

    const event = eventsOf(h.db, source.taskId).at(-1)?.id ?? 0;
    const sub = subscriptionsOf(h.db, source.taskId)[0]?.id ?? 0;
    const { b } = { b: { ...batch().b, uuid: 'u-dir', events: [{ subscriptionId: sub, eventId: event, taskId: source.taskId }] } };
    const reaction = made(service().recordRoleWake(b)).taskId;
    const claimedRun = claim(h.db, { taskId: reaction, claimant: claimantFor(h.db, reaction), workspaces: new Set(['web']), isolated: new Set(['web']) }, NOW + 3);
    if (!claimedRun.ok) throw new Error(claimedRun.message);
    const brief = briefFor(h.db, { run: claimedRun.run, task: claimedRun.task, roleMd: undefined, role: undefined });
    expect(brief.workdir?.upstream).toEqual([
      { taskId: source.taskId, path: `/home/mt/worktrees/web/${source.taskId}`, branch: `mt/${source.taskId}`, abandoned: false },
    ]);
  });

  it('rolls everything back on any other refusal, and the batch is tried again with the same key', () => {
    const { b } = batch({ title: '   ' });
    const [tasks, wakes] = [count('kanban_tasks'), count('kanban_wakes')];
    expect(service().recordRoleWake(b)).toEqual({ ok: false, code: 'invalid', message: 'a task needs a title' });
    expect([count('kanban_tasks'), count('kanban_wakes'), count('kanban_wake_events')]).toEqual([tasks, wakes, 0]);
    const again = made(service().recordRoleWake({ ...b, title: 'React to board updates' }));
    expect(getTask(h.db, again.taskId)?.idempotencyKey).toBe('wake:u-1');
  });
});

describe('wake_root', () => {
  it("is passed on to a reaction run's follow-ups however deep, and to a workflow its run applies", () => {
    const { taskId } = made(service().recordRoleWake(batch().b));
    const run = claimed(h.db, taskId, { assignee: { kind: 'role', name: 'vi-coordinator' } });
    const follow = createTask(
      h.db,
      // Another workspace: the reaction run still holds the default one.
      { title: 'a follow-up', assignee: { kind: 'role', name: 'implementer' }, workspace: 'web', createdBy: `run:${run.runId}`, createdVia: { kind: 'run', runId: run.runId } },
      NOW + 20,
    );
    if (!follow.ok) throw new Error(follow.message);
    expect(follow.task.wakeRoot).toBe(taskId);
    const deeper = claimed(h.db, follow.task.taskId);
    const next = createTask(h.db, { title: 'a follow-up of it', createdBy: `run:${deeper.runId}`, createdVia: { kind: 'run', runId: deeper.runId } }, NOW + 30);
    if (!next.ok) throw new Error(next.message);
    expect(next.task.wakeRoot).toBe(taskId);
    const applied = service().applyDag({ dag: { format: 1, tasks: [{ ref: 'a', title: 'A' }] }, createdBy: `run:${run.runId}`, createdVia: { kind: 'run', runId: run.runId } });
    if (!applied.ok || !('instance' in applied)) throw new Error('not applied');
    expect(applied.tasks.map((t) => t.task.wakeRoot)).toEqual([taskId]);
  });

  it('is none for a task made by chat, the terminal or an ordinary run', () => {
    const chat = newTask(h.db, { createdVia: THREAD });
    const terminal = newTask(h.db, { createdVia: { kind: 'operator' } });
    const run = claimed(h.db, chat.taskId);
    const follow = createTask(h.db, { title: 'a follow-up', createdBy: `run:${run.runId}`, createdVia: { kind: 'run', runId: run.runId } }, NOW + 1);
    if (!follow.ok) throw new Error(follow.message);
    expect([chat.wakeRoot, terminal.wakeRoot, follow.task.wakeRoot]).toEqual([null, null, null]);
  });
});
```

with:

```ts

/** A role's batch, as the waker formed it (wake spec §19.3): the batch, the role, and the reaction task's words. */
export interface NewRoleWake extends NewWakeBatch {
  role: string;
  title: string;
  /** The prompt (wake spec §7, §19.5), masked. */
  body: string;
}

/** What `recordRoleWake` did: made its task, found it made, or skipped the wake, saying why. */
export type RoleWakeMade =
  | { wake: WakeRow; task: TaskRow; existing: boolean }
  | { skipped: 'board' | 'role' | 'turn' | 'subscription'; reason: string };

/**
 * A role's wake (wake spec §19.3): the `kanban_wakes` row, already `delivered`,
 * with its role and its reaction task, its events, every covered
 * subscription's `wake_cursor` moved, and the reaction task, made by
 * `insertTask` as `createTask` makes any, with its subscription, a copy of the
 * batch's conversation's, all in one transaction. It makes `createTask`'s
 * checks, none bypassed, in its order: the key `wake:<uuid>` first, whose task
 * answers a repeat and writes nothing; the board, by `liveBoard`, and the role,
 * by `assignable` as it is now, each a skip, with nothing written; the checked
 * fields, with the title and body cut to their limits, never refused for
 * length, any other refusal rolling everything back.
 *
 * The task is the batch's oldest event's task's: its board, and its
 * `created_from_task`, so the role's workspace is resolved from it; by the
 * setter, its wake off, its depth the batch's + 1, its `wake_root` its own id.
 */
export function recordRoleWake(db: Db, batch: NewRoleWake, facts: TaskFacts, now: number): Result<RoleWakeMade> {
  return tx(db, (d) => {
    if (batch.events.length === 0) return refuse('invalid', 'a wake covers at least one event');
    const key = `wake:${batch.uuid}`;
    // The repeat first, by its wake row: a uuid is its batch's, whichever target recorded it.
    const recorded = wakeByUuid(d, batch.uuid);
    if (recorded !== undefined) {
      // A uuid a chat turn recorded is that turn's batch: skipped, as waiting would never change it.
      if (recorded.reactionTask === null) {
        return { ok: true, skipped: 'turn', reason: `wake ${batch.uuid} is recorded already, as a turn of the chat session, and makes no reaction task` };
      }
      const made = getTaskByKey(d, key) ?? getTask(d, recorded.reactionTask);
      if (made === undefined) throw new Error(`wake ${batch.uuid} names reaction task ${recorded.reactionTask}, which is not on the board`);
      return { ok: true, wake: recorded, task: made, existing: true };
    }
    const oldest = [...batch.events].sort((a, b) => a.eventId - b.eventId)[0];
    if (oldest === undefined) return refuse('invalid', 'a wake covers at least one event');
    const source = mustGet(d, oldest.taskId);
    const live = liveBoard(d, source.board);
    if (!live.ok) return { ok: true, skipped: 'board', reason: live.message };
    const who = assignable(batch.role, facts);
    if (!who.ok) return { ok: true, skipped: 'role', reason: who.message };
    const sub = getSubscription(d, oldest.subscriptionId);
    // A batch of a conversation follows its subscription: one gone is skipped, as no later try would find it.
    if (sub === undefined) return { ok: true, skipped: 'subscription', reason: `no subscription ${oldest.subscriptionId} for the reaction task to follow` };
    const taskId = newTaskId();
    const { lastInsertRowid } = d
      .prepare(
        `INSERT INTO kanban_wakes (uuid, channel, app_id, conversation_id, thread_id, principal, depth, state, created_at, delivered_at,
                                   target_role, reaction_task)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'delivered', ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
      )
      .run(batch.uuid, batch.channel, batch.appId, batch.conversationId, batch.threadId, batch.principal, batch.depth, now, now, batch.role, taskId);
    const wakeId = Number(lastInsertRowid);
    const insert = d.prepare('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO kanban_wake_events (wake_id, subscription_id, event_id, task_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)');
    for (const e of batch.events) insert.run(wakeId, e.subscriptionId, e.eventId, e.taskId);
    const createdVia: CreatedVia = { kind: 'wake', wakeId };
    const title = cutToBytes(batch.title, WORKER_LIMITS.title);
    const body = cutToBytes(batch.body, WORKER_LIMITS.body);
    const checked = checkTask({ title, body, assignee: batch.role, createdBy: batch.principal, createdVia }, facts);
    if (!checked.ok) return checked;
    insertTask(
      d,
      {
        title,
        body,
        contract: checked.contract,
        assignee: checked.assignee ?? null,
        idempotencyKey: key,
        createdBy: batch.principal,
        createdVia,
        board: source.board,
        createdFromTask: source.taskId,
        parents: [],
        wake: { by: null, depth: batch.depth + 1 },
        reaction: { taskId, wakeId },
        copySubscription: sub,
      },
      now,
    );
    moveWakeCursors(d, wakeId);
    const wake = getWake(d, wakeId);
    if (wake === undefined) throw new Error(`wake ${wakeId} vanished inside its own transaction`);
    return { ok: true, wake, task: mustGet(d, taskId), existing: false };
  });
}

/** Its marker sent, or tried (wake spec §5.5 step 3): `marker_at`, written once. */
```

```ts
/** Sizes, in UTF-8 bytes, of what a worker may send; chat and the terminal keep to them too. */
```

with:

```ts

/**
 * `text` cut to at most `max` UTF-8 bytes, on a whole character: what a
 * writer that must never refuse for length keeps (wake spec §19.3).
 */
export function cutToBytes(text: string, max: number): string {
  if (Buffer.byteLength(text) <= max) return text;
  let bytes = 0;
  let end = 0;
  for (const ch of text) {
    const n = Buffer.byteLength(ch);
    if (bytes + n > max) break;
    bytes += n;
    end += ch.length;
  }
  return text.slice(0, end);
}

/** Sizes, in UTF-8 bytes, of what a worker may send; chat and the terminal keep to them too. */
```

```ts
   * own write, the only one that makes a task by a wake.
   */
  recordRoleWake(batch: board.NewRoleWake): Result<board.RoleWakeMade> {
    return board.recordRoleWake(this.#db, batch, this.#facts(), this.#clock.now());
```

### Task 55: No cron jobs under a wake

**Files:**

- Create: `tests/wake-cron-root.test.ts`
- Modify: `src/cron/worker.ts`

§19.8's cron rule, amending cron §6.3's "a board run's `add` is accepted". In `src/cron/worker.ts`, the `add` of a board run whose task has `wake_root` set, a reaction task's and every task made from one, however deep, a workflow member of a start such a run made included (Task 54 writes the mark), is refused `needs_operator`, in the words a woken chat turn's refusal uses, now one constant, `NEEDS_OPERATOR`. An ordinary board run's add is accepted as before.

- [ ] **Step 55.1: Write the tests.**

Create `tests/wake-cron-root.test.ts`:

```ts
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { addComment, claim, createTask } from '../src/db/kanban.js';
import { eventsOf, subscriptionsOf } from '../src/db/kanban-read.js';
import { CronService } from '../src/cron/service.js';
import { CronTokens } from '../src/cron/tokens.js';
import { CronApi } from '../src/cron/worker.js';
import { KanbanService } from '../src/kanban/service.js';
import { hashToken, mintToken } from '../src/kanban/token.js';
import { clearSecrets } from '../src/secrets.js';
import { NOW } from './helpers/cron.js';
import { ManualClock, testDb, type TestDb } from './helpers/db.js';
import { role } from './helpers/dispatch.js';
import { ALICE, WORKSPACES, claimantFor, newTask } from './helpers/kanban.js';

/**
 * No cron jobs under a wake (wake spec §19.8): a run whose task has `wake_root`
 * set, a reaction task's and every task made from one, however deep, workflow
 * members of a start such a run made included, may not add a cron job: its `mt
 * cron add` is refused `needs_operator`, in the words a woken chat turn's
 * refusal uses. An ordinary board run's add is accepted, as before.
 */

const NEEDS_OPERATOR = 'this turn was asked by someone without operate tier, who cannot add cron jobs; an operator can, here or with /cron add';
const THREAD = { kind: 'chat' as const, channel: 'lark', appId: 'cli_app', conversationId: 'oc_team', threadId: 'omt_topic', rootId: 'om_root', chatType: 'group' as const };

let h: TestDb;
let api: CronApi;
let board: KanbanService;
const roles = new Map([['default', role('default')], ['worker', role('worker')], ['vi-coordinator', role('vi-coordinator')]]);

beforeEach(() => {
  clearSecrets();
  h = testDb();
  const clock = new ManualClock(NOW);
  const service = new CronService({ db: h.db, roles, workspaces: new Set(['default']), zone: 'Asia/Shanghai', clock });
  api = new CronApi({ db: h.db, service, tokens: new CronTokens({ db: h.db }), appId: 'cli_app' });
  board = new KanbanService({ db: h.db, roles, workspaces: WORKSPACES, clock });
});
afterEach(() => {
  clearSecrets();
  h.close();
});

/** A claim of the task, with a token. */
function running(taskId: string): { runId: string; token: string } {
  const token = mintToken();
  const r = claim(h.db, { taskId, claimant: claimantFor(h.db, taskId), tokenHash: hashToken(token), workspaces: WORKSPACES }, NOW);
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.message);
  return { runId: r.run.runId, token };
}

const add = (r: { runId: string; token: string }) =>
  api.handle({ cron: 'add', token: r.token, run: r.runId, input: { schedule: 'every day 09:00', prompt: 'Summarise the day.' } });

/** A reaction task, made by a role's wake of a task in thread omt_topic. */
function reaction(): string {
  const source = newTask(h.db, { createdVia: THREAD, wake: { by: ALICE, depth: 0, role: 'vi-coordinator' } });
  addComment(h.db, source.taskId, ALICE, 'an outcome stands in here', NOW, false);
  const r = board.recordRoleWake({
    uuid: 'u-1',
    channel: 'lark',
    appId: 'cli_app',
    conversationId: 'oc_team',
    threadId: 'omt_topic',
    principal: ALICE,
    depth: 0,
    events: [{ subscriptionId: subscriptionsOf(h.db, source.taskId)[0]?.id ?? 0, eventId: eventsOf(h.db, source.taskId).at(-1)?.id ?? 0, taskId: source.taskId }],
    role: 'vi-coordinator',
    title: 'React to board updates',
    body: 'Board update',
  });
  if (!r.ok || !('task' in r)) throw new Error('no reaction task');
  return r.task.taskId;
}

/** A follow-up made by `run`, assigned to worker, in its own workspace. */
function followUp(run: { runId: string }, workspace: string): string {
  const r = createTask(
    h.db,
    { title: 'a follow-up', assignee: { kind: 'role', name: 'worker' }, workspace, createdBy: `run:${run.runId}`, createdVia: { kind: 'run', runId: run.runId } },
    NOW,
  );
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.message);
  return r.task.taskId;
}

describe("a run of work a wake put on the board", () => {
  it("refuses a reaction run's add, in a woken chat turn's words", async () => {
    expect(await add(running(reaction()))).toEqual({ ok: false, code: 'needs_operator', message: NEEDS_OPERATOR });
  });

  it("refuses the add of a follow-up's run, of its follow-up's, and of a workflow member's the reaction run started", async () => {
    const first = running(reaction());
    const child = followUp(first, 'web');
    const childRun = running(child);
    expect(await add(childRun)).toEqual({ ok: false, code: 'needs_operator', message: NEEDS_OPERATOR });
    const grandchild = followUp(childRun, 'api');
    expect(await add(running(grandchild))).toEqual({ ok: false, code: 'needs_operator', message: NEEDS_OPERATOR });
    const applied = board.applyDag({
      dag: { format: 1, tasks: [{ ref: 'a', title: 'A', assignee: 'worker', workspace: 'docs' }] },
      createdBy: `run:${first.runId}`,
      createdVia: { kind: 'run', runId: first.runId },
    });
    if (!applied.ok || !('instance' in applied)) throw new Error('not applied');
    const member = applied.tasks[0]?.taskId ?? '';
    expect(await add(running(member))).toEqual({ ok: false, code: 'needs_operator', message: NEEDS_OPERATOR });
  });

  it("still accepts an ordinary board run's add", async () => {
    const task = newTask(h.db, { assignee: { kind: 'role', name: 'worker' } });
    expect(await add(running(task.taskId))).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
  });
});
```

### Task 56: The waker's role batches

**Files:**

- Create: `tests/wake-role-waker.test.ts`
- Modify: `src/index.ts`, `src/kanban/service.ts`, `src/kanban/waker.ts`, `tests/helpers/waker.ts`

§19.2 to §19.5, §19.7, §5.2 step 4. A conversation's outcomes are now batched by target, then setter: a task whose `wake_role` is set forms a role's batch, which the waker gives to `recordRoleWake` (Task 54) instead of a session. No session is bound or submitted to, and neither the busy check nor the refusals apply; the per-hour cap does, as a role's row is delivered, and the depth does, the reaction task being one level deeper. The setter's operate tier and the role's usability (`WakerDeps.assignable`, the service's `wakeRoleUsable`) are checked live as each batch is formed; a role removed, a setter without operate tier, an archived board and a batch too deep are each passed over with their line, once a task. The prompt (`wakePrompt`'s `role`) gets §19.5's header, its unblock note names `mt kanban wake-unblock` with JSON on stdin, and its deferred note says "when your run ends". The marker is `Waking vi-coordinator for 1 board update (k_…).`. Nothing changes for a chat session's wake.

```ts
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { archiveBoard, createBoard, dropWake, recordWake, setWake } from '../src/db/kanban.js';
import { wakeBatchUuid } from '../src/core/ids.js';
import { getTask, subscriptionsOf, wakeEventsOf } from '../src/db/kanban-read.js';
import { WORKER_LIMITS } from '../src/kanban/limits.js';
import type { KanbanEvent, TaskRow } from '../src/kanban/types.js';
import { reactionTitle, roleMarkerText, wakePrompt } from '../src/kanban/waker.js';
import type { Role } from '../src/roles.js';
import { role } from './helpers/dispatch.js';
import { ALICE, NOW } from './helpers/kanban.js';
import { APP, wakeHarness, type WakeHarness } from './helpers/waker.js';

/**
 * A role's wake in the waker (wake spec §19.2 to §19.5, §19.7): its outcomes
 * batched by target and setter, made into one reaction task by
 * `recordRoleWake`, with the role's marker; no session submitted to; the
 * setter's operate tier and the role's usability checked live; an archived
 * board and the depth each a skip, with its line; the cap counting it.
 */

let roles: Map<string, Role>;
let h: WakeHarness;
beforeEach(() => {
  // The service reads the roles as they are now, so a role taken out here is a role removed from the gateway.
  roles = new Map([['vi-coordinator', role('vi-coordinator')]]);
  h = wakeHarness({}, { roles });
});
afterEach(() => {
  h.waker.stop();
  h.t.close();
});

/** A task in the thread with wake on for role vi-coordinator, as `by`. */
function forRole(by = ALICE, more: Parameters<WakeHarness['woken']>[1] = {}): TaskRow {
  const task = h.woken(by, more);
  const r = setWake(h.db, task.taskId, { on: true, as: by, maxDepth: 5, role: 'vi-coordinator' }, by, APP, NOW);
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.message);
  h.noticed(task);
  return r.task;
}

function completed(task: TaskRow, summary = 'Booked.'): number {
  return h.event(task, 'completed', ALICE, { summary });
}

/** The reaction tasks on the board. */
function reactions(): TaskRow[] {
  const ids = h.db.prepare<[], { task_id: string }>('SELECT task_id FROM kanban_tasks WHERE reaction_of IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rowid').all();
  return ids.map((r) => getTask(h.db, r.task_id)).filter((t): t is TaskRow => t !== undefined);
}

describe("a role's wake that no later try would make", () => {
  it('passes over a batch whose uuid a chat turn recorded, with one log line, and backs off from nothing', async () => {
    const task = forRole();
    const event = completed(task);
    const [sub] = subscriptionsOf(h.db, task.taskId);
    const turn = recordWake(
      h.db,
      {
        uuid: wakeBatchUuid(APP, [[sub?.id ?? 0, event]]),
        channel: 'lark',
        appId: APP,
        conversationId: sub?.conversationId ?? '',
        threadId: sub?.threadId ?? '',
        principal: ALICE,
        depth: 0,
        events: [{ subscriptionId: sub?.id ?? 0, eventId: event, taskId: task.taskId }],
      },
      NOW,
    );
    if (!turn.ok) throw new Error(turn.message);
    // Settled, its cursors left where they are, so the role's batch of the same events is formed again.
    const dropped = dropWake(h.db, turn.wake.wakeId, 'settled by the test', NOW, { tasks: [] });
    if (!dropped.ok) throw new Error(dropped.message);
    expect(await h.round()).toBe(0);
    expect(reactions()).toEqual([]);
    expect(h.notes.filter((n) => n.includes('was not made (wake ') && n.includes('passing over its outcomes'))).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(subscriptionsOf(h.db, task.taskId)[0]?.wakeCursor).toBe(event);
    completed(task);
    expect(await h.round()).toBe(1);
    expect(reactions()).toHaveLength(1);
  });
});

describe("a role's wake", () => {
  it('makes one reaction task for the role, its row delivered, its marker naming it, and submits to no session', async () => {
    const task = forRole();
    const event = completed(task);
    expect(await h.round()).toBe(1);
    const [made] = reactions();
    expect(made).toMatchObject({
      title: `React to board updates: ${task.taskId} completed`,
      assignee: { kind: 'role', name: 'vi-coordinator' },
      createdBy: ALICE,
      wakeBy: null,
      wakeDepth: 1,
      wakeRoot: made?.taskId,
    });
    expect(made?.body).toContain('Board update: you are this task\'s run because wake is on for the tasks below (set by Alice) and names role vi-coordinator.');
    const [wake] = h.wakes();
    expect(wake).toMatchObject({ state: 'delivered', targetRole: 'vi-coordinator', reactionTask: made?.taskId, sessionId: null });
    expect(wakeEventsOf(h.db, wake?.wakeId ?? 0).map((e) => e.eventId)).toEqual([event]);
    expect(h.lark.texts.map((t) => t.text)).toEqual([`Waking vi-coordinator for 1 board update (${made?.taskId}).`]);
    expect(h.registry.submits).toEqual([]);
    expect(subscriptionsOf(h.db, task.taskId)[0]?.wakeCursor).toBe(event);
    // Nothing more: the batch is the task's, and its marker went once.
    expect(await h.round()).toBe(0);
    expect(reactions()).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(h.lark.texts).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('makes one task of three outcomes in one round, one setter, one role', async () => {
    const a = forRole();
    const b = forRole();
    const c = forRole();
    completed(a);
    h.event(b, 'blocked', 'run:r_2', { kind: 'needs_input', reason: 'Which one?', blockRecurrences: 1 });
    h.event(c, 'stranded', 'gateway', { reason: 'its workspace is gone' });
    expect(await h.round()).toBe(1);
    const [made] = reactions();
    expect(made?.title).toBe(`React to board updates: ${a.taskId} completed, ${b.taskId} blocked, ${c.taskId} stranded`);
    expect(h.lark.texts.map((t) => t.text)).toEqual([`Waking vi-coordinator for 3 board updates (${made?.taskId}).`]);
  });

  it('gives a thread with a task for the chat session and one for a role a turn and a task', async () => {
    const turn = h.woken();
    const task = forRole();
    completed(turn);
    completed(task);
    await h.round();
    await h.round();
    expect(h.registry.submits).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(reactions()).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('passes over a role that can no longer be given work, saying so once', async () => {
    const task = forRole();
    roles.delete('vi-coordinator');
    const event = completed(task);
    await h.round();
    completed(task, 'Again.');
    await h.round();
    expect(reactions()).toEqual([]);
    expect(h.lark.texts.map((t) => t.text)).toEqual([
      `wake is off for \`${task.taskId}\`: role vi-coordinator can no longer be given work (role "vi-coordinator" is not configured)`,
    ]);
    expect(subscriptionsOf(h.db, task.taskId)[0]?.wakeCursor).toBeGreaterThan(event);
  });

  it("skips a setter who lost operate tier, saying so once", async () => {
    const task = forRole();
    h.operate.delete(ALICE);
    completed(task);
    await h.round();
    completed(task, 'Again.');
    await h.round();
    expect(reactions()).toEqual([]);
    expect(h.lark.texts.map((t) => t.text)).toEqual([`wake is off for \`${task.taskId}\`: Alice no longer has operate tier`]);
  });

  it('makes no task at the depth, passing the batch over with the depth line', async () => {
    const task = forRole(ALICE, { wake: { by: ALICE, depth: 4 } });
    const event = completed(task);
    await h.round();
    expect(reactions()).toEqual([]);
    expect(h.lark.texts.map((t) => t.text)).toEqual([`\`${task.taskId}\` is 5 tasks deep in woken turns, so it stays notice-only`]);
    expect(subscriptionsOf(h.db, task.taskId)[0]?.wakeCursor).toBe(event);
  });

  it("skips a batch whose board is archived, with the board's line", async () => {
    expect(createBoard(h.db, 'research', ALICE, NOW).ok).toBe(true);
    const task = forRole(ALICE, { board: 'research' });
    h.db.prepare("UPDATE kanban_tasks SET phase = 'done' WHERE task_id = ?").run(task.taskId);
    expect(archiveBoard(h.db, 'research', ALICE, NOW).ok).toBe(true);
    completed(task);
    await h.round();
    expect(reactions()).toEqual([]);
    expect(h.lark.texts.map((t) => t.text)).toEqual([`the board did not wake vi-coordinator for \`${task.taskId}\`: board research is archived`]);
  });

  it('is counted by the per-hour cap with the chat turns', async () => {
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i += 1) {
      const task = forRole();
      completed(task);
      await h.round();
    }
    expect(reactions()).toHaveLength(6);
    const seventh = forRole();
    completed(seventh);
    await h.round();
    expect(reactions()).toHaveLength(6);
    expect(h.lark.texts.at(-1)?.text).toMatch(/^wakes are paused here until \d\d:\d\d: 6 this hour$/);
  });
});
```

```ts
}

/** A role's marker (§19.7): the role by name, and the reaction task by id. */
export function roleMarkerText(role: string, n: number, taskId: string): string {
  return `Waking ${role} for ${n} board update${n === 1 ? '' : 's'} (${taskId}).`;
}

/** An outcome's word in a reaction task's title (§19.3). */
function outcomeWord(e: KanbanEvent): string {
  switch (e.kind) {
    case 'completed':
      return 'completed';
    case 'changes_requested':
      return 'changes requested';
    case 'blocked':
      return 'blocked';
    case 'run_ended':
      return str(payloadOf(e), 'blockKind') === 'gave_up' ? 'gave up' : 'blocked';
    default:
      return 'stranded';
  }
}

/**
 * A reaction task's title (§19.3): `React to board updates: `, then each
 * event's task id and outcome word in event order, cut at the title's limit,
 * in UTF-8 bytes, with `, and N more`.
 */
export function reactionTitle(outcomes: ReadonlyArray<{ taskId: string; event: KanbanEvent }>): string {
  const head = 'React to board updates: ';
  const items = outcomes.map((o) => `${o.taskId} ${outcomeWord(o.event)}`);
  for (let n = items.length; n > 0; n -= 1) {
    const more = items.length - n;
    const title = `${head}${items.slice(0, n).join(', ')}${more > 0 ? `, and ${more} more` : ''}`;
    if (Buffer.byteLength(title) <= WORKER_LIMITS.title) return title;
  }
  return cutToBytes(`${head}${items.length} updates`, WORKER_LIMITS.title);
}
```

```ts
  #passBatch(batch: Batch): void {
```

```ts

  /**
   * A role's batch (§19.3, §19.4, §19.7): no session, no busy check and no
   * refusals, as its reaction task waits in the board's queue. Too deep, it is
   * passed over with the depth's line; over the cap, it waits; then
   * `recordRoleWake` makes the reaction task, its row delivered, its cursors
   * moved, in one transaction, and the marker names it. An archived board or a
   * role removed since is a skip, passed over with its line; any other refusal,
   * or a throw, holds the conversation back with the pause, and the same batch
   * is tried again, with the same uuid and key.
   */
  async #tryRole(batch: Batch, role: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const deps = this.#deps;
    const at = batch.at;
    const key = conversationOf(at);
    const held = this.#backoff.get(key);
    if (held !== undefined && this.#clock.now() < held.until) return false;
    const depth = Math.max(...batch.covered.map((c) => c.task.wakeDepth));
    if (depth + 1 >= deps.settings.maxDepth) {
      this.#passBatch(batch);
      for (const taskId of new Set(batch.covered.map((c) => c.task.taskId))) {
        await this.#sayOnceFor(
          at,
          `deep:${taskId}`,
          `\`${taskId}\` is ${depth + 1} tasks deep in woken turns, so it stays notice-only`,
          replyUuid(deps.appId, `wake-deep:${taskId}`, String(batch.covered[0]?.event.id ?? 0)),
          `the depth line of task ${taskId}`,
        );
      }
      return false;
    }
    if (await this.#capped(at)) return false;
    if (this.#clock.now() - this.#roundStart >= ROUND_MARKER_MS) return false;
    const channel = deps.channels.get(at.channel);
    if (channel === undefined) {
      this.#note(`kanban: no channel ${at.channel} for a wake of role ${role}`);
      return false;
    }
    const left = this.#unlifted(batch.covered);
    const prompt = wakePrompt({
      setter: batch.principal,
      operate: deps.people.canOperate(batch.principal),
      outcomes: left.map((c) => this.#outcome(c)),
      nameOf: deps.people.chatNames(),
      runAssignee: (runId) => getRun(deps.db, runId)?.assignee,
      blockRecurrenceLimit: deps.blockRecurrenceLimit,
      maxDepth: deps.settings.maxDepth,
      ...(deps.settings.holdMinutes === undefined ? {} : { holdMinutes: deps.settings.holdMinutes }),
      role,
    });
    const told = new Set(prompt.told.map((e) => e.id));
    const pairs = batch.covered.map((c) => [c.sub.id, c.event.id] as const);
    const uuid = wakeBatchUuid(deps.appId, pairs);
    let made: ReturnType<KanbanService['recordRoleWake']>;
    try {
      made = deps.service.recordRoleWake({
        uuid,
        channel: at.channel,
        appId: at.appId,
        conversationId: at.conversationId,
        threadId: at.threadId,
        principal: batch.principal,
        depth,
        events: batch.covered.map((c) => ({ subscriptionId: c.sub.id, eventId: c.event.id, taskId: c.task.taskId })),
        role,
        title: reactionTitle(left.filter((c) => told.has(c.event.id)).map((c) => ({ taskId: c.task.taskId, event: c.event }))),
        body: prompt.text,
      });
    } catch (err) {
      made = { ok: false, code: 'invalid', message: message(err) };
    }
    if (!made.ok) {
      const waitMs = Math.min((held?.waitMs ?? WAKE_POLL_MS / 2) * 2, WAKE_BACKOFF_MAX_MS);
      this.#backoff.set(key, { until: this.#clock.now() + waitMs, waitMs });
      this.#note(`kanban: the reaction task of role ${role} for ${describe(at)} was not made (${made.message}); trying again in ${Math.round(waitMs / 1000)} s`);
      return false;
    }
    this.#backoff.delete(key);
    const source = batch.covered[0]?.task.taskId ?? '';
    if ('skipped' in made) {
      this.#passBatch(batch);
      if (made.skipped === 'role') await this.#roleGone(at, source, role, made.reason, batch.covered[0]?.event.id ?? 0);
      else if (made.skipped !== 'board') {
        // A batch no later try would make (its uuid a chat turn's, its subscription gone): passed over, logged once.
        this.#note(`kanban: the reaction task of role ${role} for task ${source} was not made (${made.reason}); passing over its outcomes`);
      } else {
        await this.#sayOnceFor(
          at,
          `board:${source}`,
          `the board did not wake ${role} for \`${source}\`: ${made.reason}`,
          replyUuid(deps.appId, `wake:${uuid}`, 'board'),
          `the board line of task ${source}`,
        );
      }
      return false;
    }
    this.#paused.delete(key);
    if (made.wake.markerAt === null) {
      await this.#line(
        channel,
        targetOf(deps.db, at),
        roleMarkerText(role, left.length, made.task.taskId),
        replyUuid(deps.appId, `wake:${uuid}`, 'marker'),
        `the marker of wake ${made.wake.wakeId}`,
      );
      const marked = deps.service.wakeMarked(made.wake.wakeId);
      if (!marked.ok) this.#note(`kanban: wake ${made.wake.wakeId}'s marker was not recorded (${marked.message})`);
    }
    // A deferred block cut from the prompt (§7): the run is not told of it, so its button goes now (§5.9).
    for (const c of left) if (!told.has(c.event.id)) this.#release(c, 'not_woken');
    return true;
  }

  /** A pending row (§5.2 step 1): its batch as recorded, read again, then tried, unless it waits. */
```

### Task 57: `wake-show` and `wake-unblock`

**Files:**

- Create: `tests/wake-worker-scope.test.ts`
- Modify: `src/db/kanban-read.ts`, `src/index.ts`, `src/kanban/wake-api.ts`, `src/kanban/worker.ts`, `tests/kanban-worker.test.ts`, `tests/mt-kanban.test.ts`, `tests/mt.test.ts`

§19.8 and §19.3. Two worker commands join `WORKER_COMMANDS`, JSON on stdin, carried by the run's own token as every worker command is: `wake-show` `{"task_id"}` and `wake-unblock` `{"task_id", "comment"?}`. The worker API finds the scope by the run: its task's `reaction_of` names the wake (`wakeOfReaction`, a new read), and the command goes through the woken turn's own show and unblock, `WakeApi.show` and `.unblock`, now public, given that wake: so §9.2's checks run in its order, judged by the wake's setter's tiers, live, and the unblock's event records the wake, its actor the setter, its comment `(woken by the board) …`. A run of a task that is not a reaction task is refused `not_woken`; with wakes off, `wake_off`. The show answers in the worker's JSON form, `{"ok": true, "task": …}`, as the operator's `--json`. A run's `link` of a reaction task is refused `wrong_task`, though its `created_from_task` is the run's task. The usage lines and the worker API's unknown-command refusal, which list the commands, gain the two. Its tests hold §9.2's order through `wake-unblock`: a block lifted since and made again is `stale`, as the unblock is bound to the wake's block event; a block at `block_recurrence_limit` is `recurring`; five woken unblocks go through, the sixth is refused `woken_unblock_limit` with its line said once, and a completion starts the count again. An unblock nudges the dispatcher once: the worker API leaves `wake-unblock` to the `WakeApi`'s own nudge.

```ts
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { showJson, wokenShowText } from '../src/cli/plain.js';
import { block, closeRun, complete, setWake } from '../src/db/kanban.js';
import { commentsOf, eventsOf, getTask, openRunOf, subscriptionsOf, wokenUnblocksSince } from '../src/db/kanban-read.js';
import { KanbanService } from '../src/kanban/service.js';
import { hashToken, mintToken } from '../src/kanban/token.js';
import type { CreatedVia } from '../src/kanban/types.js';
import { WakeApi } from '../src/kanban/wake-api.js';
import { WORKER_COMMANDS, WorkerApi, type WorkerResponse } from '../src/kanban/worker.js';
import type { Role } from '../src/roles.js';
import { FakeChannel } from './helpers/channel.js';
import { ManualClock, testDb, type TestDb } from './helpers/db.js';
import { role } from './helpers/dispatch.js';
import { ALICE, NOW, WORKSPACES, claimed, newTask } from './helpers/kanban.js';

/**
 * A reaction task's run's scope (wake spec §19.8): `mt kanban wake-show` and
 * `wake-unblock`, worker commands carried by the run's own token, scoped by
 * its task's wake to the tasks the wake carried, judged by the wake's setter's
 * tiers, live, with §9.2's checks; and a run's `link` of a reaction task
 * refused (§19.3).
 */

const APP = 'cli_app';
const THREAD: CreatedVia = { kind: 'chat', channel: 'lark', appId: APP, conversationId: 'oc_team', threadId: 'omt_1', rootId: 'om_root', chatType: 'group' };
const ROLES: ReadonlyMap<string, Role> = new Map([
  ['implementer', role('implementer')],
  ['vi-coordinator', role('vi-coordinator')],
]);

let t: TestDb;
let service: KanbanService;
let api: WorkerApi;
let wakesOn: boolean;
let talk: Set<string>;
let operate: Set<string>;
let changes: number;
let lark: FakeChannel;

beforeEach(() => {
  t = testDb();
  service = new KanbanService({ db: t.db, roles: ROLES, workspaces: WORKSPACES, clock: new ManualClock(NOW + 100) });
  wakesOn = true;
  talk = new Set([ALICE]);
  operate = new Set([ALICE]);
  changes = 0;
  lark = new FakeChannel();
  const wakes = new WakeApi({
    db: t.db,
    service,
    tokens: { lookup: () => undefined },
    people: { canTalk: (p) => talk.has(p), canOperate: (p) => talk.has(p) && operate.has(p), chatNames: () => (p) => (p === ALICE ? 'Zhixi Sun' : undefined) },
    blockRecurrenceLimit: 3,
    render: { lines: wokenShowText, json: showJson },
    channels: new Map([['lark', lark]]),
    appId: APP,
    zone: 'UTC',
    nudge: () => (changes += 1),
  });
  api = new WorkerApi({ db: t.db, service, changed: () => (changes += 1), wakes: () => (wakesOn ? wakes : undefined) });
});
afterEach(() => t.close());

/** A source task blocked by its run, wake on for vi-coordinator; its reaction task, made by the wake; and a run of it, with its token. */
function reaction(blocks = 1): { source: string; other: string; react: string; ask: (command: string, input?: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<WorkerResponse> } {
  const source = newTask(t.db, { createdVia: THREAD, assignee: { kind: 'role', name: 'implementer' } });
  const set = setWake(t.db, source.taskId, { on: true, as: ALICE, maxDepth: 5, role: 'vi-coordinator' }, ALICE, APP, NOW);
  if (!set.ok) throw new Error(set.message);
  const run = claimed(t.db, source.taskId);
  const blocked = block(t.db, source.taskId, { kind: 'run', runId: run.runId }, { kind: 'needs_input', reason: 'Which one?' }, NOW + 1);
  if (!blocked.ok) throw new Error(blocked.message);
  closeRun(t.db, run.runId, NOW + 2);
  const other = newTask(t.db, { createdVia: THREAD });
  const sub = subscriptionsOf(t.db, source.taskId)[0]?.id ?? 0;
  const events = eventsOf(t.db, source.taskId).filter((e) => e.kind === 'blocked').slice(0, blocks);
  const made = service.recordRoleWake({
    uuid: `u-${source.taskId}`,
    channel: 'lark',
    appId: APP,
    conversationId: 'oc_team',
    threadId: 'omt_1',
    principal: ALICE,
    depth: 0,
    events: events.map((e) => ({ subscriptionId: sub, eventId: e.id, taskId: source.taskId })),
    role: 'vi-coordinator',
    title: `React to board updates: ${source.taskId} blocked`,
    body: 'Board update: …',
  });
  if (!made.ok || 'skipped' in made) throw new Error('no reaction task');
  const token = mintToken();
  const c = service.claim(made.task.taskId, { tokenHash: hashToken(token) });
  if (!c.ok) throw new Error(c.message);
  return {
    source: source.taskId,
    other: other.taskId,
    react: made.task.taskId,
    ask: (command, input = {}) => api.handle({ run: c.run.runId, token, command, input }),
  };
}

describe('wake-show', () => {
  it('is a worker command', () => {
    expect(WORKER_COMMANDS).toContain('wake-show');
    expect(WORKER_COMMANDS).toContain('wake-unblock');
  });

  it("shows a task the wake carried, as the operator's --json, names by principal", async () => {
    const r = reaction();
    const shown = await r.ask('wake-show', { task_id: r.source });
    expect(shown).toMatchObject({ ok: true, task: { task_id: r.source, phase: 'blocked' } });
    expect(changes).toBe(0);
  });

  it('refuses any other task unauthorized, one that exists and one that does not, in the same words', async () => {
    const r = reaction();
    const a = await r.ask('wake-show', { task_id: r.other });
    const b = await r.ask('wake-show', { task_id: 'k_nonesuch1234' });
    expect(a).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: 'unauthorized' });
    expect(b).toEqual(a);
  });

    expect(getTask(t.db, r.source)?.phase).toBe('blocked');
    expect(await r.ask('wake-unblock', { task_id: r.source })).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: 'stale' });
    expect(changes).toBe(0);

  it('refuses recurring a block at block_recurrence_limit', async () => {
    const source = newTask(t.db, { createdVia: THREAD, assignee: { kind: 'role', name: 'implementer' } });
    setWake(t.db, source.taskId, { on: true, as: ALICE, maxDepth: 5, role: 'vi-coordinator' }, ALICE, APP, NOW);
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i += 1) {
      if (i > 0) service.unblock(source.taskId, ALICE, undefined);
      const run = claimed(t.db, source.taskId);
      block(t.db, source.taskId, { kind: 'run', runId: run.runId }, { kind: 'needs_input', reason: 'Which one?' }, NOW + 1);
```
